{{TOC left}}

'''Acidir''' used to be home to the rich collectors of mysterious artifacts. It is reported that these collectors have recently stumbled upon something truly mysterious. We don't know exactly what it is, all we know is that no sane voice was heard after its arrival. High value artefacts remain inside.<br>There are 12 new themed scrap items to find on this moon.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Acidirtopvieww.png|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Lost.|Warm lush terrain, supports plenty of flora, acidic pools present.|A healthy ecosystem, fauna supports neutral behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
'''Acidir''' is an abandoned dark swampy moon featuring dense swampy forest, abandoned massive mansion, ponds of acid water, columns and overturned columns that create bridges between shores, lots of swamp trees and plants and several fireflies. Upon exiting the ship, to the right when you go down the path you'll see a short parkour that leads to large mansion where you'll find main entrance on the front side of the building and fire exit on the other side.<br>If you go a little to the right when exiting the ship and go through the bridge, you'll see fire exit to your right but when you go left where a few spotlights seem to lead, you'll find a few tables with documents and folders on them. On one table there is a pickable item which is called '''Cunningham's travel log 3'''. It can be inserted into log translator that is in front of the ship.<br>When you go to the left from the ship you'll see two paths:
*parkour made of logs
*parkour made of columns
Both parkours lead to two diffrent fire exits.<br>If you go behind the ship and and then a little to the left, you'll find a path. When you follow it, you'll find a bridge made from a column. When you go cross it, there will be two paths which lead to two different fire exits.

== > Weather ==
Acidir supports Rainy, Foggy, Stormy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed and Hurricane weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside & Outside Ambience ===
On Acidir, you can hear two different ambiences. One that plays inside and one that plays outside.

==== Outside Ambience ====
[[File:acidir outside loop.wav]]

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:acidir inside loop.mp3]]

=== Acid Water ===
As mentioned above, Acidir has '''acidic pools''' instead of water that rapidly damage the player while inside them. Falling too deep into the acid pools causes immediate death similarly to falling into a death pit.

== > Lore ==
=== The Crescent of Curses ===
- A crescent shaped cosmic growth with eyes all over it.
=== Lost Notes ===
- These follow the descent into madness of Acidir's inhabitants after the Crescent of Curses shows up.

=== Cunningham's Travel Log 3 ===
- Captain Commander Cunningham's report on Acidir during her second expedition in hopes of finding [[Cosmocos]], can be found by following the spotlights next to a fire exit.

[[file:Cunningham log 3.mp3]]
{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
! Text {{pad|0.5em|}}
|-
|{{Story Log Text|Captains Log. Log 3. Location, Acidir.<br><br>I’ve hardly had a moment to record my findings.<br>Navigating Etern was a nightmare with those bloody Nutcrackers roaming the desert.<br>We were down to a crew of 26 after that veritable screw-up - and I’m afraid things have only gotten worse since we arrived on Acidir.<br>But first - my findings on Etern.<br><br>A silver lining - I recovered a log from the corpse of a scientist pertaining to Cosmocos’ location.<br>It seems that he created some sort of AI for the sole purpose of retrieving these coordinates.<br>Unfortunately, the AI seems to malfunction while reciting them...<br><br>Certainly, it’s some system error in the mad-man’s machine.<br>Most definitely.<br>But...for some reason, it feels to me that Cosmocos...does not want to be found.<br>And yet the more I recall, the more intense my desire becomes to try and locate it.<br>To see the way the walls of crystal shimmer in the light of those strange bulbs that hang from the trees...<br><br>I know that my dreary mind couldn’t create things of such beauty of its own accord.<br>I’m far too boring for that.<br><br>Nevertheless.<br>I left a log with the rising map on Atlantica, and I’ve discovered that the 6th letter of the coordinates is a lowercase Z. Zee. Zed.<br><br>We’ll soon be leaving Acidir.<br>5 went mad after coming into contact with the Crescent of Curses and decided to go for a swim with the local pond life.<br>3 ran screaming into the woods, and it’s been hours since we saw them.<br>The ship will fly soon when the conditions become too dangerous.<br>If they’re not back before then...<br><br>Our next destination is Polarus.<br>This was the closest moon to Cosmocos before it’s disappearance.<br>We’ll stop by Gratar in lieu of the ramblings in the scientists log.<br><br>This is Cunningham. Signing off.}}
|}

== > Trivia ==
*At one point, maneaters were unintentionally added to the map. They have since been removed, but there now exists a baby maneater with a dynamite plushie as a joke.
*The ambience of Acidir is an unused ambience track from "The Betweenlands". MrCompost, the creator of Betweenlands, used to do sound design for Wesley's Moons.
*Before '''"Obscurity"''' the video material on Acidir videotape was different:<br><br>[[File:AcidirTape.mp4|border|frameless|300px]]

{{TOC left}}

'''Alcatras''' has a prison island in the outter area of the known region. Only the most dangerous of criminals would be sent to this place to never be heard from again. It is well protected, the Mortor brand was quite popular.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Alcatrastopview.jpg|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Executed.|Warm, tropical forests, large oceans.|A healthy ecosystem, fauna exhibits dangerous behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather ==
Alcatras can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Mortars ===
Alcatras has the Mortor mortars as seen in the Motra Tape, these mortars are made to shoot a bursts of explosive shells at super fast speeds. There are also switches to turn off the Mortors around the surface of the island. 

A cool '''easter egg''' can be seen when landing while the moon is rainy, flooded or stormy. A mortor with a funnel can be seen right by the ship landing spot just like in the Motra Tape.

######## Arachnohead
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Arachnohead
|images=
ArachnoheadGame.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Bunker Spider
|Internal ID= ArachnoheadEnemy
|Max Count= 3
|Power Level= 1
|Cause of Death= Blast, Mauling
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= 2
|Damage= 50, 90, or Instant Kill
|Door Speed Multiplier= 0.15
|Stun Time Multiplier= 1
}}

The '''Arachnohead''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Bunker_Spider Bunker Spider] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is a pale, baby doll-like head attached to four mechanical legs. It has a right blue eye and a left green eye that emit a light and are constantly shfiting focus.

== > Mechanics ==
Similar to a Bunker Spider, an '''Arachnohead''' will initially attempt to create a nesting area by placing several webs in the surrounding area and will typically stop if it encounters a player until line of sight is broken. Once all the webs have been laid down, the '''Arachnohead''' will find a spot to wait until one of its webs is triggered, a player walks underneath it, or it is attacked by a player. It will then pursue that player.

If the head of an '''Arachnohead''' comes into contact with players, they will take 90 damage. Any player that dies to an '''Arachnohead''' in this way will be cocooned, hung from the ceiling, and only be recoverable via the teleporter.

The '''Arachnohead''' additionally explodes on death. This explosion deals 50 damage to all nearby players or kills players and entities very close to the explosion. This explosion can set off nearby landmines, set off other '''Arachnoheads''', and set Forest Keepers on fire.

== > Spawn Chances ==
An '''Arachnohead''' is guaranteed to spawn after triggering a [[Filitrios#Teddy_Bears|Teddy Bear on Filitrios]]. The '''Arachnohead''' is also injected into the '''Enemy Spawns (Interior)''' table of any moon experiencing [[Weathers#>_Hallowed|'''Hallowed''']] weather with a weight of 35, overriding the current weight if it is lower than that.

The '''Arachnohead''' can also naturally spawn on the following moons:

######## Art Gallery
[[File:Artgallerymain.jpg|thumb|The main entrance in the Art Gallery. Note how the door has transformed into a painting.]]
The '''Art Gallery''' is a museum themed interior that most commonly spawns on [[Cubatres]]. It always has three floors, and the main entrance is always on the second floor. After stepping away from main entrance the door visually transforms into a painting.

== > Rooms ==

*'''First Floor''' - The first floor has many statues of entities, moons, and display cases. Scrap can spawn in these display cases, which can be broken by interacting with them multiple times or hitting them with a shovel.
*'''Second Floor''' - The second floor is the painting gallery and scrap generally spawns on the tables or pedestals. There is an additional part of this area with a wooden floor and many statues of hoarding bugs.
*'''Third Floor''' - The third floor is a more expansive wooden storage area with various boxes, statues, paintings, etc. Scrap can spawn on the floor here.
*'''Cube Display''' - Several chairs lying in front of a display case with a device to input a code next to it. This room typically spawns adjacent to the main entrance and the display case holds the [[Art_Gallery#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objective''']] reward.

== > Interior Features ==
*'''Elevators''' - Two elevators connect to all three floors and can be used to go between them. Music can be heard playing from the elevators when nearby to indicate their position. A player can drop down from one floor to the next and take 50 damage without using an elevator, but dropping from the third floor to the first floor deals 100 damage. Entities can travel between floors through the broken elevator shaft.
*'''Lasso Man Sighting''' - Occasionally brief visions of a '''Lasso Man''' may appear that fades out of view after a couple seconds or upon getting close to it.
<!-- Needs confirmation if this still can happen.
*'''Paintings''' - Paintings on the walls of the second floor periodically shift into different paintings, using them for navigation is ill-advised.
-->
*'''Breaker Box''' - The breaker box in the Art Gallery is always accompanied by the same text, and turning it off can cause some secrets to be revealed.
*'''Movable Painting''' - Some paintings can be moved to reveal scrap behind them. If the '''Breaker Box''' is turned off, the paintings that can be moved will have a large X on them.
*'''Fog Machine''' - A fog machine can be found in the interior, primarily on the second floor, and reduces visibility in the surrounding area. It can be disabled by interacting with it.

== > Hazards ==
*'''Lasso''' - A lasso that falls and hangs from the ceiling swaying around, dealing 666 damage to any player that walks into it and hanging them. Their corpse will be left hanging from the ceiling afterward.
*'''Mysterious Painting''' - '''Lasso Man''' will stalk players and appear in paintings they were last around or are currently near. He starts at the back of the painting and quickly moves forward to be front and center of it, accompanied by a sound effect. If a player makes too much noise near the painting, '''Lasso Man''' will lash out of it with long, sweeping tendrils that deal 666 damage to players if they come into contact with the ends of them. '''Lasso Man''' will then shortly retreat back into the painting and disappear.

== > The Painting ==
[[File:ArtGalleryThePainting.jpg|thumb|A close-up of The Painting attached to the wall after having broken its glass display case.]]
The Painting serves as the apparatus for the interior, but it is not guaranteed to spawn. It is worth ▮220, is two-handed, and weighs 31lbs. It can be found in a glass casing at the end of a large room with several chairs, two Lasso Man statues, and a clock. This room always generates on the second floor.

When a player enters this room, an alarm will go off, sets of lasers will appear, and the clock will start ticking from 12 o'clock. A player must reach the end of the room and retrieve The Painting without being detected by the lasers and within about 90 seconds. If a player is detected or time runs out, The Painting can no longer be grabbed and will shortly be shredded. If a player successfully grabs The Painting, it will trigger all apparatus related events.

Players can safely stand between each set of lasers. On the left side of the room there is a note that provides instructions on how to move between the sets of lasers without being detected. When the lasers blink once, the lasers will shortly disappear and make it safe to move. When the lasers blink twice, it is not safe to move as the lasers disappear and reappear too quickly. When the lasers blink three times, it is not initially safe to move when the lasers briefly disappear but is safe to move the second time they disappear.

At the beginning, players can hug the wall to get to the center pathway and avoid having to deal with the chairs. Players should then get as close to each set of lasers as possible to make it easier to safely get between them. Although it can be difficult to discern between two or three blinks, it is very easy to tell when one blink happens and the timing for moving for one or three blinks is rather forgiving. Additionally, players should make sure to be checking their backs for entities, as they can come into the room.

== > Secondary Objectives ==
[[File:ArtGalleryCubeDisplay.jpg|thumb|The Cube Display that holds the reward with the device to input the code next to it.]]One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn inside the '''Cube Display'''.

=== Decipher the Code ===
After turning off the breaker box, four symbols will appear at the bottom of the '''Cube Display'''. Players must wander around the '''Second Floor''' and find those four symbols with a number nearby. Players must then return to the '''Cube Display''' and input the numbered code matching the symbol code.

If successful, a sound effect will play and the '''Cube Display''' will open for players to ge their reward.

=== Discover the Tower ===
If players turn off the breaker box, they'll receive a hint at the bottom of the '''Cube Display''' to find a tower. This tower is a moving pillar with several hoarding bugs on the '''First Floor'''. The hoarding bugs with an X on them can be interacted with to turn them around and reveal a paper attached to their back. One of the papers will have the code written on it.

After players learn the code, they can return to the '''Cube Display''', input the code, and get their reward.

=== Crack the Vault ===
If players turn off the breaker box, they'll receive a hint at the bottom of the '''Cube Display''' to find a vault. This vault spawns on the '''Second Floor''' in the area with wooden tiles.

The vault will have three small dials and one large dial on it. Players must repeatedly turn the small dials until they hear a noticeably different click sound. Once all three small dials are in place, players must look at what numbers they point to and add them together. The larger dial must then be turned to that number. For example, if the three small dials point to 5, 10, and 20 respectively, the large dial must be turned to 35. Players can then repeatedly interact with the door handle to try and open the door.

If successful, the door light will turn green and swing open to reveal the code. Players can then return to the '''Cube Display''', input the code, and get their reward.
=== Rewards ===
<!--Multiplayer values may need to be double checked in-game due to rounding.-->
<div class="noresize">
{| class="wikitable sortable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="text-align: center;" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
|+ style="white-space: nowrap;" | Art Gallery Secondary Rewards
! Scrap Name !! Image !! Conductive !! Weight (lbs) !! Base Value !! Minimum Value !! Minimum Solo Value !! Maximum Value !! Maximum Solo Value
|-
| Old idolised cube || {{Item Preview|Old idolised cube.png}} || Yes || 17 || 160 || 160 || 187 || 184 || 214
|-
| Idolised cube || {{Item Preview|Idolised cube.png}} || Yes || 17 || 270 || 270 || 315 || 310 || 362
|-
| Pristine idolised cube || {{Item Preview|Pristine idolised cube.png}} || Yes || 17 || 420 || 420 || 491 || 483 || 583
|}
</div>
The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Mechanics#Furniture_luck the vanilla luck system]. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. '''Discover the Tower''' and '''Crack the Vault''' are considered Easy difficulty and have a 1.0x multiplier. '''Decipher the Code''' is considered Medium difficulty and has a 1.15x multiplier. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

== > Event: Lost Corridors ==
[[File:ArtGalleryLostCorridorsEntrance.jpg|thumb|The entrance to the Lost Corridors.]]The '''Lost Corridors''' can generate connected to the '''Second Floor'''. The entrance is a door with an outline of '''Lasso Man''' above it.

Behind the door is a staircase that leads into a maze with statues of '''Lasso Man''', various boxes, etc., scattered around. The general layout of the maze is always the same but what pathways are open or blocked off is random. Players must find their way through the maze to a door at the end of it. This door can be locked, but a key spawns next to it. Inside the room will be a painting with '''Lasso Man''' in it as well as a '''Crystal of wicked soul''' next to the painting.

As soon as a player enters the room through or near the doorway, [[Lasso_Man|'''Lasso Man''']] will come out of the painting and spawn as an actual entity. He is a variant of the Jester that almost immediately spawns in his chasing state, but he has a significantly slower roaming speed and maximum chase speed. Players must escape back through the maze while '''Lasso Man''' chases them. Since '''Lasso Man''' is a Jester variant, he will target all players in the interior until they leave and then roam the interior looking for players for the rest of the day.

It is recommended to map out a specific path to escape from before entering the room and triggering '''Lasso Man''', as running into a dead-end can easily result in death. Spray paint is especially useful for this. It is also currently possible but not advised to use extension ladders to both clip into and out of the room to get '''Lasso Man''' stuck if the door is locked, potentially even being able to avoid triggering his spawn entirely, while still obtaining the reward.

The '''Crystal of wicked soul''' is the reward for the event. It is conductive, weighs 8lbs, and is worth ▮196.

######## Assimilated Employee
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Assimilated Employee
|images=
Assimilated Employee.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Cadaver Bloom
|Internal ID= AssimilatedEmployee<br>Enemy
|Max Count= 8
|Power Level= 3
|Cause of Death= Mauling
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= 28 (takes 1 damage from all sources)
|Damage= 30
|Door Speed Multiplier= 1.25
|Stun Time Multiplier= 0.25
}}

The '''Assimilated Employee''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Cadaver_Bloom Cadaver Bloom] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is the corpse of an employee with several tendrils coming out of their body that it uses to move around. The head of the deceased employee is also on top of and speared by one of the tendrils.

== > Mechanics ==
Similar to the '''Cadaver Bloom''', the '''Assimilated Employee''' will roam around until a player enters its line of sight. It will then quickly and erratically begin chasing and attempting to attack that player. It will deal 30 damage on contact and decapitate the player if they are killed by it.

Since the '''Assimilated Employee''' has a whopping 28hp and will only take 1 damage from any attack, the most effective ways to deal with are to prevent its spawning entirely or trap its AI. Beyond dying through unrecoverable means or behind a locked door, players can choose to die on terrain where enemy AI does not function properly to ensure the safety of the rest of the squad.

If players are in a situation where they must fight the '''Assimilated Employee''', a shovel is most effective. It will be stunned when it gets hit and players can simply strafe backwards or in a circle and hit the '''Assimilated Employee''' every time it time it tries to rush close to them. In a desparate situation, a player can sacrifice themselves by using the '''Mortar Hammer''' to stun the '''Assimilated Employee''' for 30 seconds and open a window for another player to easily kill it.

If an '''Assimilated Employee''' is killed, the body of the assimilated player will drop. This uses the same model as the Cadaver Bloom and flowers will be sprouting from the corpse.

== > Spawn Conditions ==
The '''Assimilated Employee''' can only spawn through the [[Assimilated_Growth|'''Assimilated Growth''']] and its infection. As such, the '''Assimilated Employee''' can be encountered on [[Hyx|'''Hyx''']]. It can additionally be encountered on {{spoiler|[[Faith|'''Faith''']], [[Filitrios|'''Filitrios''']], [[Fission-C|'''Fission-C''']], [[Gloom|'''Gloom''']], and [[Utril|'''Utril''']] if players place a mysterious object on their exteriors to spawn the '''Assimilated Growth''' on future landings. This also applies to [[Centrus|'''Centrus''']] and [[Vindict|'''Vindict''']] for placing the object on '''Filitrios''' or '''Utril''' respectively.<br><br>The object is reset after being fired unless the '''Brooding seeds''' acquired from the hidden chamber on [[Berunah|'''Berunah''']] are placed onto the exteriors of [[Etern|'''Etern''']], '''Filitrios''', '''Fission-C''', '''Gloom''', and '''Utril'''. The changes for every moon, including '''Faith''' regardless of if players moved the mysterious object in the [[Faith#Secret_Passage|'''Secret Passage''']], become permanent on that save file if this condition is met. Oddly, '''Etern''' does not seem to spawn an '''Assimilated Growth''' despite also having an altar.}}

While players can be fully infected and assimilated through [[Hyx#Assimilation|'''Hyx's hazards''']], the infection does not function properly if the '''Assimilated Growth''' has not spawned.

######## Assimilated Growth
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Assimilated Growth
|images=
Assimilated_Growth.jpg: In-Game
|Variant Of= Cadaver Growth
|Internal ID= AssimilatedGrowths<br>Enemy
|Max Count= 1
|Power Level= 2
|Cause of Death= Suffocation
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes (Kill Assimilated Employee)

|Health= Unkillable
|Damage= Instant Kill (Bursting)
|Door Speed Multiplier= Irrelevant
|Stun Time Multiplier= Immune
}}

The '''Assimilated Growth''', also referred to as its scan name '''Assimilation tendril''', is an infectious entity that only grows within the interior of a moon. It is a variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Cadaver_Growth Cadaver Growth] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. As the name implies, the growths are red tendrils that release foreign matter into the air to begin assimilating employees.

== > Mechanics ==
The '''Assimilated Growth''' behaves similarly to the Cadaver Growth, selecting a random tile to initially spawn and grow on, infecting nearby players, etc. However, the '''Assimilated Growth''' can not be destroyed and has a significantly reduced base rate of infection. This is especially noticeable in singleplayer, where players can last most if not the entire day without ever dying to infection on its own without additional modifiers, such as getting hit by [[Hyx#Assimilation|'''Hyx's hazards''']].

When a player is about to burst and die, they will see a warning message reading "IRREGULAR ORGAN MOVEMENT DETECTED!!! FOREIGN MATTER DETECTED!!! IRREGULAR BRAIN WAVE DETECTED!!!", will hear ringing, and their screen will turn red. They will die shortly afterward and an [[Assimilated_Employee|'''Assimilated Employee''']] will spawn from their body and corpse. An '''Assimilated Employee''' also spawns from infected players that die through most other means if infection has progressed far enough.

== > Spawn Conditions ==
An '''Assimilated Growth''' will immediately spawn in the interior of [[Hyx|'''Hyx''']]. An '''Assimilated Growth''' will also immediately spawn within the interiors of {{spoiler|[[Faith|'''Faith''']], [[Filitrios|'''Filitrios''']], [[Fission-C|'''Fission-C''']], [[Gloom|'''Gloom''']], and [[Utril|'''Utril''']] if a '''mysterious object''' has been placed on an altar on their exteriors. An '''Assimilated Growth''' will also spawn within the interiors of [[Centrus|'''Centrus''']] and [[Vindict|'''Vindict''']] after placing the object on '''Filitrios''' or '''Utril''' respectively.<br><br>The object is reset after being fired unless the '''Brooding seeds''' acquired from the hidden chamber on [[Berunah|'''Berunah''']] are placed onto the exteriors of [[Etern|'''Etern''']], '''Filitrios''', '''Fission-C''', '''Gloom''', and '''Utril'''. The changes for every moon, including '''Faith''' regardless of if players moved the mysterious object in the [[Faith#Secret_Passage|'''Secret Passage''']], become permanent on that save file if this condition is met. Oddly, '''Etern''' does not seem to spawn an '''Assimilated Growth''' despite also having an altar.}}

None of these spawns contribute to total Power Level.

######## Asten Lab
[[File:AstenLabMain.jpg|alt=The main entrance of Asten Lab.||thumb||The main entrance of Asten Lab.]]
The '''Asten Lab''' is a lab themed interior added in the '''Obscurity''' update. It most commonly spawns on [[Hyx]].

== > Rooms ==
*'''Cafeteria''' - A cafeteria that is always connected to the main entrance hallway, though it can generate up a staircase connected to said hallway. Scrap can spawn here.
*'''Security Office''' - A security office with several monitors. This office always spawns connected to the main entrance hallway. Scrap typically spawns outside the office doors.
*'''Containment Door''' - A sealed door that can only be opened by completing a [[Asten_Lab#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objective''']]. Other random scrap can spawn in the room behind it.
*'''Stairs''' - Stairs connecting to the upper or lower floor. Can often generate as dead ends.
*'''Janitor Closet''' - A small janitor's closet with various tools and utilities. Scrap can spawn in these closets.
*'''Lab Section''' - Larger rooms filled with all sorts of equipment, tables, containers, etc. Scrap can spawn in these rooms.
*'''Storage''' - Smaller rooms with a random assortment of things. Scrap can spawn in these rooms.
*'''Greenhouse''' - A corridor with several plants being grown on shelves.
*'''Office Space''' - A large office space with several desks, wooden walls, and padded floors. Scrap can spawn in this area.
*'''Cube''' - A room that connects to several hallways and has a cube structure in the middle of it. Scrap can spawn in this room.

== > Interior Features ==
*'''Breakable Glass''' - Players can break open glass containers in some '''Lab Section''' rooms by repeatedly interacting with them or by hitting them with a shovel. Scrap can spawn in these containers.
*'''Double Doors''' - Typically two doors instead of one will connect to the various hallways and rooms in the interior. Either door can be locked, so it's important to make sure they both are before using a key.

== > Hazards ==
*'''Chemical Bomb''' - A small, green container that will occassionally beep. If a player gets too close to one, including through obstructions or walls, it will start beeping faster and will explode if players stick by it for too long. This explosion can deal 50 damage to or instantly kill players depending on proximity to the blast. The explosion will also leave behind a slippery green substance around the surrounding area, causing players to slide around.

== > Secondary Objectives ==
[[File:AstenLabContainment.jpg|thumb|The Containment Door that holds the reward.]]One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn behind the '''Containment Door'''.

=== Security ===
Players must head to the '''Security Office''' and pull the lever located by the desk to turn on the monitors. Players can then interact with the keyboard to open and close doors as well as switch between monitors, with the monitor brightening to indicate which one the player is on. Only one door can be opened at a time and players must open the door matching the number on the '''Containment Door'''. Although players can go check what that number is first, it is often faster to brute force it by trying every door in rapid succession.

If the '''Containment Door''' is successfully opened, the keyboard can no longer be interacted with and a sound effect will play. Players can then head to and open the '''Containment Door''' for their reward.

=== Containment Breach ===
Shortly after landing on a moon, five [[Contaminated_Snare_Flea|'''Contaminated Snare Fleas''']] will spawn in the interior. This a variant of the Snare Flea with 1hp and a glowing green liquid on its body. All five must be killed and a sound effect will play every time one is killed. Typically, these fleas are bunched up or close by each other.

If all five are killed, a sound effect will play and players can now open the '''Containment Door''' for their reward.

=== Lockdown ===
Players must locate a small lab room containing a chemistry station, Hydrogen Peroxide, and a Sulfur Bottle. Players must insert the Sulfur Bottle into the tube above the red canister, insert the Hydrogen Peroxide into the clear container, add oxygen by interacting with the canister to the left on the ground, and turn the nozzle on the red canister to heat up the sulfur. Once complete, '''Sulfuric Acid''' will spawn as scrap for players to collect.

Players must then return to the '''Containment Door''' and insert the '''Sulfuric Acid''' into the panel on the left to fry the circuits. Players can then open the door to claim their reward.

=== Rewards ===
<div class="noresize">

The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Mechanics#Furniture_luck the vanilla luck system]. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. '''Security''' and '''Lockdown''' are considered Very Easy difficulty and have a 0.6x multiplier. '''Containment Breach''' is considered Easy difficulty and has a multiplier of 1.0x. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

== > Event: Cadaver Monstrosity ==
[[File:AstenLabCadaverMonstrosity.jpg|thumb|The Cadaver Monstrosity.]]In the '''Greenhouse''' tile, there is a chance for a crack in the wall to appear that players can interact with. Interacting with it will cause the player to take 5 damage and cause the '''Cadaver Monstrosity''' to bust through the wall. Two shovels will spawn in front of the '''Cadaver Monstrosity''' and it will trap all players in this room by blocking the exits with its arms.

The '''Cadaver Monstrosity''' will extend a tendril from the center of its body with a groan before striking it down near the center of the room and at a player. Any player hit by the strike will take 25 damage. Players must hit the weak spot at the end of this tendril with a shovel or knife to hurt the '''Cadaver Monstrosity'''. It takes a total of 10 hits to defeat.

The '''Cadaver Monstrosity''' will attempt to attack players with its mouths, indicated by a mouth chomping and preparing to lunge forward. Coming into contact with a mouth will deal 25 damage to players. The '''Cadaver Monstrosity''' will bite faster and more often as it loses hp.

Additionally, the '''Cadaver Monstrosity''' can spray pollen and acid from the flowers on its body at players. The pollen is harmless, but can obscure vision and make it harder to see visual telegraphs. A flower that is about to spray acid will begin twitching while closed before opening and spraying over the area in front of it, quickly dealing 10 damage per hit.

If players are unsuccessful and die to the '''Cadaver Monstrosity''', this room becomes blocked off for the rest of the day. If players are successful and kill the '''Cadaver Monstrosity''', it will violently explode and drop a '''Cadaver Heart''' worth ▮240 to ▮351. The '''Cadaver Monstrosity''' can kill players post-mortem if it began an animation prior to exploding, such as its acid spray.

'''Asteroid-13''' is not a traditional [[moons|moon]], but an asteroid housing a "bio-weapon testing facility". The moon orbits Vow and nobody who has ever went to the moon has returned.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Asteroid-13top.jpg|650px|border|frameless]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Deceased/Mutated|Cold, hard rocky terrain, no surface plant life detected.|A dead ecosystem.|}}

== > Environment ==
'''Asteroid-13''' is a a rocky environment with 7 big craters around the map and a lot of smaller ones scattered about on the moon. The buildings are domed bunkers that appear to lead underground due to the lack of any large buildings on the surface. Unlike other moons, '''Asteroid-13''' has no sun. 

== > Weather ==
Asteroid-13 can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, or Minefield weather by default.

If Asteroid-13 is Eclipsed, the power supply will be completely broken and the lights can not be turned on. Additionally, eight enemies will spawn on the exterior and in the interior when landing.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==

=== Inside & Outside Ambience ===
On Asteroid-13 you can hear two diffrent ambiences. One plays inside, while the other one plays outside.

==== Outside Ambience ====
[[File:Asteroid outside loop.wav]]

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:Asteroid inside loop.wav]]

=== Hidden Clock & Time Multiplier ===
The player's clock is hidden while on Asteroid-13. However, time progresses at its normal speed.

=== Electricity ===
Asteroid-13's exterior has a power switch that lights up the entire moon to see. The power will randomly turn off sometimes, requiring a player to go back to it and turn it on again. The power will also shut off when the ship leaves the moon. This power switch is unavailable when the moon is Eclipsed, or if a player has pulled the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Apparatus Apparatus]. 

Asteroid-13's interior is always foggy, similar to the vanilla Zeekerss event, which reduces visibility.

== > Lore ==
'''Asteroid-13''' is a bio-weapon testing and holding facility created after the fall of '''[[Calist]]'''. It hosted multiple entities such as:

'''BIO-HXNV7''' (The description matches that of a [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Coil-Head Coil-head])

'''Cursed Coin''' (Effects of this bio-weapon match that of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Ghost_Girl Ghost Girl])

'''Hyper Acid''' (It is hinted towards the Acid having a connection with the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Hygrodere Hydrodere] through it's capabilities)

'''Comedy Mask''' (The [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Masks_(Item) Masks] found throughout the vanilla game)

'''Golden Dagger''' (Custom item added by Welsey's Moons)

On the outside and throughout it's interior multiple pieces of information such as the following can be found:

''Experiment Logs''

''Recovered Secret Log''

''Geoffrey Final Log''

######## Atlantean Citadel
[[File:Atlantean Citadel Main Entrance.jpg|alt=The main entrance room in the Atlantean Citadel interior.|thumb|The main entrance room in the Atlantean Citadel interior.]]
The '''Atlantean Citadel''' is an ancient temple themed interior that frequently spawns on [[Atlantica]], [[Berunah]], [[Hyve]], [[Junic]], [[Roart]], and [[Thalasso]]. This interior also has a rare chance to spawn on any moon.

== > Rooms ==
*'''Vault''' - A lever can be pulled in the main entrance area to raise up a hidden '''Vault''' with symbols on it. Completing a [[Atlantean_Citadel#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objective''']] allows players to interact with the lever on it and open it.
*'''Great Hall''' - A large area with various branching pathways connecting to the rest of the interior that has three floors. It is always connected to the main entrance.
*'''Observatory''' - A room with several tower structures and a starry roof. This room is primarily for the [[Atlantean_Citadel#Seek_the_Hidden_Stars|'''Seek the Hidden Stars]] objective.
*'''Grates''' - A spiral staircase leading to a grate that can be pushed upward. Players can remain at the top of the staircase and jump to avoid drowning during interior floods.
*'''Sunroof''' - Sunlight can be seen from the roof of a large pit. This doesn't actually lead to the exterior and attempting to reach the top with a jetpack will deal 666 damage to and cut the player in half. There is a staircase players can use to avoid drowning when the interior floods.
*'''Tunnels''' - Tunnels that players must crouch-walk into. Entities can go into these tunnels.

== > Interior Features ==
*'''Chests''' - Chests can be found in the interior that can have scrap in them. This scrap is separate from the rest of the scrap initially generated on a moon and spawns when the chest is opened.
*The weather slightly alters the appearance of the interior. For example, rain can be seen pouring from the '''Sunroof''' during Rainy, Stormy, or Flooded weather.
*The color of this interior depends on the moon it spawns on.

== > Hazards ==
*'''Axe Trap''' - Sometimes there can be a pressure plate that when stepped on triggers an axe to swing across, dealing 100 damage to any player caught in its path. This can be avoided by moving fast enough or jumping over the pressure plate.
*'''Eye Trap''' - An eye that looks around periodically. Any players that enter its line of sight will anger it, causing it to release spikes from various holes in the room dealing 33 damage. This can be avoided by avoiding its gaze or by running out of the room fast enough after angering it.

== > Beholder's Eye ==
[[File:CitadelBeholdersEye.jpg|thumb|192x108px|A Beholder's Eye in a hidden treasure chamber.]]
The '''Beholder's Eye''' serves as the apparatus for the interior, and two are guaranteed to spawn on either side of the interior. Both are worth ▮180, are two-handed, and weigh 36lbs. Each one is located behind a special locked door that can only be opened with a "Dungeon key", and two keys are guaranteed to spawn in the interior as scrap.

When the first Beholder's Eye is taken, all other apparatus related events will be triggered and the interior will begin to flood. The player must utilize the '''Grates''', '''Sunroof''', remain on the third floor at the '''Great Hall''', or simply wait outside to avoid drowning. The water level will rise and persist for about 105 seconds before draining in the next 15 seconds, making the whole sequence last for about 120 seconds.

Although water can still be heard gushing in either of the Beholder's Eye rooms, the interior can only flood once a day and the second Beholder's Eye can be safely retrieved provided another key is found.<br><br><br>

== > Secondary Objectives ==
[[File:AtlanteanCitadelVault.jpg|thumb|The Vault that holds the reward.]]One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn in the '''Vault'''.

=== Fill the Waters of Tribute ===
If the four basins are not lit up on the '''Vault''', players must find a room with four water basins, writing on the walls, and a door similar to the '''Vault''' door. Players must follow the instructions written on the wall to press the buttons to pour the exact amount of water needed into each basin. The numbers written use [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman_numerals Roman numerals].

If sucessful, the door similar to the '''Vault''' door will open to reveal a lever. Interacting with this lever will cause a sound effect to play and players can return to and open the '''Vault''' to get their reward.

=== Turn On the Fountains ===
If the three fountains are not lit up on the '''Vault''', players must find three fountains in the interior. At least one typically spawns in the '''Great Hall'''. They must then interact with five buttons in a random order to turn them on, and the buttons will reset to the starting position if pressed in the wrong order. A sound effect will play and water will begin to flow from the fountain if successful.

Once all three fountains have been turned on, a sound effect will play and players can return to and open the '''Vault''' to get their reward.

=== Seek the Hidden Stars ===
If the observatory looking at a star is not lit up on the '''Vault''', players must find the '''Observatory'''. A tower light will be on and players can interact with a panel in the room to turn it up, down, left, and right. Players must locate the random position of three hidden stars. The light from the observatory will get smaller as players get closer to a star. A red star will form and a jingle will play when a star is successfully found.

After players locate all three hidden stars, a sound effect will play and it will start visually storming in that room. Players can now return to and open the '''Vault''' to get their reward.

=== Rewards ===

The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Mechanics#Furniture_luck the vanilla luck system]. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. '''Fill the Waters of Tribute''' is considered Easy difficulty and has a 1.0x multiplier. '''Turn On the Fountains''' and '''Seek the Hidden Stars''' are considered Hard difficulty and have a 1.4x multiplier. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

== > Event: Atlantean Tomb ==
[[File:AtlanteanCitadelTomb.jpg|thumb|The Atlantean Tomb after starting the event.]]The '''Atlantean Tomb''' can randomly generate in the interior. It is a room with a center device and several inactive '''Eye Traps''' on the wall. To start the event, players must interact with three levers in a random order on the back of the central device. This will cause the door to the room to shut and the lights to turn on.

Players must now interact with seven levers on the wall in a random and sequential order. Activating the wrong lever will cause all levers to reset. One strategy players can use is to give a number to each lever in their head to make it easier to remember the correct sequence.

While players do this, three different traps can activate. The first trap activates immediately after starting the event, where an '''Eye Trap''' reveals itself in the center device and begins spinning towards a player. The speed of its spin depends on how far away it is from a player, and weightless players can outpace it by simply walking in the same direction of the spin. Players can not duck under its line of sight even though it looks possible to do. If it is triggered, several spikes that deal 33 damage each will come out of the center device. Players can stand on the edge of the center device to avoid the attack.

After players have activated two successful levers, the '''Eye Traps''' on the wall will begin activating at random. They behave the same as the hazard and activate the spikes around them. The rate at which the '''Eye Traps''' activate and how many are active at any given time increases based on the progress made on the correct lever sequence.

After players have successfully activated four levers, a giant eye will periodically become active and reveal itself on the ceiling to look down at the whole room. It will then get angry and cause several blades to shoot from the ground and slowly rotate around a ring near the center. These blades will shortly recede back into the ground and each blade does 33 damage per hit to players on contact. This attack can easily be avoided by going closer to the center.

After players activate all seven levers in the correct order, all the eyes will begin to close and the center device will lower. It will then raise back up to reveal four '''Golden bones'''. Each bone is conductive, weighs 16lbs, and is worth ▮112-151.

{{TOC left}}

Atlantica was hit by rogue rays from a supernova. This caused a disturbance in the local flow of time. Because of this, the city of Atlantica is forever doomed to sink over and over. Every inhabitant has drowned.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Atlanticatopview.png|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Drowned.|Cold wet terrain, supports aquatic plant life.|A healthy ecosystem, fauna supports neutral behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}
Primarily ocean, or coastal. split into multiple islands, bound together by small paths.

== > Weather ==
Atlantica can experience Rainy, Stormy, Flooded, Foggy, Eclipsed, or Forsaken weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside Ambience ===
On Atlantica you can hear an unique ambience that plays inside.

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:Atlantica ambience inside.wav]]

=== Sinking City's Events ===
The interior will flood twice a day regardless of what interior is generated. The first flood will begin at around 10:00am, flood entirely at around 11:30am, and drain at around 12:30pm. The second flood will begin at around 04:30pm, flood entirely around 06:00pm, and begin draining at around 07:00pm. It is advised to leave the interior entirely during these timeframes to avoid drowning, but it is possible to get to higher elevations in some interiors to survive.<br><br>'''Additionally''', the main entrance will begin sinking at around 04:30pm and be completely submerged at around 07:30pm. Although it is still possible to enter through the main entrance past this point in time, the only reliable way to exit through it is with a jetpack.<br><br>Upon leaving the moon, you'll hear a loud burst and a light blue light will illuminate the area, followed by everything returning to how it was at the start of the day before sinking.

{{spoiler|Interacting with the map found on the exterior of [[Infernis]].<br>Alternatively, inserting the Atlantica videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of [[Alcatras]] and [[Gratar]] into the projector in [[Galetry]].}}

{{spoiler|[[Lecaro|<big>'''Lecaro:'''</big>]] If you go to the left of the ship and continue the path that way, you will eventually reach a fire exist that has a bridge to the right of it. Pushing down the bridge will lead to a structure that has a map that's drawn on the ground. Interacting with this will cause a short cutscene then unlock Lecaro.}}<br>{{spoiler|[[Gratar|<big>'''Gratar:'''</big>]] Gratar videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.}}

######## Backoiler Spillfish
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Backoiler Spillfish
|images=
Backoiler Spillfish.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Backwater Gunkfish
|Internal ID= OilyStingray
|Max Count= 6
|Power Level= 0.5
|Cause of Death= N/A
|Is Body Recoverable?= N/A

|Health= 4
|Damage= 0
|Door Speed Multiplier= 0.8
|Stun Time Multiplier= 1
}}

The '''Backoiler Spillfish''' is a docile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Backwater_Gunkfish Backwater Gunkfish] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is a purple stingray with two small eyes, five tentacles for its mouth, and a dark green coloration around its eyes, on its back, and on its stinger.

== > Mechanics ==
Similar to the Backwater Gunkfish, the '''Backoiler Spillfish''' will find a location to enter its hiding state near scrap, at an AI node, or near the closest player and can be heard flopping around while it does so. If any player enters its line of sight while it moves to this location, it will immediately stop moving and enter its hiding state.

After entering its hiding state, the '''Backoiler Spillfish''' will remain there indefinitely if no players are in the interior or on the exterior where it is. If players are in the interior or on the exterior where it is, it will instead check for nearby players on a timer. If this timer runs out, it will get up, leave a small puddle of oily goo behind, and find a new location to hide.

If a player steps on, hits, or remains too close to a '''Backoiler Spillfish''' for too long, it will be frightened and spray all nearby players with goo that covers their hud. It will then flee, leaving behind a trail of slippery and oily goo that lasts for the rest of the day.

Two universal bugs exist for the Backwater Gunkfish and all its variants. Firstly, all of them practically have 5hp instead of 4hp, as they only die after their hp drops below 0 rather than at 0. Secondly, all of them will use the same goo as whichever one first sprayed goo on a moon. For example, the '''Backoiler Spillfish''' will use the same goo as the [[Springwater_Hotfish|'''Springwater Hotfish''']] if the latter sprayed goo first, making the '''Backoiler Spillfish''' capable of killing players. However, these are mostly just auditory or visual differences.

== > Spawn Chances ==
The '''Backoiler Spillfish''' only has a chance to spawn within the interiors of [[Oldred|'''Oldred''']] (25.97%) and [[Thalasso|'''Thalasso''']] (9.80%). 

== > Bestiary Entry ==
The '''Backoiler Spillfish''' has the same entry as the Backwater Gunkfish.
{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
!Backwater Gunkfish {{pad|0.5em|}}
|-
|{{Story Log Text|Backwater Gunkfish<br><br>Sigurd's danger level: 0% but these little goopy goblins wont leave me ALONE<br><br>Scientific name: Infectum linteum<br><br>The Backwater Gunkfish is a type of Gunkfish of the family Mobulidae. Unlike the other types of Gunkfish, the Backwater Gunkfish spends most of its time on land. It can inhabit any damp, warm space where a water source is present. Its body is fat, flat, squishy and gelatinous, the width of a doormat. Its tail, slightly harder than the rest of its soft body, can range from 2-3 feet in length. When stressed, its tail is often curled up over its head to position for firing mucus or to shake and rattle as a deterrent.<br><br>The Backwater Gunkfish feeds off organic material on surfaces, and for this reason, it is found most often around polluted water, swamps, or dirty sewers. When frightened, the Gunkfish can use an opening in its tail to release a burst of a thick, green mucus mixed with saliva to defend itself; the Backwater Gunkfish keeps an especially large "reserve" for emergency situations and can squirt multiple times. When needed, it uses part of this extra reserve to excrete from its body, increasing its mobility on land.<br><br>The Backwater Gunkfish is harmless and is considered a natural cleaner of its preferred environments. Its mucus is a disinfectant; though it is not safe or healthy to consume, it is unlikely to cause major harm if it enters the body through the eyes or nose. Its smell is often described as a mix of vinegar and lard, and it is slightly warm when freshly excreted.<br><br>Though not directly harmful, the Backwater Gunkfish is often considered a notorious pest to water treatment facilities and petroleum refineries. The gunkfish itself is evasive, capable of fitting itself into very small holes and pipes, and its mucus is arduous to remove once it has hardened, forming a substance comparable to ice. For all these reasons, the Backwater Gunkfish has lead to many accidents and should be taken seriously. Today, pest removal services are well-accustomed to safe Gunkfish removal and relocation operations, and there are many affordable options if you believe there is one in the area. The best way to prevent a Gunkfish infestation is to keep your environment clean and dry and to close off any access to standing water.}}
|}

######## Baduck
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title= Baduck
|images=
Baduck.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Baboon Hawk
|Internal ID= BaboonDuck
|Max Count= 120
|Power Level= 0.5
|Cause of Death= Unknown
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= 2
|Damage= 20
|Door Speed Multiplier= 0.5
|Stun Time Multiplier= 0.4
}}

The '''Baduck''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Baboon_Hawk Baboon Hawk] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It resembles a rubber ducky and a small Baboon Hawk as a rotund, bipedal creature with a bird-like skull, yellow skin, an orange beak, brown and orangish fur on its back, and bat-like wings. It has rows of fanged teeth inside its beak it uses to bite players.

== > Mechanics ==
The '''Baduck''' is almost identical to the Baboon Hawk in terms of behavior and AI, spawning in groups of two, often scouting around in groups, having the same checks for when to attack a player, etc. While the '''Baduck''' does have a predetermined territory with the same three pikes as the Baboon Hawk, they will sometimes just return to wherever they had spawned with scrap and player corpses as well.

The primary differences between the two are just their stats. The '''Baduck''' is easier to kill due to its reduced hp, but its tiny size can make it more annoying in general. The sheer number of '''Baducks''' that spawn can also quickly become an issue if they all decide to gang up on players at once.

== > Spawn Chances ==
The '''Baduck''' has a 66.67% chance to spawn in the interior, on the exterior, and on the exterior during daytime on [[Duckstroid-14|'''Duckstroid-14''']], exclusively spawning on this moon.

== > Bestiary Entry ==
Players must type in "baboonduck" as one word to access this entry, as the terminal will attempt to redirect to the entry for the Baboon Hawk otherwise.

Endless deserts, nothing but sand.<br><br>Except for the occasional temple hidden between the hills of sand.<br><br>They say below the sand lies an ancient civilisation hidden from time.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:BerunahMap.png|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|-|Hot, endless deserts, ancient artifacts detected.|Populated by very few species.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}
'''Berunah''' environment

== > Weather ==
Berunah can experience Stormy or Eclipsed weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Time Multiplier ===
This moon has a default day speed multiplier of 0.75, meaning the player can stay on the moon for longer.

=== Sandstorm ===
Shortly after landing, a sandstorm will blow through. This will lower the sand in the area and reveal the ruins that make up the exterior.

=== Destiny Item For {{Spoiler|Ending 3}} ===
<big>The following content contains spoilers for completion.</big>

{{spoiler | Once the sandstorm has passed, a stairway will be revealed directly in front of the main entrance door. Going down this stairway will lead to an area with an interactable statue on the left side. After interacting with this statue, inserting a "Crystal cube", which is found on the exterior of [[Cubatres]], into the hole the statue's light is shining through will reveal a hidden chamber. Inside will be five brooding seeds and a glowing eye at the end of the chamber. The player must return all these brooding seeds to the ship, but can also approach the eye for an explanation on what to do with these seeds. }}

{{spoiler | The player must place the brooding seeds onto altars on the exteriors of [[Etern]], [[Filitrios]], [[Fission-C]], [[Gloom]], and [[Utril]]. Doing so will alter the exteriors and interiors of these moons any time players land on those moons afterward until the player is fired. These changes become permanent on that save file once all five seeds are placed prior to being fired. Berunah's exterior will also be permanently altered on that save file once all five seeds are placed and players have entered the hidden chamber at least once.}}

{{spoiler | Once all five brooding seeds have been placed, the player must return to Berunah and the hidden chamber. A "Chunk of Overseer" will now be in the hidden chamber. Near the main entrance, a lever that a statue is looking at will now be interactable nearby. This will raise up the shrine of purification to insert the chunk into, and a cutscene will play shortly afterward. }}

{{spoiler | After the cutscene, the destiny item "Stone of purification" will spawn behind the ship. This allows the player to achieve Ending 3. }}

######## Black and White Confetbees
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Black and White Confetbees
|images=
Black and White Confetbees.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Mask Hornets
|Internal ID= BlackWhiteConfetbees
|Max Count= 1
|Power Level= 2
|Cause of Death= Stabbing
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= Unkillable
|Damage= 10
|Door Speed Multiplier= 0.08
|Stun Time Multiplier= 0.6
}}

The '''Black and White Confetbees''' are a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Mask_Hornets Mask Hornets] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. As the name implies, they look like small pieces of black and white confetti.

== > Mechanics ==
Similiar to the Mask Hornets, the '''Black and White Confetbees''' roam around the interior until finding a player to chase. They will quickly deal 10 damage per hit to players on contact. They move rather slowly, being even slower than a player at walking speed in straightaways, and can be greatly hindered by doors.

A general strategy for dealing with the '''Black and White Confetbees''' during the event is to walk around the edge of the arena and group up all the bees before quickly moving to the other side of the room once it is about to spin. This helps in getting the bees closer to the center pillar to potentially get caught on it or slowed down by it once the spinning starts.

== > Spawn Conditions ==
Three '''Black and White Confetbees''' are spawned during the [[Carnival#>_Event%3A_Colorless_Spiral|'''Colorless Spiral''']] event in the '''Carnival'''. These spawns do not contribute to the total Power Level, and the Max Count and Power Level of the '''Black and White Confetbees''' only matters if players modify spawn tables to spawn the '''Black and White Confetbeees''' elsewhere.

== > Bestiary Entry ==
While the '''Black and White Confetbees''' do have a unique bestiary entry, they share the same terminal keyword, "confetbees", as the [[Confetbees|'''Confetbees''']] and it will typically override that entry. However, there is little difference between the two entries.

The Grand Capitol of '''Calist''' rests between the dense green forests and the lakes of golden shine. Until one day, it did not. Broken remains.. remain inside.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Calisttopviewv1.jpg|650px|frameless|border]]
[[File:Calistv2.jpg|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Destroyed.|Warm, dense forests, rivers of gold.|A healthy ecosystem, fauna exhibits dangerous behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}
Calist has a rocky environment with a small surface area due to it's destruction. Remnants float in near orbit rocky bits of planet debris and ruined buildings.

== > Weather ==
Calist can experience Eclipsed weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside & Outside Ambience ===
On Calist you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside the facility while the other one plays outside.

==== Outside Ambience ====
[[File:Calist outside loop.wav]]

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:Calist inside loop.wav]]

=== Falling Buildings ===
As time passes on Calist, broken buildings will begin falling and landing on its surface. This causes the roof within interior to randomly collapse with rubble and damage the player. One building will fall and create a bridge behind the ship that leads to one of the fire exits at around 02:00pm.

=== Royal Apparatus ===
Calist has a lone interior fire exit that leads to an area below the main exterior, where the Royal Apparatus can be found. The player will have to jump across moving rocks to reach it and return to the fire exit, which as a minimum reference is possible to do with base game stamina and 100lbs. This area is accessible via jetpack as well. Additionally, removing the Royal Apparatus triggers all apparatus related events, including the activation of all Old Birds.

{{TOC left}}

A renowned establishment on the moon of '''Carnate'''. The circus is a place of joy. Or perhaps a corportate ploy to exhaust the common people of their finance while overworking and tormenting those who worked under the circus umbrella with hands of careless greed. Who knows. High value plushies remain inside.

== > Moon Map ==

== > Moon Info ==

{{Moon Info|Abandoned|Warm. healthy environment, mostly covered by forest.|Rich and healthy ecosystem.|}}

== > Environment ==
'''Carnate''' has hilly and forested terrain with two lakes to the south and northwest. Fireflies appear around the exteiror as time progresses. Several circus tents, balloons, picnic tables, poles with lights, speakers, and party streamers, and carousels like the ones found in the [[Toy_Store|'''Toy Store''']] can be found on the exterior as well. If the breaker box is turned off in the interior, the lights on the exterior will also turn off.

Players can go inside the large red and yellow tents, which typically have several tables and chairs as well as a star with an eye in the center of the floor. Four of these tents are the main entrance and fire exits. The main entrance is in the tent southwest of the ship, a fire exit tent is south and slightly west of the ship and behind the main entrance tent, another fire exit tent is far northeast of the ship, and the last fire exit tent is north of the ship.

######## Carnival
[[File:CarnivalMain.jpg|alt=The main entrance of the Carnival.||thumb||The main entrance of the Carnival.]]
The '''Carnival''' is a circus and funhouse themed interior added in the '''Obscurity''' update. It only spawns commonly on [[Carnate]] and has a very rare chance to spawn on any moon.

== > Rooms ==
*'''Tent''' - A yellow and red tent that the main entrance spawns in.
*'''Button Room''' - A room with a large container and a button that always spawns in the '''Tent'''. This is the reward room for the [[Carnival#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objectives''']].
*'''Server Room''' - A room that can generate in the '''Tent''' with server racks and shelves. Scrap can spawn here.
*'''Funhouse''' - The primary area of the interior with red and white walls and wooden floors. The majority of scrap spawns around the various rooms in cabinets, on tables, etc. It is connected to the '''Tent''' through a large doorway with two eyes and the shape of a mouth.
*'''Spinning Tunnel''' - A catwalk leading into a tunnel that is spinning.
*'''Crystal Ball''' - Rooms with large crystal balls on center tables or small crystal balls and smaller tables in grated areas. These rooms can generate without a crystal ball on them and commonly have scrap.
*'''Abyss''' - A long wooden walkway that borders on a massive, pitch black area with practically nothing in it. The [[Carnival#Traverse_the_Tightropes|'''Traverse the Tightropes''']] objective spawns here.
*'''Glass Maze''' - A maze of glass can spawn that leads to the '''Glass maze trophy''', the apparatus of the interior. It weighs 21lbs and is worth ▮80. If a player takes it off its pedestal, all apparatus related events will be triggered and the glass floor beneath will start cracking. Players must quickly run off it before it breaks and they fall into the pits that act as quicksand below.

== > Interior Features ==
=== Music ===
Ambient music can be heard playing around the interior. Different music can also play in the '''Spinning Tunnel''' and '''Crystal Ball''' rooms.
==== Carnival Ambience ====
[[File:CircusAmbience2.mp3]]
==== Magic Ambience ====
[[File:MagicBallLoop.mp3]]

=== Other Features ===
*'''Broken Door''' - Some doors fall to the ground after being opened.
*'''Varying Door Sizes''' - Some doors are large while other doors are small and require players to crouch through them.
*'''Rotating Room''' - A circular room that periodically spins around, disorientating players and changing where they need to enter or leave through.
*'''Tightropes''' - A narrow rope can sometimes connect two areas.

== > Hazards ==
*'''Boxing Glove''' - A boxing glove can pop out from the floor and punch through a doorway after a door is opened, dealing 100 damage to any player it hits. Depending on the direction players come from, there can be a raised area on the floor that indicates where the glove will pop up from and players can prepare to avoid it. This door will remain open for the rest of the day.
*'''Hammerbot''' - Small robots with glowing eyes can be found around the interior. Walking into their line of sight will cause them to beep and do an overhead slam with a comically large hammer. This hammer will deal 999 damage to all players it hits. The robot usually misses if a player is as close as possible to it due to the hammer's handle.
*'''Mouth Pit''' - An opening in the floor with a painting resembling an open mouth that players can fall into
*'''Death Pit''' - A pit with broken wood platforms for players to walk on to jump over them. Some tiles also have a black floor that gives the illusion of being a death pit while being safe.

== > Secondary Objectives ==
[[File:CarnivalTraverseButton.jpg|thumb|The Button Room that holds the reward and masks indicating the Traverse the Tightropes objective spawned.]]One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn after pressing the button in the '''Button Room'''. 

=== Pop the Balloons ===
If the '''Button Room''' has balloons in it, players must find and pop four balloons within the interior with a shovel or knife. After popping a balloon, a sound effect will play to indicate it was popped and [[Confetbees|'''Confetbees''']] will spawn. This is a variant of the Mask Hornets.

Once all four balloons are popped, players can return to and press the button in the '''Button Room''' for their reward.

=== Press the Nose ===
If the '''Button Room''' has cages in it, players must find a room in the interior with similar cages and a large clown face. Approaching the nose will prompt players to press it, switching the prompt to "Run" if pressed. Music will begin playing throughout the whole interior and all players must leave the interior within the next 40 seconds. When time is up, the interior will explode and deal multiple instances of 9,999 damage to all remaining players inside. This also disables the power for the rest of the day.

This explosion can be heard from the exterior and a sound effect will play afterward. Players can now press the button in the '''Button Room''' to receive their reward.

=== Traverse the Tightropes ===
If the '''Button Room''' has masks on the wall, players must make their way to the '''Abyss'''. Several wooden pillars, tightropes, and lights will now be in this area. Players must make their way through the maze to the other side and interact with a mask. A jetpack can also be used to get across.

After the mask is interacted with, a sound effect will be heard and players can now return to and press the button in the '''Button Room''' for their reward.

| Magnificent crystal ball || {{Item Preview|Magnificent crystal ball.png}} || No || 19 || 420 || 483 || 563
|}
</div>
The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Mechanics#Furniture_luck the vanilla luck system]. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. All of Carnival's '''Secondary Objectives''' are considered Medium difficulty and have a reward multiplier of 1.15x. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

== > Event: Colorless Spiral ==
[[File:CarnivalColorlessSpiral.jpg|thumb|The Colorless Spiral after activation.]]A small black and white room with a center pillar can randomly spawn somewhere in the '''Funhouse'''. If a player enters the room and walks to the other end of it, the room will abruptly start to spin upwards and trap them inside. It will also turn the lights on and begin playing music.

Once the room has spun fully upwards, [[Black and White Confetbees|'''Black and White Confetbees''']] will spawn. This is a variant of the Mask Hornets that players must avoid. While moving around this room can give the illusion of it spinning, it doesn't start spinning until later when the music gets faster and the room begins to spiral downwards. A second '''Black and White Confetbees''' will spawn when the spinning stops. The room will then shortly spin back upwards and a third '''Black and White Confetbees''' will spawn after it stops. Finally, the room will quickly spiral all the way back down to the ground floor and spawn the reward. The '''Black and White Confetbees''' will be in the interior for the rest of the day.

'''Black and White Confetbees''' struggle to catch up to players that are weightless and manage their stamina to sprint away in bursts, but will likely collide with players when the room spins them around violently. A general strategy to mitigate this is to move along the edge of the room and group up all the bees before quickly moving to the other side of the room past the center pillar once the room is about to spin. This helps in getting the bees closer to the center pillar to potentially get caught on it or slowed down by it once the spinning starts. Regardless of the strategy used, the event itself is rather forgiving due to the low 10 damage per hit from the bees and the bigger problem is often dealing with the bees in the interior for the rest of the day.

{{TOC left}}

The city named '''Centrus''' is one of the three major cities settled on the moon of [[Filitrios|'''Filitrios''']]. It represented the purity of the moon's economy and values displayed through grand buildings of unique architecture. Being nearly entirely made out of bright concrete. It was therefor known as The White City. But this once thriving city now holds a dark history.

== > Moon Map ==

== > Moon Info ==

{{Moon Info|Executed.|Cold, lush terrain with unstable structures.|A healthy avian ecosystem.|}}

== > Environment ==

== > Weather ==
Centrus supports Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, and Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Filitrios and Mysterious Altars ===
{{spoiler|If a '''Brooding seed''' was placed on the altar on the exterior of [[Filitrios|'''Filitrios''']], the terrain on the exterior will be dramatically altered, several tentacles will appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, the interior will be visually altered, and an [[Assimilated_Growth|'''Assimilated Growth''']] will almost immediately spawn in the interior when landing on '''Centrus''' in the future. This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of [[Etern|'''Etern''']], [[Fission-C|'''Fission-C''']], [[Gloom|'''Gloom''']], and [[Utril|'''Utril''']], in which case these changes become permanent on that save file.}}

= Introduction =
<big><big>'''Welcome!''' Welcome to city 17- sorry! wrong wiki. Welcome to '''Characters''' page! A page dedicated to all characters in this mod.<br>
The formula for this page is somewhat like this: First, there are the general statistics, then, the storyline of any given character is a summary of all of the logs and other scraps of lore present '''IN''' the mod, no fanon nor answers from Wesley from outside of the mod included.</big><br>
== Agent Geoffrey ==
<big>Full Name: Geoffrey Samuel Smith<br>
Occupation: High Commander and Agent of the Emperor<br>
Status: Deceased, killed either by a coil-head or infected with BIO-HXNV7 on Asteroid-13<br>
Marital Status: Married to Madeline Smith (<small>also deceased, blown up with Calist</small>)<br>
Children: more than one (all also blown up with Calist)<br>
Age: Middle-aged<br>
Voice Actor: Audio Knight, creator of Starlancer Moons<br>
Place of birth: Unknown<br>
Place of death: 57 Asteroid-13<br>
<small><small>'''Disclaimer:''' Geoffrey's storyline is presented backwards in the game, but I have flipped it here for the sake of logic!</small></small><br>
<big>Geoffrey's Storyline:</big><br>
We "first" hear of Agent Geoffrey in his first log on Calist, where he and the Council Of Rule (<small>aka God knows who, thanks for clarifying anything, Wesley, no, actually we know one member, Michael Dunton, more on him later.</small>), are 4 weeks into a debate about the usage of bio-weapons.<br>
The Council is very much against any use of the bio-weapons, and Geoffrey has been trying his best to convince them otherwise, despite knowing what atrocities can bio-weapons cause, because he is somewhat supposed to represent the Emperor after all.<br>
After finishing his first log, Geoffrey (<small>possibly</small>) writes a letter to his Wife, Madeline Smith, before leaving Calist and heading to Polarus for the final meeting with the Emperor.<br>
On Polarus, despite his best efforts to explain how the council is "very adamant about not allowing any bioweapons to be used or studied" to the Emperor, it was all in vain, as the Emperor ignored his reasoning, and instead, told Geoffrey to give the order for the Triton Military to nuke Calist.<br>
He gave the order, "in the name of the Emperor", knowing what this incident will bring about.<br>
After being assured that his family will get sent off to Trite (<small><small>Editor Zenny here, uhh, spoiler alert: {{spoiler|They went fucking nowhere and got blown up with Calist}}</small></small>), he ends his log, and heads off to March, where he is tasked with assembling a team to research the moon of Cosmocos, including Captain Donahue and more notably, at the time, Lieutenant Commander Cunningham.<br>

{{TOC left}}

Deep within the jungles of '''Chasm''' lie a cluster of large ravines. At the bottom of these ravines, caves and caverns of highly profitable resources. While mining corporations were desperate to get their hands on said resources. The working class was not quite as excited. The flora would not care what it caught. High value items remain inside.

== > Moon Map ==

== > Moon Info ==

{{Moon Info|Abandoned.|Warm. Moist, often hit by heavy rains.|Dominated by a few species.|}}

== > Environment ==

== > Weather ==
Chasm supports Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, and Forsaken weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
Chasm's exterior has a unique map hazard called a "Sinkmaw". It is an opening in the ground that will shut if a player falls into it and begin filling with acid. This acid deals 10 damage per hit and will eventually rise high enough to submerge the player, but drowning can be temporarily prevented by jumping. Approximately 20 instances of damage, or 200 damage total, will occur before the acid fully recedes and the Sinkmaw opens back up. A player stuck in a Sinkmaw can only escape through another player teleporting them or, likely unintended, using an extension ladder to clip through it.

######## Confetbees
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Confetbees
|images=
Confetbees.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Mask Hornets
|Internal ID= Confetbees
|Max Count= 1
|Power Level= 2
|Cause of Death= Stabbing
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= Unkillable
|Damage= 10
|Door Speed Multiplier= 0.08
|Stun Time Multiplier= 0.6
}}

The '''Confetbees''' are a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Mask_Hornets Mask Hornets] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. As the name implies, they look like small pieces of confetti in various colors.

== > Mechanics ==
Similiar to the Mask Hornets, the '''Confetbees''' roam around the interior until finding a player to chase. They will quickly deal 10 damage per hit to players on contact. They move rather slowly, being even slower than a player at walking speed in straightaways, and can be greatly hindered by doors.

== > Spawn Conditions ==
The '''Confetbeees''' are spawned in the same location as a balloon after it is popped for [[Carnival#Pop_The_Balloons|'''Pop the Balloons''']] objective in the '''Carnival'''. As such, a maximum of four '''Confetbees''' can be in the interior at any given time. These spawns do not contribute to the total Power Level, and the technical Max Count and Power Level of the '''Confetbees''' only matters if players modify spawn tables to spawn the '''Confetbees''' elsewhere.

== > Bestiary Entry ==
While the '''Confetbees''' do have a unique bestiary entry, they share the same terminal keyword, "confetbees", as the [[Black_and_White_Confetbees|'''Black and White Confetbees''']] and it will typically be redirect to that entry instead. However, there is little difference between the two entries.
