######## Contaminated Snare Flea
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Contaminated Snare Flea
|images=
Contaminated Snare Flea.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Snare Flea
|Internal ID= Contaminated<br>Centipede
|Max Count= 4
|Power Level= 1
|Cause of Death= Suffocation
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= 1
|Damage= 10
|Door Speed Multiplier= 0.23
|Stun Time Multiplier= 3
}}

The '''Contaminated Snare Flea''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Snare_Flea Snare Flea] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It looks identical to the Snare Flea as a large pink centipede, but it has a glowing green liquid all over its body.

== > Mechanics ==
Like the Snare Flea, the '''Contaminated Snare Flea''' will find a random location in the interior to attach itself to the ceiling and wait for a player to walk underneath them. If a player encounters the '''Contaminated Snare Flea''' before it attaches itself to the ceiling it may abruptly change direction and find a different spot nearby. There can also be instances where part of the '''Contaminated Snare Flea''' is visible on the floor because it is on the ceiling in the room below.

Whenever a player walks underneath the '''Contaminated Snare Flea''', it will fall from the ceiling and either land on the player's head or begin chasing them to try and attach itself to their head. It slowly deals 10 damage per hit to the player it is attached to, eventually killing them. In singleplayer, the player will instead be dropped to critical hp the first time the '''Contaminated Snare Flea''' attaches to them on a moon. The '''Contaminated Snare Flea''' can be removed from a player's head and killed by using a weapon, leaving the interior, or by teleporting the player.

== > Spawn Conditions ==
Five '''Contaminated Snare Fleas''' will almost immediately spawn in the interior upon landing if the [[Asten_Lab#Containment_Breach|'''Containment Breach Objective''']] is generated in '''Asten Lab'''. These five fleas generally all group up or are close by each other. These spawns do no contribute to total Power Level, and the Max Count and Power Level of the '''Contaminated Snare Flea''' only matter if players modify spawn tables to spawn the '''Contaminated Snare Flea''' elsewhere.

== > Bestiary Entry ==
The '''Contaminated Snare Flea''' shares the same entry as the Snare Flea. If players only scanned the '''Contaminated Snare Flea''' and wish to view the entry, they will likely need to enter "contaminatedsnareflea" as one word for the terminal to properly register and display it.

{{TOC left}}

A large mining facility built within the ashen hills of Core. Previously an active volcanic wasteland now cooled to manageable temperatures.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Core.png|650px|border|frameless]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|escaped|Warm, ash ridden environment with low volcanic activity.|Dominated by a few species.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather ==
Core can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside Ambience ===
On Core you can hear an ambience that plays inside the facility only.

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:Core inside loop.wav]]

=== Small Volcanoes ===
'''Core's exterior''' has small, '''active volcanoes''' that rapidly '''deal 18 damage per hit''' to a player stepping in them. These volcanoes randomly emit grey smoke particles as a warning for when they will soon erupt. During an eruption, hot rocks will be shot out randomly around the volcano that explode and deal 18 damage to nearby players.

'''Additionally''', the '''bottom of Core's exterior''' is covered in thick smoke that '''quickly deals 10 damage per hit''' to the player.

=== Major Story Spoilers: Decision Aftermath ===
{{spoiler|If players decided to overload and blow up [[ResearcherxB|'''ResearcherxB''']], debris from the ship can fall onto Core's exterior. If players land on Core in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and [[Infected Bunker Spider|'''Infected Bunker Spiders''']] will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.}}

== > Progression ==
=== Unlocked By ===
{{spoiler|Logging "Pedro's note 3" that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior of [[Dreck]]. At least one "Pedro's note 3" is guaranteed to spawn.}}

=== Unlocks ===
{{spoiler|[[Faith|<big>'''Faith:'''</big>]] Logging "My task 4" that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior. At least one "My task 4" is guaranteed to spawn.}}

######## Corpse Crawler
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Corpse Crawler
|images=

The '''Corpse Crawler''' is a relatively passive entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Spore_Lizard Spore Lizard]. It is an employee's corpse stuffed with machinery, being riddled with spikes protruding out of the employee's body. It additionally has four hydraulic legs, a mechanical spine, and a pale baby head with hollowed out eyes.

== > Mechanics ==
Similar to the Spore Lizard, the '''Corpse Crawler''' will simply wander around until noticing a player. Upon noticing a player, they will be frightened, may pulse the various spikes on their body outward to intimidate the player, and will attempt to path away from the player and break line of sight. When cornered, the '''Corpse Crawler''' will also attempt to bite players and deal 20 damage on contact.

Instead of releasing spores, the '''Corpse Crawler''' will vomit out a '''Gore Spike''' when it feels threatend. This action will deal 20 damage to nearby players. This '''Gore Spike''' acts as a hazard for the rest of the day, pulsing the metal spikes lodged in the gore outward roughly every 8 seconds and dealing 20 damage to nearby players.

== > Spawn Chances ==
The '''Corpse Crawler''' is injected into the '''Enemy Spawns (Interior)''' table of any moon experiencing [[Weathers#>_Hallowed|'''Hallowed''']] weather with a weight of 28, overriding the current weight if it is lower than that.

The '''Corpse Crawler''' also has a chance to spawn on many moons, most commonly spawning within the interior of [[Demetrica|'''Demetrica''']].

######## Cosmic Bracken
__NOTOC__

The '''Cosmic Bracken''', also referred to by its scan name as '''Bracken?''', is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Bracken Bracken] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. While its body structure is identical to the Bracken, it has blue leaves on its back, purple skin, and several white dots on its body. These white dots make the '''Cosmic Bracken's''' skin resemble a starry night sky, especially in the dark.

== > Mechanics ==
Similar to the Bracken, the '''Cosmic Bracken''' will silently stalk players and attempt to sneak up behind them to snap their neck with its hands. If a player spots the '''Cosmic Bracken''' within the middle of their screen, it will be startled, begin to move towards its chosen room, wait, and repeat the whole process. Staring at the '''Cosmic Bracken''' increases the likelihood of it attempting to chase and attack the closest employee, and directly attacking the '''Cosmic Bracken''' instantly triggers this.

Any player that comes into contact with the '''Cosmic Bracken''' will be killed and it will attempt to drag their corpse to its chosen room. While the '''Cosmic Bracken''' only has a a Max Count of 1, it is only found on moons where it can spawn in every table and so players can encounter up to two on the exterior.

On the exterior of [[Glimmer|'''Glimmer''']], the '''Cosmic Bracken''' moving through some of the flora will make it glow and release lights resembling fireflies just like it does when a player moves through it. While this is just a visual feature, it does make it easier to tell when a '''Cosmic Bracken''' may be sneaking up on a player.

== > Spawn Chances ==
The '''Cosmic Bracken''' has a 25.21%, 98.08%, and a 94.72% chance to spawn in the interior, on the exterior, and on the exterior during daytime respectively on [[Cosmocos|'''Cosmocos''']]. The '''Cosmic Bracken''' additionally has a 23.56%, 91.07%, and 75.32% chance to spawn in the interior, on the exterior, and on the exterior during daytime respectively on [[Glimmer|'''Glimmer''']].

== > Bestiary Entry ==
The '''Cosmic Bracken''' shares the same entry as the Bracken. If players have only scanned the '''Cosmic Bracken''' and wish to view the entry, they may need to type out "cosmicbracken" as one word into the terminal to avoid having the terminal try to route them to [[Cosmocos|'''Cosmocos''']].

It is a bipedal vertebrate with skin the color and texture of a red beat. The name was coined for what appear to be leaves protruding from its upper spine. The purpose of these is believed to be for intimidation, however not much is known about the specifics of bracken behaviour due to its illusiveness and low population.<br><br>We know a little from accounts by wildlife experts who have encountered it. is a lone hunter with high intelligence. {{TOC left}}

'''Cosmocos''' is the long lost moon. Home to one of the Vault Key Apparati and to the Celestial Brain.<br>

== > Moon Map ==
{{Maps|Cosmocos}}

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|???|???|???|<br><br>UNKNOWN ANOMALY DETECTED}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}
Cosmocos is dark and hard to traverse. The map changes throughout the day, as walls that were once present disappear later. There are plants that emit blue light to help guide you to the main entrance or fire exits.

== > Weather ==
Cosmocos can experience Foggy or Eclipsed weather by default.

If Cosmocos is Eclipsed, additional Watchers will spawn on the exterior.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==

=== Inside & Outside Ambience ===
On Cosmocos you can hear two diffrent ambiences. One plays outside while the other one plays inside.

==== Outside Ambience ====
[[File:Cosmocos outside loop.wav]]

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:Cosmocos inside loop.wav]]

=== Sound that play when the ship firsts lands ===
[[File:PlanetStart.ogg]]

=== Time Multiplier ===
The player's clock is hidden while on Cosmocos. However, time still progresses and Cosmocos has a day speed multiplier of 0.5, meaning the player can stay on the moon for significantly longer.

=== Cosmic Watchers ===
Cosmocos features unique map hazards called "Watchers". They look around the area they are facing toward and will deal minor damage to the player caught in their gaze.

=== Cosmic Apparatus ===
'''Cosmocos has a lone interior fire exit''' that leads to an exterior area '''filled with Watchers''', where the Celestial Brain and '''Cosmic Apparatus can be found'''. It is not possible to use a jetpack to reach or escape this area, as it is not part of the rest of the exterior and is surrounded by invisible walls. Removing this apparatus will anger all Watchers and cause them to look around faster. '''Additionally''', removing this apparatus will still trigger all apparatus related events, such as the flamethrowers in the [[Greenhouse]] or the falling ceiling and locked exit doors in the [[Grand Armory]].

|{{Story Log Text|At the behest of Captain Donahue, I am to record my own personal experiences here on Cosmocos.<br><br>I was first to stumble upon this strange extraterrestrial lifeform.<br>It seemed to be, upon first glance, perhaps a plant, or something akin to coral - something like Diploria.<br>But when I placed my hand upon it, even through my suit, I felt - I felt as if incredible knowledge was poured into me.<br>Knowledge of things vastly unfamiliar and unbelievably alien to me - but also of things familiar, things around me that others had been educated on, but I’d never had the opportunity to learn.<br>It was incredible, exhilarating.<br>Unlike anything I’ve ever experienced.<br><br>But the most exhilarating thing of all was this unusual connection I feel that I’ve fostered with this thing.<br>This being.<br>In a sense, it felt... like a person, is perhaps the best way to put it, in terms we are capable of understanding.<br>Like Cosmocos isn’t just a moon.<br>Like it’s... a huge, alien life-form, sitting here in space with its own incredible ecosystem.<br><br>Bizarre as it may be, I can say with confidence that I could feel what seemed to be a rush of emotions from Cosmocos itself.<br>I still feel it now, in truth.<br>Which sounds like insanity, doesn’t it? But it was beautiful.<br>Like a rush of warmth, kindness, generosity.<br>I really feel like Cosmocos wants to teach us things.<br>Like it wants to help us grow and nurture us.<br><br>The Captain has commanded that no one is to interact with this celestial brain aside from himself for our own safety.<br>I do feel slightly disheartened by this, as I was hoping to commune with it again.<br><br>I have so much more to say.<br>It’ll be difficult to record all of this knowledge I’ve been gifted with in a comprehensible format on these recorders, but I’ll do my best over the next few cycles.<br><br>Lieutenant Commander Cunningham, signing off.}}

######## Creaker
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Creaker
|images=
Creaker.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Nutcracker
|Internal ID= Creaker
|Max Count= 10
|Power Level= 1
|Cause of Death= Gunshots, Kicking
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= 5
|Damage= 20, 40, 100, or Instant Kill 
|Door Speed Multiplier= 2
|Stun Time Multiplier= 0.5
}}

The '''Creaker''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Nutcracker Nutcracker] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It resembles an older and worn down Nutcracker holding a blue shotgun and has a small orange eye surrounded by a membrane.

== > Mechanics ==
The '''Creaker''' behaves identical to the Nutcracker, having the same patrolling state, scanning state, attacking state, etc. The most notable differences are the sound effects played and the scrap dropped, being the '''Spooky shotgun''' and up to two '''Spooky ammo'''. These are functionally identical to the '''Shotgun''' and '''Ammo''' respectively, and the latter works for reloading any shotgun, but killing a '''Creaker''' is the only legitimate way to obtain either scrap.

== > Spawn Conditions ==
The '''Creaker''' is injected into the '''Enemy Spawns (Interior)''' table with a weight of 9 on any moon experiencing [[Weathers#>_Hallowed|'''Hallowed''']] weather. This makes the '''Creaker''' a fairly rare entity to encounter, as it can not spawn anywhere else naturally.

'''Crowd''' was one of the many moons housing mass livingspaces for the ever expanding population. This particular one was abandoned fairly early into the grand war. Ownership was transferred to the Trite Control Corporation.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Crowdtopdown.png|frameless|border|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Abandoned|Warm. Mildly foggy. Slightly sparse oxygen due to previous inhabitation.|Dominated by a few species.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather ==
Crowd can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.<br><br>When Crowd experiences Flooded weather, the insides of the houses on the exterior will be filled with water immediately upon landing. The rest of the exterior will flood as normal.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Trial: Teach the Disloyal ===
This moon features a trial that generates with the [[Spooky Manor]] interior. Completing it rewards the player with scrap worth a total of at least ▮400. '''The specific rewards''' are {{spoiler|the scrap "Diamond filled liver" and "Teach the disloyal ticket". }}

<big>'''To complete this trial:'''</big>

#{{spoiler|Find three radios within the interior and interact with them to switch their channel.}}
#{{spoiler|Find the pool room with an employee in it within the interior, interact with the red button in this room, and grab the gas canister revealed underneath the red button shortly afterward.}}
#{{spoiler|Find the garage within the interior and use the gasoline to fuel the generator next to the car.}}
#{{spoiler|Return to the pool room, interact with the red button again, and wait for the employee to die. The reward spawns below the dead employee.}}

=== Major Story Spoilers: Decision Aftermath ===
{{spoiler|If players decided to overload and blow up [[ResearcherxB|'''ResearcherxB''']], debris from the ship can fall onto Crowd's exterior. If players land on Crowd in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and [[Infected Bunker Spider|'''Infected Bunker Spiders''']] will spawn at the start of the day.}}

== > Progression ==
=== Unlocked By ===
{{spoiler|Inserting the "Teach the disloyal" videotape that is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop on [[Galetry]] or randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of [[Calist]], [[Filitrios]], [[Motra]], or [[Trite]] into the projector in [[Galetry]].}}

=== Unlocks ===
{{spoiler|[[Narcotic|<big>'''Narcotic:'''</big>]] "Medicate the unwell" videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.}}

'''Cubatres''' is one with strange shapes and even stranger occurrences. Volatile materials are scattered across the landscapes and gathered to create the most outlandish machines. One of which being the renowned apparatus.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Cubatres (v6).png|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Vanished.|Cold, Rocky Terrain, highly volatile crystals present.|A destroyed ecosystem.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather ==
Cubatres can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside & Outside Ambience ===
On Cubatres you can hear two diffrent ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

==== Outside Ambience ====
[[File:CubatresOutsideLoop.wav]]

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:CubatresInsideLoop.wav]]

=== Crystaline Cubes ===
The highly volatile crystals mentioned are map hazards called '''"Cube"''' found on the exterior and within the interior. '''On the exterior''', one can be seen to the right behind the ship and another can be seen to the left behind the ship. '''At 11:00AM''', a blinding white light will be seen and the cube to the right will begin floating. It will then pulse out energy, move to a different, specific location, and repeat the pattern for the rest of the day. The other cube becomes active '''at 04:00PM''' and acts the same way. Any player within the energy pulse '''will rapidly take 40 damage per hit''' and likely die.<br><br>'''In the interior''', any cube has a random chance to activate (seemingly up to a maximum of four) and pulse out energy at set intervals. Any player within the energy pulse '''will rapidly take 10 damage per hit'''.<br><br>'''Additionally''', the scrap '''"Crystal cube" can be found on the exterior'''. From the front of the ship, wrap around the left wall until reaching one of the cubes. Then, hug the right wall until reaching various petrified entities surrounding the scrap. This is also the location of one of the fire exits. {{spoiler | This scrap is required to access the hidden chamber on the exterior of [[Berunah]].}}

{{spoiler|Interacting with the map found on the exterior of [[Utril]].}}

This moon does not unlock any other moons.

######## Decrepit Store
[[File:StoreMain2.jpg|thumb|The main entrance of the Decrepit Store.]]
The '''Decrepit Store''', also referred to as Store, is a custom interior. It only spawns on Facto, a.k.a., the Crocs inspired Lethal Company experience, by default, which is a moon that must be downloaded separately from the rest of "Wesley's Moons". After "Obscurity" update came out, this interior was removed from "Wesley's Interiors". Now you can only download its [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/Magic_Wesley/Decrepit_Store/ standalone version on ThunderStore].

== > Rooms ==
*'''Secured Area ''' - Rooms with many wooden crates stacked on top of each other that generate behind security doors. The majority of scrap is condensed to spawning in these rooms.
*'''Display Rooms''' - Rooms with a white tiled floor and many display pedestals. Scrap can generate on these pedestals.
*'''Old Storage Area''' - A large part of the interior will generate as a far more run-down area with a wooden tile, various stacked crates, boxes, and miscellaneous items, and more worn down mannequins. The apparatus room tends to generate in this area.
*'''Apparatus Room''' - Similar to the storage areas, this is a room with several stacked wooden crates. Several mannequins are lined up in front of the boxes on either side and surrounding the apparatus.

== > Hazards ==
*'''Mannequins''' - When the apparatus is pulled, one mannequin in the interior will activate and spawn one of three unique entities: Mannequin, Broken Mannequin, or Headless Mannequin. All three are a silent variant of the Coil-Head.

######## Deep Sewers
[[File:DeepSewersMainEntrance.jpg|thumb|The main entrance of the Deep Sewers.]]
The '''Deep Sewers''' is a sewers themed interior that most commonly spawns on [[Narcotic]]. This interior can be claustrophobic and maze-like due to its long, narrow hallways and corridors that connect to each other.

== > Rooms ==
*'''Brick Maze''' - Corridors with sludge and waste that make up a large portion of the sewers. Scrap can generate in the areas with light and platforms, including the main entrance.
*'''Valve Gate''' - A large valve connected to a gate that typically spawns close to the main entrance and always in part of the '''Brick Maze'''. Players can open this gate after completing a [[Deep_Sewers#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objective]].
*'''Concrete Brick Maze''' - The other large portion of the sewers that frequently connects to loot rooms.
*'''Large Tunnel''' - A large tunnel with various branching pathways that can connect to various parts of the interior.
*'''Storage''' - A small room that generates with various objects, such as buttons on the right wall, shelving units, tools hanging on the left wall, etc. Scrap often spawns in these rooms.
*'''Locker Storage''' - A room with a set of lockers that has a door leading into another room partially submerged in waste. Scrap often spawns in these lockers or in the partially submerged room.
*'''Roof Grate''' - A small room with a sewer grate in the middle of the roof. The '''Snatcher''' can be heard and encountered here and scrap can occasionally generate here.
*'''Long Pipe''' - An absurdly long pipe can generate that often connects to another part of the interior.

== > Interior Features == 
*'''Graffiti''' - Graffiti can be found on various walls in the sewers. Most of it is flavor text, but some of the graffiti hints at the existence of the '''Treasure Room''' and the '''Snatcher'''.
*'''Snatcher''' - The Snatcher is a large creature that appears to be made up of waste with multiple eyes and limbs. The player can encounter it or its arms dangling through sewer grates at various points in the interior, but all of these encounters are auditory or visual.
*The liquid present in the sewers depends on the moon the interior spawns on.

== > Hazards ==
*[[Snatcher|'''Snatcher (Entity)''']] - At 05:00pm, there is a 50% chance for the '''Snatcher''' to spawn within the interior. It will roar and be heard by any players in the interior if it spawns. It is a variant of the Thumper with 8hp.

== > Treasure Room ==
[[File:DeepSewersTreasureRoom3.jpg|thumb|The treasure room at the bottom of the staircase.]]
The treasure room serves as the apparatus room for the interior and is its most prominent feature, although it does not have a guaranteed chance to spawn. It is a large room with many wooden platforms stacked to the left, where scrap can spawn, and a guaranteed key spawn and interactable wheel to the right. It also has a staircase submerged in toxic waste that rapidly deals 2 damage per hit to the player or 18 damage per hit to the player if they are near the bottom. At the bottom of the staircase there is a door, which can be locked, that opens to a room with many gold bars alongside cash registers, golden cups, pill bottles, and wedding rings. Other scrap can spawn in this room, though it is unlikely.
<br><br>
Turning the wheel temporarily begins to drain the toxic waste and allows for safe travel to the bottom, taking about 12 seconds from turning the wheel to fully drain. After about another 45 seconds, the sound of rushing water will be heard and the waste will begin to rise again. Once the waste has returned to its original position, the lights will begin flickering and the power will go out with a radiation warning shortly afterward.
<br><br>
If a player simply runs straight down and up the stairs with no strategy, tools, or additional modifications, it is possible retrieve up to three pill bottles and one cash register/gold bar while taking a little damage from the rising waste. Alternatively, the player can safely retrieve four cups/rings. This totals to an average of ▮204-264 depending on what scrap is taken.
<br><br>
Dropping off the staircase railings can be used as shortcuts to save a tremendous amount of time during the descent. When looking at the wheel, turn around and run towards the wall and railing, jump onto the railing, and fall onto the first outer railing below. From here, look at and push up against the wall, walk or jump off to the right while remaining as close to the railing as possible, and immediately begin moving left to land onto the second outer railing. This can be repeated to reach the third outer railing, or the player can fall straight from the first to the third outer railing, and places the player at the staircase leading to the door. The second and third falls are risky, however, as missing will usually result in death. This increases the total average to ▮268-368 depending on what scrap the player grabs and what risks they're willing to take, with the most feasible maximum being two pill bottles and two gold bars.
<br><br>
The player can also continuously drop and pick up a cash register while moving backwards to increase speed and decrease stamina usage overall. If executed correctly with the above shortcuts, a player can sacrifice most of their hp to retrieve two rings/cups, a gold bar, and a cash register for an average of ▮402. Since this requires an immense out of effort with little room for error, it is generally recommended to stick to safer and more consistent options.
<br><br>
Although a TZP-inhalant can be useful, it usually isn't worth the price as it can not be reused. An extension ladder usually gets stuck, but can create a platform to jump to the third outer railing with less risk. A jetpack can be used to safely make two trips for six gold bars, totaling to an average of ▮936, but can be cumbersome or risky to carry into the interior and it will likely take a bit of practice for players unfamiliar with using one.

== > Secondary Objectives ==
[[File:DeepSewersValveDoor.jpg|thumb|The Valve Gate that has the reward room behind it.]]One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn in the room behind the '''Valve Gate'''.

=== Fix the Flow Machines ===
If the graffiti on the wall by the '''Valve Gate''' mentions flow machines, players must find three flow machines in the interior. Players must repeatedly interact with the yellow valve and then push or pull the left and right levers to the respective left and right number position. The bottom lever position is 0 and the top lever position is 10. The lever moves up or down by 1 with each interaction. A sound effect will play after a flow machine is successfully fixed.

Once all three flow machines have been turned on, a sound effect will play and players can return to and open the '''Valve Gate''' to enter the room and get their reward.

=== Restart the Power ===
If the graffiti on the wall next to the '''Valve Gate''' mentions the power box exploding, players must find two power boxes with several knobs in the interior. Players must turn each knob to the correct position indicated by a unique click sound when a player turns it to that position. These power boxes also have a written warning that faulty knobs, indicated by sparks coming out of the knob when turning it, must always be pointed upward. Trying to activate the power by pressing the red button and having a knob in an incorrect position will cause players to take 40 damage.

Once both power boxes are turned back on, a sound effect will play and players can return to and open the '''Valve Gate''' to enter the room and get their reward.

=== Traverse the Sludge Tunnel ===
If the graffiti on the wall next to the '''Valve Gate''' mentions a sludge tunnel, players must go to the sludge tunnel in the '''Concrete Brick Maze''' with a yellow pipe leading to it. Inside will be an underwater maze and they must interact with several yellow valves to open the full path to a bigger valve at the end of the yellow pipe. The lights lead the way to the valves or the gates that valves open. Players must also return to the entrance of the '''Sludge Tunnel''' to avoid drowning with each trip.

Once the last valve has been interacted with, a sound effect will play and players can return to and open the '''Valve Gate''' to enter the room and get their reward.

The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Mechanics#Furniture_luck the vanilla luck system]. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. '''Traverse the Sludge Tunnel''' is considered Easy difficulty and has a 1.0x multiplier. '''Fix the Flow Machines''' and '''Restart the Power''' are considered Hard difficulty and have a 1.4x multiplier. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

== > Event: Deep Maintenance Elevator ==
[[File:DeepSewersElevator.jpg|thumb|An angled view of the Deep Maintenance Elevator.]]The '''Deep Maintenance Elevator''' can randomly generate in the interior. It is a small, rectangular platform suspended above sewage.

As soon as a player stands on the elevator, both the sewage below it and the elevator itself will begin to descend. The '''Snatcher''' will appear and spray sewage onto the platform, causing it to become slippery. The '''Snatcher''' will then attempt to either hit players on the edges of the elevator, dealing 50 damage on contact, or attempt to knock players off the elevator by spitting streams of sludge at them that pushes them backwards. If players do fall off the elevator, they will likely die to fall damage or drown.

Players should try to make their movements small and precise to avoid gaining too much speed and sliding around uncontrollably. If the '''Snatcher''' is going to hit players with its spit, they can position themselves to get pushed into the columns or objects at the corners of the arena. A jetpack completely trivializes this event, as players can just activate their jetpack if they begin to fall off the elevator. An extension ladder can be used to some degree as well, but is often too finnicky to be of much use.

Eventually, the elevator will descend to a slightly open pipe and the '''Snatcher''' will disappear. Inside this pipe will be the '''Snatcher skullplate''', which is the reward for the event. It is conductive, is two-handed, weighs 13lbs, and is worth ▮192 to ▮227. Players must collect the reward quickly before the elevator begins to rise back up without them on it.

The Domes of '''Demetrica''' are places of safe harbour where one can wait out the war. Near the edge of the region, far away from conflict they promise to keep the population secure. Billions of people went. You will find them inside.  

== > Moon Map ==
{{Maps|Demetrica}}

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Living happily.|Warm, lush terrain, very diverse oceanic flora.|A healthy ecosystem.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}
'''Demetrica''' environment

== > Weather ==
Demetrica can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, or Forsaken weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Bloody Appararus ===
Demetrica has a unique '''Bloody Apparatus''' that spawns on the exterior. It is in a room that is directly behind the ship when the door opens and it is on top of a platform that requires a jetpack, extension ladder, or the company cruiser (not recommended) to reach. '''Removing this apparatus triggers all apparatus related events'''.<br><br>Entering this room will trap the player inside and '''activate two walls with skulls on them'''. These walls move around the room in straight lines counter-clockwise and briefly stop to turn corners. To escape, there is a door on the other side of the room that has a panel to the right with multiple switches. Flicking a switch will also flick every adjacent switch and players must turn on all the switches, indicated by the switch being down and lit green, to open the door.<br><br>'''The walls remain active for the rest of the day'''. If a player escapes the room through the door, both sides of the room will open and the room will be accessible for the rest of the day. If no player escapes the room through the door after triggering the trap, it will remain inaccessible for the rest of the day.

A desert moon previously used for mining operations. Ownership was transferred to the Trite Control Corporation.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Descenttopdown.png|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Abandoned|Warm, sandy terrain. Commonly hit with sandstorms.|Dominated by a few species.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather ==
Descent can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Trial: Incinarate The Lies ===
This moon features a '''trial that generates with the Expanded Mineshaft interior'''. Completing it rewards the player with scrap worth a total of at least ▮400. '''The specific rewards''' are {{spoiler | the scrap "Charred diamond" and "Incinerate the lies ticket".}}

<big>To complete this trial:</big>

#{{spoiler|Find the room with the employee in it within the interior. This room is generally near the main entrance elevator.}}
#{{spoiler|Find and insert eight false articles into the shredder in front of the employee. They spawn on the smaller shelving units within the interior.}}
#{{spoiler|Press the red button in this room, wait for three symbols to appear on the screens above the employee, and remember the symbols.}}
#{{spoiler|Find a room in the interior with multiple pipes with symbols on them and interactable valves.}}
#{{spoiler|Turn the three valves on the pipes that have the same symbols as the ones shown previously. Turning the wrong valve will cause the player to die via blast if in close proximity, but there is a delay before the blast that allows a player to run away unscathed.}}
#{{spoiler|Return to the room with the employee in it and press the red button again.}}
#{{spoiler|Interact with the red valve at the end of the room when prompted and wait. The door the employee was slid into will open and reveal the rewards afterward.}}

{{TOC left}}

Not much is known about this asteroid, nobody has dared to visit it since its sudden appearance. Hence it has not been properly named, all we know is that it's a very dangerous place. A place completely desolate of life. For its name is: '''Desolation'''.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:DesolationTopView.jpg|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Left/Deceased.|Dead, desolate landscape, no healthy flora present.|A dying ecosystem, remaining fauna display agressive behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather ==
Desolation can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Dead Trees & Giant Watchers ===
'''Desolation's exterior''' has multiple '''dead trees''' that can be '''pushed''' down to create '''bridges'''. '''Additionally''', multiple giant watchers rise throughout the day and look around an area in a set pattern. Any player that is within the red light of the giant watcher's gaze will rapidly take 9 damage per hit, even if the player is behind something.

=== Dying Cosmic Growth ===
'''Desolation's interior''' has stalks of '''dying cosmic growth''' that act as obstructions. '''Additionally''', mounds of dying cosmic growth fall slowly through the ceiling and through the floor randomly throughout the day. These can block off pathways or doors for significant periods of time, as well as trap and quickly suffocate any player that gets caught underneath one.

{{spoiler|[[Utril|<big>'''Utril:'''</big>]] Utril videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.}}

== > Lore ==
Desolation was originally part of [[Cosmocos]] and housed a secondary facility there. When Cosmocos began its teleportation, it split off this segment to protect itself from any surviving personnel in the secondary facility.

=== Harrington's Logs ===
'''Harrington's Logs''' can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior. They follow the story of Professor Harrington, a scientist who was researching Cosmocos and its "Cosmic Growth" in this secondary facility and experienced its teleportation.

==== Harrington's Log 1 ====

Then we can offically start studdying on this side of the moon.<br>Which is splendid because have made a recent discovery...<br>This weird stuff..<br>Some sort of fungi perhaps?<br><br>I am not entirely sure what this is just yet but it has a.. regenerative ability.. at speeds unlike anything we have seen before.<br><br>We discovered this when we used a metal pipe to carefully stab a hole into it.<br>Anwyays.<br>I should wrap this up now, I'll record another log once we've got something.<br><br>Professor Harrington, over and out.}}

######## Dirty Disturbed Masked
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Dirty Disturbed Masked
|images=
Dirty Disturbed Masked.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Masked
|Internal ID= DirtyDisturbedMasked<br>PlayerEnemy
|Max Count= 10
|Power Level= 1
|Cause of Death= Strangulation
|Is Body Recoverable?= No

|Health= 4
|Damage= Instant Kill
|Door Speed Multiplier= 2
|Stun Time Multiplier= 0.75
}}

The '''Dirty Disturbed Masked''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Masked Masked] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is an employee with a '''Dirty disturbed''' mask attached to their face.

== > Mechanics ==
Identical to a regular Masked, the '''Dirty Disturbed Masked''' will roam around in search of players. It looks similar to a normal player on the radar but will often be seen spinning around. It will look around, sprint, and stop sprinting randomly. If no player is within the interior, it will try to reach the main entrance and exit onto the exterior and vice versa. It will also make its way to the ship after some time to hide and wait for players to return to ambush them.

If a '''Dirty Disturbed Masked''' spots a player, it will pause before beginning to chase them. If a player comes into contact with it, they'll be grabbed and the '''Dirty Disturbed Masked''' will try to convert them. This can be interrupted if the '''Dirty Disturbed Masked''' is hit. Otherwise, the player will die, their body and any scrap they were holding can not be recovered, and a second '''Dirty Disturbed Masked''' will spawn.

== > Spawn Conditions ==
An initial '''Dirty Disturbed Masked''' will only be spawned if a player wears and randomly gets possessed by the '''Dirty disturbed''' scrap that is a potential [[Toy_Store#Rewards|'''Secondary Objective Reward''']] from the '''Toy Store'''.

######## Dormant

{{TOC left}}

The moon now called '''Dormant''' is a desolate wasteland after having taken its part in the Grand War. While a majority has been fully destroyed, flukes in the heavy weaponry have spared this place from total destruction. A large amount of MK2 Core Heaters were used to wipe the moon off the maps. A similar, older model from those used to cause the Silent Flash. Due to the failure in technology, many of these bombs either detonated in orbit or lodged themselves firmly into the ground without detonating at all. Yet due to their unstable nature could not be retrieved. They now lie there, dormant.

== > Moon Map ==

== > Moon Info ==

{{Moon Info|Abandoned.|Warm, dry, toxic terrain, highly irradiated flora.|An irradiated, dying ecosystem.


Critical level explosive device detected.|}}

== > Environment ==
'''Dormant''' is an arid, dry, and rocky moon. While the trees and most other flora are dead, signs of life can still be found in small patches of greenery on more sandy areas. Ponds of green, toxic waste can also be found around the moon.

Its most prominent landmarker is the dormant, colossal explosive behind the ship lodged into the ground. Three concrete buildings and structures as well as metal fencing can be found around the moon as well. The larger building behind and west of the ship is the main entrance and the other two structures found northwest and east of the ship are both fire exits.

=== Exterior Ambience ===
[[File:Etern outside loop.wav]]

=== Interior Ambience ===
[[File:Fission inside loop.wav]]

== > Weather ==
'''Dormant''' supports Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Forsaken, and Hurricane weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== The Bomb ===
'''Dormant''' naturally generates mines on its exterior, which can deal 30 damage to players or instantly kill nearby players and most entities depending on proximity to the blast. If any player causes a mine to detonate, it will destabilize the '''Unstable core-heater''', i.e., the bomb. If five mines are detonated, the bomb will explode and instantly kill all players.

=== Interior Fire Exit ===
A lone fire exit can be found in the interior that leads to an area with dense foliage and many mines on the exterior. A '''Floppy disc machine''' can be found on the other side of this area. It is recommended to bring tools like a Jetpack or TZP-Inhalant to make crossing the area less risky. Players can not access this area from the exterior normally, as there is a damage trigger on the roof of the area that deals 999 damage to players that pass through it.

{{TOC left}}

The salt fields of Dreck were most popular for prison mining camps. 
The working conditions were harsh, nowhere near as harsh as those on [[Core]] however. 
Though despite the enforcement of the military, one of the quarries was overtaken by its prisoners.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:DreckMap.png|frameless|border|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Transferred|Cold, large salt plains, many quarries were built here.|Dominated by a few species.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather ==
Dreck can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Dangerous Tunnels ===
'''Dreck's exterior''' has '''multiple tunnels that can collapse''' throughout the day when a player walks through them. Any player that gets caught in the collapse '''will be crushed to death''' and any collapsed tunnel will be inaccessible for the rest of the day.

=== Gas Leaks ===
'''Dreck's interior''' has a unique map hazard called a '''"Gas leak"'''. These are pipes that randomly leak out gas, similar to steam valves, which '''shortly ignites into a blast of fire'''. Any player within the fire '''will rapidly take 12 damage per hit'''.

######## Droop
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Droop

The '''Droop''' is a hostile entity and a variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Barber Barber] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is a tall, slender, and humanoid looking creature with pitch black skin. It has two glowing white eyes and a wide open mouth that emits a light below it. It will shrink itself down to fit into tighter spaces, such as moving around in the interior.

== > Mechanics ==
Unlike the Barber, the '''Droop''' is always visible. The '''Droop''' also does not increase or does not increase at a noticeable speed as time progresses.

Otherwise, the '''Droop''' behaves similarly to the Barber, making an audible buildup noise before stepping (teleporting) to a random location within a set distance. If a player enters its line of sight, it will attempt to move towards them. Any player that walks in-between the hands of a '''Droop''' will be temporarily blinded and take 100 damage. This is an important distinction from the Barber's instant kill, as it allows players to survive a hit from the '''Droop''' by overcapping their health with a '''Health-stim'''.

== > Spawn Chances ==
The '''Droop''' has a 51.95% chance to spawn in the interior and a 91.67% chance to spawn on the exterior of [[Xenphir|'''Xenphir''']], exclusively spawning on this moon.

######## Duck
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title= Duck
|images=
Duck.jpg:In-Game

|Is Body Recoverable?= No

|Health= Unkillable
|Damage= Instant Kill
|Door Speed Multiplier= Can't Open Doors
|Stun Time Multiplier= Immune
}}

The '''Duck''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Red_Pill Red Pill], an unused vanilla entity, added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is literally just a large a rubber ducky.

== > Mechanics ==
The '''Duck''' always knows where players are and will attempt to move towards the closest player regardless of location. For example, if a player is in the interior and the '''Duck''' is on the exterior, it will still attempt to path as close as it can to the player in the interior. This makes the '''Duck''' behave similarly to a permanently active Jester, but its movement is similar to that of a Thumper, rapidly accelerating while moving and having to slow down to make turns.

The '''Duck''' is technically killable and stunnable, but lacks an actual hitbox and is completely invulnerable in-game. Likewise the '''Duck''' technically has a Door Speed Multiplier of 1, but is incapable of opening doors in-game. Any player that comes into contact with the middle of the '''Duck''' will violently explode into chunks and their body can not be recovered.

== > Spawn Chances ==
The '''Duck''' has a 33.33% chance to spawn in the interior, on the exterior, and on the exterior during daytime on [[Duckstroid-14|'''Duckstroid-14''']], exclusively spawning on this moon.

== > Weather ==
Duckstroid-14 can experience Rainy, Stormy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Baduck ===
'''Duckstroid-14''' features a unique entity called a [[Baduck|'''Baduck''']]. It is a '''smaller variant of the Baboon Hawk with 2hp'''.

=== Duck ===
'''Duckstroid-14''' features another unique entity called the [[Duck|'''Duck''']]. It is a variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Red_Pill Red Pill], which is an unused vanilla entity. The '''Duck''' always knows where players are and will move towards them. For example, the '''Duck''' on the exterior will still attempt to move towards players in the interior if no player is on the exterior. Any player that comes into contact with the middle of the '''Duck''' will die. While the '''Duck''' is technically killable and stunnable, it lacks an actual hitbox and is completely invulnerable in-game. The '''Duck''' can not open doors.

=== Traitorous Fire Exit ===
Duckstroid-14 has a lone fire exit that leads to the back of the giant duck, '''dropping the player into space''' and killing them.

{{TOC left}}

'''Dune''' is a large moon mainly consistent of expansive stretches of desert with a few oceans in between. It used to be a popular place for lavish mansions and buildings for those who could afford such luxuries. However due to frequent incidents with Earth leviathans, cacti infestations and large sandstorms, most of these locations have been left abandoned.

== > Moon Map ==

== > Moon Info ==

{{Moon Info|Abandoned.|Hot, dry terrain, large deserts.|A simple ecosystem, dominated by earth leviathans.|}}

== > Environment ==
'''Dune''' is largely a dry and somewhat hilly desert. Most of its flora is cacti and bushes, and a small oasis can be found to the right and south of the ship. There is a ravine in front of and to the left of the ship with two bridges to cross over it to a large building, which is the main entrance.

'''Dune''' has three smaller concrete buildings around the exterior as well, which are the fire exits. The first is to the right and east after crossing the upper bridge, the second is to the right and south of the ship near a fence and the oasis, and the third is almost directly behind and to the west of the ship.

=== Exterior Ambience ===
[[File:Etern outside loop.wav]]

== > Weather ==
'''Dune''' supports Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default. A waterfall can be seen to the left of the lower bridge during Rainy or Stormy weather.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==

If players land on '''Dune''' in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and two [[Infected Bunker Spider|'''Infected Bunker Spiders''']] will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.}}

######## Elder
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Elder
|images=
Elder.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Forest Keeper
|Internal ID= Elder
|Max Count= 1
|Power Level= 3
|Cause of Death= Crushing, Gravity
|Is Body Recoverable?= No (Crushing), Yes (Gravity)

|Health= 80
|Damage= Instant Kill
|Door Speed Multiplier= 1
|Stun Time Multiplier= 1.2
}}

The '''Elder''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Forest_Keeper Forest Keeper] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is a colossal humanoid figure with spikes jutting out of its body, skin resembling old tree bark, an open hole on its chest that is its mouth, and two eyes with a red layer around them.

== > Mechanics ==
Similar to the Forest Keeper, the '''Elder''' will roam around until spotting players, raising its suspicion meter. The distance from the '''Elder''', being uncrouched, moving, and sprinting all can increase the rate at which the '''Elder''' becomes suspicious. Once its suspicion meter has risen high enough for that specific player, it will begin chasing them until line of sight is broken for more than 3 seconds or the player dies. It will then search around the area it last saw the player for 9 seconds before beginning to roam around again.

If the '''Elder''' grabs a player by coming into contact with them and successfully eats them, they will die and both their body and any items they were holding can not be recovered. If the '''Elder''' dies, its body will fall backwards and crush any player underneath it. 

== > Spawn Chance ==
The '''Elder''' exclusively spawns on [[Roart|'''Roart''']], having a 73.53% chance to spawn on the exterior during daytime.

== > Bestiary Entry ==
While the entry for the '''Elder''' is called "Forest Elder", players must type it as one word or type a minimum of "foreste" to not be redirected to the entry for the Forest Keeper.

The Elders are a nearly extinct subspecies which are able to grow nearly twice as tall as the Forest Keepers due to their living conditions. However it is also because of their preferred environment that they never seek to leave the dense jungles which have become increasingly rarer.<br>The Forest Elder shares a striking resemblance with its smaller counterpart. The main difference being a slightly whiter appearance and their eyes having a red protective layer against attacks from avian wildlife.<br><br>It has been known that some tribes take the Elders as higher beings, believing they are men chosen by gods who have transformed to become the protectors of the woods they live in.<br><br>Due to the striking similarity to the Forest keeper, read the data entry about the Forest keeper for more information on the Elder’s visual and physical evolution.}}

######## Emma
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Emma
|images=
Emma.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Ghost Girl
|Internal ID= HangedGirlEnemy
|Max Count= 1
|Power Level= 2
|Cause of Death= Unknown
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= Unkillable
|Damage= Instant Kill
|Door Speed Multiplier= Irrelevant
|Stun Time Multiplier= Immune
}}

'''Emma''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Ghost_Girl Ghost Girl] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. This entity is not to be confused with the other appearances of '''Emma''' during [[Weathers#>_Forsaken| '''Forsaken''']] weather or {{spoiler| the unique trial found on the exterior of [[Roart|'''Roart''']]}}. She is a young girl with a white dress, pale grey skin, long black hair, hollowed out eyes, and a noose around her neck.

== > Mechanics ==
There is little to no difference between the Ghost Girl and '''Emma'''. She will appear behind her targeted player always accompanied by the sound of her hanging, muffling the player's audio if they look at her. After her targeted player has looked at her at least twice or ignored her at least three times, approaching, looking, or staring at her can cause her to begin chasing that player. She will decapitate and instantly kill that player on contact.

There can be confusion on which '''Emma''' is the real entity versus the harmless and spooky jumpscares she does during [[Weathers#>_Forsaken| '''Forsaken''']] weather. However, players can always tell if she's the real entity depending on if she appears behind them, if their audio is muffled while looking at her, if only one player sees her at that time, and if this encounter happens later in the day. She can also still be cheesed by phasing into and crouching on top of the cupboard in the ship.

== > Spawn Condition ==
'''Emma''' will spawn at exactly 02:00pm on a moon during [[Weathers#>_Forsaken| '''Forsaken''']] weather. This spawn does not contribute to total Power Level. 

== > Bury the Child Videotape ==
While '''Emma''' does not have a bestiary or journal entry, this videotape does provide a little context on who she is. It is randomly available for purchase in the Gift Shop on [[Galetry|'''Galetry''']] and {{spoiler|is only supposed to unlock [[Roart|'''Roart''']] during Halloween season.}}

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Killed.|Hot, deserts, frequent sandstorms.|A barren ecosystem.|<br><br>Home of the Emperor}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}
'''Empra''' is a dune with a dust storm with the city of '''Empra'''

== > Weather conditions ==
Empra can experience Rainy, Stormy, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Time Multiplier ===
Empra has a default day speed multiplier of 0.5, meaning the player can stay on the moon for significantly longer.

=== Gilded Jester ===
The [[Gilded_Jester|'''Gilded Jester''']] is an entity that exclusively can spawn in the interior of '''Empra'''. It is a variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Jester Jester] with a faster roaming speed, a significantly longer countdown before it begins cranking, and a significantly reduced cranking duration.

=== Destiny Item For {{Spoiler|Ending 2}} ===
'''Empra has a big cart with a lever''' that makes it go back and forth on the tracks. Scrap and items can travel back and forth on the cart. '''Inserting an apparatus''' into the center of the cart causes it to '''move faster'''.

<big>The following contains spoilers for completion.</big>

{{spoiler|An apparatus must be inserted into the center of the cart. It is recommended to bring one beforehand due to how dangerous the interior of Empra can be.<br><br>On the front end of the cart you can place the "Huge harold" (Atomic bomb) scrap that has at least one guaranteed spawn in the interior. Near the main entrance there is a mortar that needs to be interacted with to aim at the massive seed of assimilation in front of the main entrance. A lone fire exit can be found within the interior that leads to a control panel and this area is also accessible via jetpack. Interact with the control panel as prompted to fire the mortar and destroy the seed. This will anger the Overseer and cause him to unleash many tendrils around the exterior, and touching them will kill the player.<br><br> Interact with the control panel again as prompted to move the cranes and lift up the tracks, which also pushes the cart back. Run to the cart and ride it back to the ship. Pull the cart lever again and you will be warned to jump off the cart immediately. The cart will then be rocketed into the Overseer and detonate the atomic bomb, killing him.<br><br>After a cutscene, the destiny item "Chunk of harold" will spawn behind the ship. This allows the player to achieve Ending 2.}}

How many times would it take for them to remember I can’t hear the knocking.<br><br>13:30 We are back out to get lunch. I’ve been practicing art in the meantime. They quickly send me to bed.<br><br>I’m sure they’ll tell me what that was tomorrow.<br><br><br>Diary entry 849.<br>This isn’t real. I am fairly certain this is a horrible nightmare.<br>I will try to write what I saw. I’m fearful.<br><br>10:30 I woke up to a cold breeze. I walked over to brush my teeth, make up my hair and change clothes. I found it strange that I couldn’t feel my parents walk around, for a moment I assumed they were off to a neighbor again. Until I stepped out of my room.<br><br>They were there, by the window, hanging from the ceiling. There was an empty noose next to them.<br>I haven’t looked at them since.<br>12:00 I’ve been sobbing and crying. It’s not just my parents. I haven’t found a single living person. I think it’s everyone.<br>I’ve looked out the window in the hallway. And I see more people hanging in the distance.<br>I don’t believe this is real.<br><br>13:40 I went to an empty apartment on the top floor. I don’t have to see anyone here. I don’t want to see anyone else.<br><br>14:44 I felt the emergency bells ringing, it was a deep rumble to my skin which I’ve only felt during tests, I stepped out on the balcony to see what was going on, hoping there would be an answer but there he was. The Emperor. And at least a hundred noblemen all slowly marching out the palace. I screamed hoping for something to happen. Nothing. They kept walking. Nobody even bat an eye. I thought the Emperor would save us. Just like he had done with so many before us. I screamed and begged.<br>It’s hard to write while I’m shaking.<br>He stopped moving in the middle of the plaza. I thought he finally heard my screams but he kneeled and looked up. His mouth moved but it was too far for me to read what he said before he burst into this red mass. I couldn’t move. My body forced me to watch as he erupted into a swarm of tendrils reaching for the ground while he grew into something horrific. The noblemen kept walking and collapsed into him, vanishing into the mass. Last thing I saw before could take control and run was the red mass growing and pulsating.<br><br>16:12 I haven't quite calmed down but I’ve at least managed to calm my breathing. This doesn’t feel real.<br>I don’t understand what is happening. Or if it even is. The Emperor would never let this happen. This would never happen.<br>We’ve always been happy. I feel dizzy. There is a hole in my mind I cannot fill. It doesn’t make sense. Was it yesterday’s broadcast? What was even said? I wish I could fucking hear.<br>It’s cold here.<br>This must be a nightmare. It’s the only thing that makes sense. I know what they’re like, they’re just like this. The End.

== > Moon Info ==
{{Story Log Text|'''POPULATION:''' you?}}

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==

End is not a traditional moon and serves as the credits for Wesley's Moons. Time does not pass and landing does not count as a day towards the current deadline, although players will be fired upon returning to orbit when landing here on Day 0. Immediately upon landing, the credits will begin rolling and can not be skipped. Once finished, players can explore around the building and find various hazards and objects from many moons and interiors on display.

When facing away from the back of the ship, players can go into the right hallway to reach an area with the library and electric chair from the [[Rubber Rooms]] on display. This area also has five buttons on the wall that will spawn weapons and entities to fight in this area:

*Wave 1: Two shovels and two Thumpers.
*Wave 2: Two shovels, one Butler, and one Thumper.
*Wave 3: Two loaded shotguns with the safety off, eight shotgun ammo, one Butler, and four Thumpers.
*Wave 4: Two loaded shotguns with the safety off, eight shotgun ammo, two Butlers, two Nutcrackers, and two Thumpers.
*Wave 5: Two loaded shotguns with the safety off, eight shotgun ammo, one Jester, three Nutcrackers, and two Thumpers.

Every wave can seemingly be infinitely spawned, so players can freely farm knives, shotguns, and shovels on End.

== > Progression ==

=== > Unlocked By ===
{{spoiler | Inserting any destiny item into the destiny item slot before taking off in the abandoned ship on [[Repress]]. A destiny item can be acquired on [[Berunah]], [[Carnate]], [[Empra]], [[Release]], or [[Utril]]. }}

=== > Unlocks ===
This moon does not unlock any other moons.

######## Endings
{{Spoiler warning}}
'''Wesley's Moons has six different endings that can be achieved. The majority of these endings require unlocking a specific moon or moons.'''

== > Acquiring an Ending ==

{{ spoiler | Every ending requires routing to [[Repress]] to repair and power an abandoned ship on the exterior. Progress for doing this will be reset upon returning to orbit. An apparatus, two oil barrels, and an untampered operating panel are required to repair the ship. The appratus can be found within the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Interiors#The_Factory Facility], [[Expanded Facility]], [[Fractured Complex]], and [[Decrepit Store]] interiors. The oil barrels can randomly spawn as scrap within the interiors of multiple moons, but most commonly spawn within the interior of Repress. The untampered operating panel is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop on [[Galetry]] for ▮7000, can be crafted on [[Gratar]], and randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of [[Empra]] or [[Hyx]]. }}

{{ spoiler | To the left of the main entrance, insert an apparatus to open the door at the end of the wire. To the left of the ship in this room, place two oil barrels to fuel the ship. Once fueled, turn towards the monitor, interact with the keypad, interact with the top lever, interact with the bottom lever, and interact with the top lever again to move the ship outside. Run straight out of this room to reach the ship, jump inside, and place the untampered operating panel onto the terminal. If a destiny item has been collected, it can be inserted into the slot to the left of the terminal. Regardless, taking off will cause a cutscene to play and transport the player to the back of the ship once finished. }}

== > Ending 1: Escaped? ==

{{ spoiler | Ending 1 is the simplest ending to achieve, as players do not need a destiny item and just take off in the abandoned ship on Repress. }}

== > Ending 2: Fate Left Unfair ==

{{spoiler | To get this ending you must first acquire 3 special apparatuses, these apparatuses are: }}

{{spoiler | -The Bloody Apparatus which is acquired from [https://wesleysmoons.wiki.gg/wiki/Demetrica Demetrica] }}

- {{spoiler | Once you land on [https://wesleysmoons.wiki.gg/wiki/Demetrica Demetrica] buy either a jetpack or ladder and then proceed to the dome, you'll come to a 3 way fork going left or right will take you towards the main entrance but going straight is where the apparatus is, if you go straight you will enter a square room, dying inside this room without opening the other door will cause the room to become inaccessible for the rest of the day . As soon as you step foot in this room the path behind you will close and a trap will activate in the room, this trap comes in the form of two blocks/walls that stay on the lower level they move counter-clockwise and when they hit a wall they will briefly stop and turn, being in the way of one of these traps will kill the player, so as soon as you enter use the jetpack/ladder to get onto the upper level where the apparatus is, on the opposite end of where the player enters is a door, this door is the way out of the room, and is a unique door, the player can go down and interact with it which will fill up an interaction meter that stays between interactions, once that meter is full the door opens, alternatively and the most recommended option is to bring a key which will immediately open the door  or a lockpicker which will open the door after 30 seconds, once this door is open this room will be accessible for the rest of the day and you can take the apparatus at any point. }}

{{spoiler | -The Cosmic Apparatus which is acquired from [https://wesleysmoons.wiki.gg/wiki/Cosmocos Cosmocos] }}

{{spoiler | -The Royal Apparatus which is acquired from [https://wesleysmoons.wiki.gg/wiki/Calist Calist] }}

{{spoiler | After acquiring an apparatus you must bring it back to [https://wesleysmoons.wiki.gg/wiki/Galetry Galetry] where you will then insert it into its respective reactor slot inside the secret back room accessed by interacting with the loot bug statue in the back left next to the stairs, once all three have been inserted a new room will open up, inside the room will be a tape for the moon [https://wesleysmoons.wiki.gg/wiki/Hyx Hyx] insert that into the projector and then proceed to the planet, once you're on [https://wesleysmoons.wiki.gg/wiki/Hyx Hyx] proceed into the interior and keep your eye out for a tape there's always one guaranteed to spawn, this tape goes to the moon [https://wesleysmoons.wiki.gg/wiki/Empra Empra]. }} 

{{spoiler | Once on [https://wesleysmoons.wiki.gg/wiki/Empra Empra] there will be a few steps you must do after taking the cart over to the entrance: }}

{{spoiler | 1. Before heading inside the interior, there's a mortar on the left side that must be lowered go up to it and interact with it. }}

{{spoiler | 2. Once inside look for the fire exit that takes you out to an upper area that overlooks the cart this is where the crane controls are, there's a button to fire the mortar do that while you're here and then remember where the door is at you will be back here. }}

{{spoiler | 3. Now you will want to find two items in the interior the apparatus (word of advice if you have any special interiors installed and they have custom apparatuses you will not be able to continue, it must be the base apparatus), and you will also need to find the nuke, once both have been found take them to the cart and place them in their respective spots. }}

{{spoiler | 4. Head back to the crane controls are and get the crane into position, after its in position head down to the cart and head back to the ship, once back at the ship just send the cart back without you on it, after a bit a cutscene will play (this cutscene is not the ending), after the cutscene ends there will be an item that spawns on the ground near the ship called Chunk of Harold, this is a destiny item, grab it and head off to orbit. Players will achieve Ending 2 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene. }}

== > Ending 3: End of Time ==

{{spoiler | Ending 3 is the most complex ending to achieve and follows a mysterious voice guiding the player to various locations. First, players should get access to [[Berunah]]. Berunah can only be unlocked by following the specific progression route through [[Dreck]], [[Core]], and [[Faith]]. Do not route to Berunah after unlocking it. }}

{{spoiler | Next, players need to access [[Cubatres]] and retrieve the "Crystal cube" scrap found on the exterior near one of the fire exits. Cubatres can only be accessed through [[Utril]]. Players should now route to Berunah with the cube. }}

{{spoiler | After the sandstorm passes on the exterior, a stairway will be revealed directly in front of the main entrance door. Going down this stairway will lead to an area with an interactable statue on the left side. After interacting with this statue, inserting the cube into the hole the statue's light is shining through will reveal a hidden chamber. Inside will be five brooding seeds and a glowing eye at the end of the chamber. Players must return all these brooding seeds to the ship, but can also approach the eye for an explanation on what to do with these seeds and this explanation will be logged in the ship terminal. }}

{{spoiler | Players must place the brooding seeds onto altars on the exteriors of [[Etern]], [[Filitrios]], [[Fission-C]], [[Gloom]], and [[Utril]]. Check the Progression section on each moon page to see the specifics of unlocking each of them, and it is highly recommended to unlock and route to [[Alcatras]] for the highest chance at finding the Gloom videotape. Placing the brooding seeds will display a warning message and permanently alter the exteriors and interiors of these moons on that save file until the player is fired. Berunah's exterior will also be altered once all five brooding seeds are placed. }}

{{spoiler | After placing all five brooding seeds, players must return to Berunah and the hidden chamber.  A "Chunk of Overseer" will now be in the hidden chamber. Near the main entrance, a lever that a statue is looking at will now be interactable nearby. This will raise up the shrine of purification to insert the chunk into, and a cutscene will play shortly afterward. }}

{{spoiler | After the cutscene, the destiny item "Stone of purification" will spawn behind the ship. Players will achieve Ending 3 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene. }}

== > Ending 4: Old Mans Rest ==
{{spoiler | Ending 4 is the quickest of the five endings that provide destiny items to complete and follows the story of a character named Professor Harrington. "Harrington's Research 4" is a destiny item that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior of [[Utril]]. Players will achieve Ending 4 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene. For players that wish to understand and experience the story, it is recommended to unlock and route to [[Cosmocos]] and [[Desolation]] and find logs there as well. }}

== > Ending 5: Living Ingredient ==
{{spoiler | Ending 5 follows the experimentations done by the Trite Control Corporation and requires completing a unique trial on [[Release]]. Release can only be unlocked by following the specific progression route through [[Crowd]], [[Narcotic]], [[Descent]], and [[Extort]]. It is important to note that while all of these moons have trials, only Release's trial is required to complete this ending. }}

{{spoiler | To complete this trial:<br>1. Though not required until the final step, it is advised to find a door with a sign that says "RESHAPE THE INCAPABLE" and remember its location.<br>2. Find a room with an employee trapped in a machine and remember its location.<br>3. Find and return three "Machine parts" scrap to this room and insert them into the machine. These parts spawn in smaller server rooms with shelving units behind electrical gates. These electrical gates will deal 99hp to the player if they walk through them while holding machine parts. The intended method to avoid taking damage is to place the parts onto a small platform, walk through the electrical gate and around to the other side of the platform, and rotate the platform to safely transport the parts. However, dropping the parts near the electrical gate, walking through the gate, and grabbing the parts from the other side is much simpler.<br>4. Press the red button in the room with the employee, grab the gas can underneath it, and find a generator within the interior to fuel with the gas. The generator typically spawns in rooms adjacent to catwalks with a sign saying "BACKUP POWER".<br>5. Return to the room with the employee, press the red button again, and wait.<br>6. Once the employee has been "reshaped" and a loud buzzer sound plays, return to the door in step 1. It will now be opened. }}

{{spoiler | After completing the trial, interact with the TV in the now open room. The destiny item "Secret Coordinates" will spawn in the machine next to the TV afterward. Players will achieve Ending 5 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene. }}

== > Ending 6: Art of War ==
{{spoiler | Ending 6 follows the experimentations done by the Trite Control Corporation. It requires completing the trials on [[Crowd]], [[Narcotic]], [[Descent]], [[Extort]], and [[Release]] and acquiring the unique ticket scrap from each of them. Players will progress to each moon in the listed order. For the sake of not bloating this guide and making it overwhelming, please read the specifics on completing each trial in the Moon Exclusive Content section of each moon page. For Release's trial specifically players can also read Ending 5 on this page. }}

{{spoiler | Do not attempt Release's trial until all other tickets have been acquired. Once Release's trial is completed and the reward room has been unlocked, do not interact with the TV before inserting all five unique trial tickets into the machine next to the TV as prompted. Submitting any less than all five tickets will result in Ending 5. Interacting with the TV after submitting all five tickets will instead spawn the destiny item "Very secret coordinates" in the machine next to the TV. Players will achieve Ending 6 after having inserted it it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene. }}

{{spoiler | After completing any ending except Ending 1, players will unlock a hidden moon called [[End]]. This moon is not a traditional moon and instead serves as the credits for Wesley's Moons. This moon can also be used to farm knives, shotguns, and shovels. }}

{{TOC left}}

'''Etern''' was home to a scientific lab where biological experiments took place. Many new lifeforms were created here among which are the famous Baboon Hawks. In more recent times they have been working on "Project Nutcracker" as instructed. Rumors are that they used human subjects for emotional manipulation using certain toy masks.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Eterntopview.jpg|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Transformed.|Warm, Dry sandy terrain, supports plant life such as cactaceae and rarely polypodiophyta.|A thriving ecosystem, creatures support agressive behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
Etern is a deserted moon. It has polypodiophyta scattered around the moon with cactaceae spread about. Etern has lots of steep hills that you can't walk up. After the bomb goes off at 5pm the place turns into a barren wasteland where the cactaceae are turned into molten rock from the explosion with heavy amounts of fog and dust from the explosion making it hard to see.

== > Weather ==
Etern can experience Rainy, Foggy, Stormy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==

=== Inside & Outside Ambience ===
On Etern you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

==== Outside Ambience ====
[[File:Etern outside loop.wav]]

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:Etern inside loop.mp3]]

=== Bomb ===
Etern's exterior has a siren that will go off at 05:00pm outside a fence, which can also be heard while inside the interior. At 06:00pm the siren will stop and a bomb will be dropped. This bomb doesn't do any damage regardless of proximity, but makes everything foggy outside and hard to see. By around 10:00pm the dust will settle.

=== Ambience ===
Etern's interior plays unique ambient sounds, primarily to trick the player into thinking there is danger. For example, a Nutcracker can be heard scanning an area in the distance as well as the distant spring of a Coil-Head as if it had been spotted.

=== Altar (Mysterious Object's Slot) ===
Etern's exterior also has an altar where a mysterious object can be placed. To reach it, walk straight forward from the front of the ship and it'll be slightly to the right in some plants and grass. This '''mysterious object''' is {{spoiler|a '''Brooding seed''' that can found in a hidden chamber on the exterior of [[Berunah|'''Berunah''']]. Placing the seed will cause a warning message to appear that says "A Cosmic Entity of unknown power has turned it's focus towards this planet."}}

{{spoiler|This dramatically alters the terrain on the exterior, causes several tentacles to appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, and visually alters the interior. This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of [[Filitrios|'''Filitrios''']], [[Fission-C|'''Fission-C''']], [[Gloom|'''Gloom''']], and [[Utril|'''Utril''']], in which case the changes become permanent on that save file.}}

=== Tape Player Logs & Protocol Wipeout ===
Additionally, '''Tape player protocol wipeout''' and '''Tape player logs''' can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior. They tell the rest of the story of the scientist that created G.A.R.Y., the AI sold to the company on [[Gratar]]. They talk about the installation of a nuke on Etern, a former project that created Baboon Hawks, a new project for the creation of Nutcrackers, and the aforementioned manipulative weapons resulting in the creation of Masked. The scientist died to a Nutcracker via gunshot.

=== Etern Videotape ===
If players find the Etern videotape randomly as scrap within the interiors of other moons and insert it into the projector in [[Galetry]], the story of Captain Commander Cunningham continues. Confusingly, Etern is recorded as "Tape 3" while [[Atlantica]] is recorded as "Tape 2" by Cunningham. On the other hand, '''Cunningham's travel log 2''' explicitly states that Cunningham routed to Atlantica after visiting Etern. Either way, this chronologically happened some time between Cunningham routing to [[Infernis]] and Cunningham routing to [[Acidir]].<br>'''This videotape''' can be found on [[Calist]], [[Fission-C]], [[Oldred]], [[Trite]] and [[Polarus]].
