######## Expanded Facility
[[File:ExpandedFacilityMain.jpg|thumb|The main entrance of the Expanded Facility.]]
The '''Expanded Facility''' is a variation of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Interiors#The_Factory Facility], also referred to as Factory, interior that adds many extra tiles and some minor features. It most commonly spawns on [[ResearcherxB]] and [[Release]]. The latter has a unique trial there instead of a [[Expanded_Facility#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objective''']].

== > Rooms ==
*'''Nail Machine''' - A machine that generates in a large '''Wire Room''' typically close by the Main Entrance. There are several server racks in the room and two '''Fuses''' on a stool next to the machine. This machine holds the reward for completing a [[Expanded_Facility#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objective''']].
*'''Wire Room''' - A large or small room with various wires on the roof and wall and a metal floor.
*'''Additional Server Rooms''' - A handful of other rooms with severs now generate. One has a window that looks into it and another has a staircase. 
*'''Large Storage''' - A large room with a few shelving units inside and big boxes inside.
*'''Backup Power''' - A small room with shelving units and a sign that reads "BACKUP POWER".
*'''Square Catwalk''' - Catwalks connecting to each other in a room to form a square.

== > Features ==
*'''Rotating Platform''' - Scrap can be placed on small platforms that rotate by pushing a red button. This is primarily useful for transporting scrap past an '''Electrical Gate'''.

== > Hazards ==
*'''Electrical Gate''' - Primarily spawns in front of small storage rooms with a warning sign that reads "DO NOT CROSS WITH MECHANICAL PARTS". Holding "mechanical parts" in the player's hand and attempting to pass through this gate deals 99 damage to the player. "Mechanical parts" are any scrap tagged as '''lethal_company:metal''' (Cash registers, Clown horns, Big bolts, etc.) and the '''Machine parts''' scrap. The '''Rotating Platform''' can be used to safely transport scrap past the gate, but the player can also just drop the scrap near the gate, walk to the other side, and safely grab it.

== > Secondary Objectives ==
[[File:ExpandedFacilityNailMachine.jpg|thumb|The Nail Machine with the Fuses next to it.]]One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn after twisting the dial on the '''Nail Machine'''.

=== Restart the Power ===
Players must bring and insert a '''Fuse''' into two panels found in the interior. Once inserted, players can interact with the dial and cause a light to start sequentially going from top to bottom on the side. Players must pull the crank on the right at the same time that light is over the yellow circle three times, with the yellow circle potentially changing positions and the light speeding up or slowing down to throw players off. There is also a delay between the light going from the bottom back to the top circle.

Once both panels have successfully turned on, players can return to the '''Nail Machine''' and twist the dial for their reward.

=== Fix the Breakers ===
Players must bring and insert a '''Fuse''' into two panels of switches found in the interior. Once inserted, players must flick all the switches in a specific but random order. Flicking the switches in the incorrect order will cause all switches to reset. If successful, a sound effect will play and the panel can no longer be interacted with.

Once both panels are activated, players can return to the '''Nail Machine''' and twist the dial for their reward.

=== Control the Pressure ===
Players must bring and insert both '''Fuses''' into a panel hooked up to a machine with several valves that generates in a '''Large Storage''' room. Typically, this room is either near the main entrance or connected to the large open room. After activation, players can simply do nothing and the pressure will stabilize after about 180 seconds. However, players can turn the valves on the machine that are releasing steam to stabilize the pressure faster.

Once stabilized, all the valves will turn and a sound effect will play. Players can now return to the '''Nail Machine''' and twist the dial for their reward.

=== Rewards ===
<!--Multiplayer values may need to be double checked in-game due to rounding.-->
<div class="noresize">
{| class="wikitable sortable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="text-align: center;" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"

The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Mechanics#Furniture_luck the vanilla luck system]. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. '''Control the Pressure''' is considered Easy difficulty and has a 1.0x multiplier, '''Restart the Power''' is considered Medium difficulty and has a 1.15x multiplier, and '''Fix the Breakers''' is considered Hard difficulty and has a 1.4x multiplier. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

######## Expanded Mineshaft
[[File:ExpandedMineshaftMain.jpg|thumb|The main entrance of the Expanded Mineshaft.]]
The '''Expanded Mineshaft''' is a variation of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Interiors#The_Mineshaft_(more_info_needed) Mineshaft] that is similar in gameplay but is structurally different. It also adds several extra tiles. It commonly spawns on [[Chasm]], [[Core]], [[Dreck]], [[Infernis]], and [[Lecaro]].  It most commonly spawns on [[Descent]] and features a unique trial there instead of a [[Expanded_Mineshaft#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objective''']]. 

== > Rooms ==
*'''Locked Storage''' - A room with several lockers, benches, and hangers behind a special locked door. Typically spawns close to the main entrance and requires completing a [[Expanded_Mineshaft#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objective''']] to open.
*'''Conveyor Belt''' - A room with a conveyor belt that typically spawns near the main entrance.
*'''Pressure Management''' - A room with many pipes inside of it.
*'''Cave-In''' - Some hallways have dead ends as a result of a cave-in.
*'''Coal Storage''' - A room with many containers of coal.
*'''Minecart Storage''' - An area with many minecarts placed on the tracks.
*'''Furnace''' - A room with a furnace in it and coal nearby. Two furnaces can also spawn across from each other in hallways.
*'''Lifts''' - Areas with smaller lifts likely used for transporting materials and supplies up and down. Falling to the bottom kills the player.
*'''Chasm''' - A broken pathway above a large chasm that must be jumped over. Falling to the bottom kills the player.
*'''Spider Cave''' - A pathway in the caves leading to a pit with several webs, eggs, and a Bunker Spider on the other side. This room always generates but is only accessible through normal means if the [[Expanded_Mineshaft#Dissolve_the_Webs|'''Dissolve the Webs''']] objective is generated.

== > Secondary Objectives ==
[[File:ExpandedMineshaftLockedStorageDoor.jpg|thumb|The Locked Storage door with the Gas tank for the Fuel the Generator objective next to it.]]One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that spawns in the '''Locked Storage''' room.

=== Flick the Switches ===
Players must find two panels of switches in the main area of the mineshaft. Players must flick up all the switches that have a wire connected to a red light and flick down all other switches. A sound effect will play and the panel can no longer be interacted with if successful.

After both panels are turned on, a sound effect will be heard and players can return to and open the '''Locked Storage''' for their reward.

=== Fuel the Generator ===
If a '''Gas tank''' spawns next to the '''Locked Storage''' door, players must bring it to a yellow generator with its light on somewhere in the caves. Players must pour the gas into the funnel on the machine connected to the generator.

After the gas has been poured, a sound effect will play and players can return to and open the '''Locked Storage''' for their reward.

=== Dissolve the Webs ===
If webs are above or around the '''Locked Storage''' door, players must find the now accessible '''Spider Cave''' in the caves. Players must cross the pit to reach the other side with the Bunker Spider, several webs, and several eggs. A web on a pipe that periodically sparks can be interacted with to remove it at the end of the room.

If successful, a sound effect will play and players can return to and open the '''Locked Storage''' for their reward.

=== Rewards ===

The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. == > Weather ==
Extort can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Trial: Grind The Deluded ===
This moon features a '''trial''' that generates on the exterior. Completing it rewards the player with scrap worth an average of ▮378. The '''specific rewards''' are {{spoiler | several "Small diamond" and one "Grind the deluded ticket" scrap.}}

<big>To complete this trial:</big>

#{{spoiler|Find the shed with an employee strapped to a table and hooked up to a machine. Go straight and slightly right from the back of the ship past the first hill until you reach a second hill. The shed is at the bottom. This is also where one of the fire exits is.}}
#{{spoiler|To the right of the machine will be three gas canisters and the names of three locations. Take a gas canister to any of these locations. There is a map on the wall in the shed to use as a guide.}}
#{{spoiler|When you reach a location, fuel the generator near the grinder the employee is trapped in with the gas canister. Wait for the employee to be grinded and grab the "Gore bucket" that gets filled.}}
#{{spoiler|Return to the shed and insert the gore into the machine the employee is hooked up to.}}
#{{spoiler|Repeat steps 2-4 two more times.}}
#{{spoiler|There is a hole in the back of the shed to crouch through that leads to a submerged building. Retrieve a blue key that spawns in a random location inside. Jumping prevents drowning.}}
#{{spoiler|Return to the shed, press the red button to the left of the employee, and insert the blue key into the key slot to the right of the map as prompted. The rewards will spawn in front of the grinder shortly afterward.}}

{{TOC left}}

A new curious factory has emerged in Facto… and now rumors of a comfy shoe that makes hunting monsters easier are spreading. Can you survive the Crocs mission?

== > Moon Map ==
{{Maps|Facto}}

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Abandoned|Dry. dusty, many industrial artifacts.|Dominated by a few Crocs-wearing species.|<br><br>Owned by Crocs(tm)}}

== > Environment ==
Facto is an abandoned industrial moon featuring rough landscape, dead soil, several bushes, dead trees, lying rocks, telecommunications poles and factory buildings that contain Crocs shoes. Upon exiting the ship, to right and left will be telecommunications poles and especially large one to the left. When you go left those poles will lead you close to one of the fire exits. Leading straight out of the ship and going behind that one little hill in front of the ship will lead you close enough to the main entrance to spot it. To access the second and last fire exit on this moon, you need to go a little bit right from that small hill and then you should be able to find it.

== > Weather ==
'''Facto''' supports Rainy, Foggy, Stormy, Eclipsed, Earthquake, Forsaken, Hallowed, and Hurricane weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Unique Scrap ===
On this moon you can find unique scrap such as '''crocs shoes'''. For example: gold croc, glitter croc, box of crocs, time croc, etc. Vanilla scrap can also be found, like: egg beater, cookie mold pan, V-type engine, etc.

=== Crocs Enemies ===
Except finding '''crocs shoes''', you can also encounter '''enemies wearing those'''. Entities like earth leviathan or hygrodere do not have them for obvious reasons. All enemies on this moon are the same as Vanilla ones. Crocs shoes on their feet are just a cosmetic addition.

== > Progression ==
=== Unlocked By ===
{{Spoiler|Inserting '''Facto videotape''' to videotape player on Galetry. This '''videotape''' that can be found on [[Polarus]], [[Filitrios]], [[Empra]], [[Trite]] and in Gift Shop on [[Galetry]].}}
=== Unlocks === 
This moon does not unlock any other moon.

{{TOC left}}

A moon housed by a friendly religious group.<br>They care for nature. It is their purpose. It is their believe.<br>But don't be mislead by the beauty of this moon.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Faith.jpg|frameless|border|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Few|Half days, warm, fields of invasive flower species.|Dominated by Earth Leviathans.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}
Faith is covered with flora. The landscape is also littered with holes due to the Earth Leviathan activity. Half-days occur on Faith, meaning it gets very dark very quickly.

== > Weather ==
Faith can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside & Outside (Day & Night) Ambience ===
On Faith you can hear three ambiences: '''Inside ambience''' (that plays inside facility), '''day ambience''' (that plays during the day) and '''night ambience''' (Which plays during night).

==== Day Outside Ambience ====
[[File:Faith outside ambience.mp3]]

==== Night Outside Ambience ====
[[File:FaithOutsideAmbienceNight.mp3]]

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:FaithInsideLoop.wav]]

=== Secret Passage ===
'''Faith's exterior''' has various '''interactable levers''' on stone shrines. '''Pulling the lever''' will cause the '''light to change color''' and a sound effect to be heard. The easiest way to reach any of them is to follow the dirt pathway and there are six in total. Once all six levers have been pulled, a hidden area will open in a giant rock that is behind and to the far right of the ship (near the Cosmocos shrine). Inside will be the scrap '''"My task 5"''' as well as an interactable '''mysterious object'''.

If players interact with this object, {{spoiler|the inside of the rock will change and an [[Assimilated_Growth|'''Assimilated Growth''']] will immediately spawn in the interior when landing on '''Faith''' in the future. This persists until the player is fired unless the '''Brooding seeds''' from [[Berunah|'''Berunah''']] are placed on the other altars found on the exteriors of [[Etern|'''Etern''']], [[Filitrios|'''Filitrios''']], [[Fission-C|'''Fission-C''']], [[Gloom|'''Gloom''']], and [[Utril|'''Utril''']]. Once every seed has been placed, the object will move onto the altar on its own if players did not move it already and all these changes become permanent on that save file.}}

{{TOC left}}

'''Filitrios''' houses a giant toy store. One with a whole world of fun. It was the largest and the most popular, but every fun place has its own dark secrets. People went missing. Many toys remain inside.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Filitrios.jpg|frameless|border|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Executed.|Cold, mountainous terrain, very snowy.|A healthy avian ecosystem.|<br><br>Home to the Across the Stars radio station.}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather ==
Filitrios can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Filitrios Toy Store's Ambience ===
'''happyplace''' - special music that plays only on this map. 

[[File:Happyplace.ogg]]

=== Teddy Bears ===
'''Filitrios's exterior''' and interior can have '''teddy bears''' with a pale head sown onto them. If the pale head has a blue right eye, the head will activate randomly when a player is nearby and look around the surrounding area in a clockwise rotation. If a player is seen during this time, the head will expand and an [[Arachnohead|'''Arachnohead''']] will spawn from the teddy bear.

=== Altar (Mysterious Object's Slot) ===
'''Filitrios's exterior''' also has an altar where a mysterious object can be placed. The altar is almost directly south from the back of the ship and slightly to the right before the bridge leading to the radio station. This '''mysterious object''' is {{spoiler|a '''Brooding seed''' that can found in a hidden chamber on the exterior of [[Berunah|'''Berunah''']]. Placing the seed will cause a warning message to appear that says "A Cosmic Entity of unknown power has turned it's focus towards this planet".}}

{{spoiler|This dramatically alters the terrain on the exterior, causes several tentacles to appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, visually alters the interior, and causes the [[Assimilated_Growth|'''Assimilated Growth''']] to almost immediately spawn in the interior when landing on the moon in the future. All these changes also apply to [[Centrus|'''Centrus''']]. This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of [[Etern|'''Etern''']], [[Fission-C|'''Fission-C''']], [[Gloom|'''Gloom''']], and [[Utril|'''Utril''']], in which case these changes become permanent on that save file.}}

== > Progression ==
=== Unlocked By ===
{{spoiler|Logging "Radio Message 3" found on the exterior of [[Trite]].<br> Alternatively, inserting the Filitrios videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Adamance Adamance], [[Fission-C]], [[Gloom]], [[Motra]], or [[Utril]] into the projector in [[Galetry]].}}

=== Unlocks ===
{{spoiler|[[Centrus|<big>'''Centrus:'''</big>]] Interact with the computer in the radio station found on the exterior.}}<br>{{spoiler|[[Crowd|<big>'''Crowd:'''</big>]] "Teach the disloyal" videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.}}<br>{{spoiler|[[Demetrica|<big>'''Demetrica:'''</big>]] Log "Radio Message 4" found on the exterior.}}<br>{{spoiler|[[Hyve|<big>'''Hyve:'''</big>]] Hyve videotape that is found within the breakable hive that has a 33% chance to spawn on the exterior.}}<br>{{spoiler|[[Motra|<big>'''Motra:'''</big>]] Motra videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.}}

*There is a Maneater and a Webley sitting next to each other in the toy store as an homage to Wesley and his girlfriend.<br><br>[[File:Webley and Maneater.jpg|border|300px]]<br><br>
*'''Behind the scenes:'''
**Before '''Journeys update''' there were voiceline test and attempts before each videotape was finished. Here's a one of test voicelines of '''Voice of Filitrios'''. Voice that you can hear in '''Filitrios videotape'''.<br><br>[[File:The many Pronunciations of Filitrios.mp3]]
*Despite being in the [[Filitrios#Enemy_Spawns_(Interior)| Enemy Spawns (Interior)]] table, [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Lasso_Man Lasso] can not spawn without commands or additional modification. Wesley has previously stated Lasso was added to a spawn table because it was funny, which likely applies here too, but Wesley also created a Jester variant called [[Lasso_Man|'''Lasso Man''']] and potentially added it to the table in the Obscurity update.

{{TOC left}}

'''Sector C of Fission''' houses an old toy factory later repurposed as nuclear power plant. However this power plant was abandoned many rotations ago due to health inspection failure. Now this structure is crumbling and all those who visit will leave changed.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Fission-C topvieww.jpg|650px|border|frameless]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Gone.|Hot dry toxic terrain, no surviving flora.|An irradiated ecosystem.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}
Fission-C is an abaondoned toxic wasteland which used to be a powerplant. There ae shipping containers and toxic waste around the moon's surface.

== > Weather ==
Fission-C can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.

If Fission-C is Flooded, the pools of toxic waste on the exterior will have already risen and will continue to rise even higher throughout the day.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside Ambience ===
On Fission-C you can hear an ambience that plays inside the facility.

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:Fission inside loop.wav]]

=== Toxic Waste ===
'''Fission-C's exterior has toxic waste''' that will '''rapidly deal 12 damage per hit''' to the player while standing in it. This toxic waste behaves similar to flooding in that it will rise in specific areas throughout the day.

=== Toxic Barrles ===
'''Fission-C's interior''' has open radioactive barrels that '''quickly deal 1 damage per hit''' to any player within its radius. The player can sacrifice some hp to close these barrels by walking up to and interacting with them.

=== Altar (Mysterious Object's Slot) ===
'''Fission-C's exterior''' also has an altar where a mysterious object can be placed. To reach it, look north of the back of the ship and follow the left pathway past the two barrels. This '''mysterious object''' is {{spoiler|a '''Brooding seed''' that can found in a hidden chamber on the exterior of [[Berunah|'''Berunah]]. Placing the seed will cause a warning message to appear that says "A Cosmic Entity of unknown power has turned it's focus towards this planet".}}

{{spoiler|This dramatically alters the terrain on the exterior, causes several tentacles to appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, visually alters the interior, and causes the [[Assimilated_Growth|'''Assimilated Growth''']] to almost immediately spawn in the interior when landing on the moon in the future. This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of [[Etern|'''Etern''']], [[Filitrios|'''Filitrios''']], [[Gloom|'''Gloom''']], and [[Utril|'''Utril''']], in which case the changes become permanent on that save file.}}

######## Fractured Complex
[[File:FracturedComplexMainEntrance.jpg|alt=The main entrance of the Fractured Complex.|thumb|The main entrance of the Fractured Complex]]
The '''Fractured Complex''' is a factory-like interior with various machinery and conveyor belts. It most commonly spawns on [[Empra]].

== > Rooms ==
*'''Secure Door''' - A large security door that spawns near the main entrance. This door can be opened by interacting with the lever next to it after completing a [[Fractured_Complex#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objective''']].
*'''Break Room''' - A room that can typically spawn near the main entrance that has lockers, cabinets, a refrigerator, etc. Scrap can spawn in this room and typically in the larger cabinet.
*'''Server Room''' - A room with server racks, cabinets, and lockers. Scrap can spawn in this room, especially in the cabinets.
*'''Machinery Rooms''' - Multiple different rooms with varying machinery in them. Scrap can spawn in in these rooms.
*'''Long Conveyor Belt''' - A larger room with staircases and a long conveyor belt(s). Scrap frequently spawns in this room.
*'''Security Room''' - A security office with several desks and monitors with a narrow hallway. This room is mostly for the [[Fractured_Complex#Facility_Security|'''Facility Security''']] objective.
*'''Catwalks''' - Long, winding catwalks with numerous branching paths and doors. Scrap can spawn on small platforms near the railings or frequently in a part of this area that has a staircase and multiple cabinets.
*'''Apparatus''' - A regular apparatus that is not guaranteed to spawn. If it does spawn, it will either be in its own room or in a large square area of the '''Catwalks'''.

== > Interior Features ==
*'''Sliding Doors''' - Doors players can open and shut by interacting with the lever next to them. They can randomly slam shut when players approach them or walk through them and will open on their own after some time.

== > Secondary Objectives ==
[[File:FracturedComplexSecureDoor.jpg|thumb|The Secure Door that holds the reward.]]One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn past the '''Secure Door'''.

=== Facility Pressure ===
Players must find two sets of valves in the interior. A monitor displays the current pressure while a notice on the wall displays the target pressure. Players must add to or subtract from the current pressure by turning the valves left or right to reach the target pressure. Each valve can only be turned in a direction once before having to be turned the other way to return to its starting position. For example, if a player turns a valve to add 10, they can only turn the valve the other way to subtract 10 before being able to turn the valve to add 10 again. A sound effect will play after the target pressure is reached and the valves can not be interacted with anymore.

Once both sets of valves reach their target pressure, a sound effect will play and players can return to the '''Secure Door''' to get their reward.

=== Facility Power ===
Players must find two panels on the wall that have a 3x3 grid of buttons on it in the interior. Pressing one button will press all adjacent buttons and players must turn all the buttons green to turn on the power.

A sound effect will play if players are successful and the panel can no longer be interacted with. Once both panels have had all their buttons turned green, another sound effect will play and players can return to the '''Secure Door''' to get their reward.

=== Facility Security ===
Players must find their way to the '''Security Room'''. There are six live wires electrifying the floor and blocking the walkway, rapidly dealing 15 damage per hit to players. Players must get close enough to each wire to see the name tag on them or color of them and then return to a panel of 18 wires at the start of the room to cut that matching wire. Cutting a wrong wire will deal 90 damage to the player.

Once all six live wires have been cut, players can safely walk to the end of the room and press a button. A sound effect will play and players can return to the '''Secure Door''' to get their reward.

=== Rewards ===
<!--Multiplayer values may need to be double checked in-game due to rounding.-->

The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Mechanics#Furniture_luck the vanilla luck system]. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. '''Facility Power''' is considered Easy difficulty and has a 1.0x multiplier while '''Facility Pressure''' and '''Facility Security''' are considered Medium difficulty and have a 1.15x multiplier. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

== > Event: The Compactor ==
[[File:FracturedComplexCompactor.jpg|thumb|A sideview of The Compactor.]]'''The Compactor''' can randomly spawn within the interior. It spawns 16 Silver sheets inside of it that are conductive, weigh 26lbs, and range from ▮20 to ▮107 each.  As soon as a player enters '''The Compactor''', its roof will begin to shut and a panel will be lowered to reveal five grids of buttons. Pressing one button will press all adjacent buttons in that grid. Players must turn all the buttons green to open the exit door.

Gears on the wall will have a Silver sheet already stuck in them. This sheet will break after roughly 14 seconds as soon as players drop in, causing '''The Compactor''' to begin advancing forward. Players must insert another Silver sheet into the gears to halt its advance for roughly another 24 seconds before that sheet breaks too. Players must repeatedly sacrifice Silver sheets to stall '''The Compactor''' while solving the grid puzzles to open the exit door and escape before it crushes them.

It is recommended that players quickly scan for lower value sheets and either hold them in their inventory or place them near the gears to pick up and insert as needed. It is also recommended to move Silver sheets closer to the exit, as they can not be collected through normal means once '''The Compactor''' moves over top of them.

Any Silver sheets that players can successfully get out of '''The Compactor''' is their reward for the event. This can range anywhere from ▮0 to ▮1752 depending on both how lucky and skillful players are. The average total for all 16 Silver sheets spawned is ▮1016.

'''Galetry''' is A peaceful gallery resting between the mountain tops. Eager to collect your scrap and deliver it to the company building.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Galetryoutside.png|border|frameless|650px]]
[[File:Galetryinside.png|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Abandoned.|Warm, hilly terrain, supports diverse plantlife.|A healthy ecosystem, fauna rarely exhibits dangerous behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
'''Galetry''' is a forested and hilly moon. Trees, tall grass, and flowers cover the terrain and a waterfall can be seen behind the ship falling into a small river. The time of day is randomly selected between morning, noon, evening, and rarely night when players land on the moon.

The most prominent feature on '''Galetry''' is the large building directly behind the ship, which plays music inside. It houses busts of Hoarding Bugs and a giant art museum of pictures depicting both custom content from Wesley's Moons and vanilla Lethal Company areas, such as [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Experimentation Experimentation] and [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Offense Offense]. Two smaller buildings can be found to the left and right of the ship respectively, the left being the [[Galetry#Fire_Exit|Fire Exit]] and the right being the [[Galetry#Gift Shop|Gift Shop]].

=== Museum's Ambience ===
[[File:Museuma background track final.wav]]

=== Outside Ambience ===
[[File:Forest.wav]]

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside the Building ===
Immediately left upon entering will be a '''Log translator''' for players to log [[Items#Loggable_Items|'''Loggable Items''']]. Additionally, a '''Videotape player''' can be found by going left upon entering the building, climbing a ladder on the right-hand side, and climbing the stairs to the right. [[Items#Videotapes|'''Videotapes''']] can be inserted into here for players to watch and unlock new moons.

A desk can be found on the right side of the building where players can sell their scrap. Immediately to the right upon entering the building, players can also place items on a counter and press a button to transfer them over to the desk to make transportation of large amounts of scrap easier.

A bust of a Hoarding Bug with a flashlight pointing to another bust can be found on the left side of the building. Interacting with the bust the flashlight is pointing at will cause the stairs to move and reveal a hidden backstage area. Butch, a passive and invulnerable Butler, will appear and start cleaning when players walk through. At the end of the hallway is a sealed door, '''The great mystery''' log, and a large apparatus sticking out on the left side. Interacting with this apparatus will turn the lights on. Players can leave this area by backtracking, interacting with a Hoarding Bug bust, and waiting for the stairs to move again.

Additionally, {{spoiler|players will find slots to insert three more special apparatus on either side of the sealed door: The '''Cosmic apparatus''', '''Royal apparatus''', and '''Bloody apparatus'''. These can be found on [[Cosmocos|'''Cosmocos''']], [[Calist|'''Calist''']], and [[Demetrica|'''Demetrica''']] respectively. Inserting an apparatus will be saved until the player is fired, but inserting all three apparatus will permanently be saved on the save file. Once all three are inserted, the door will open to reveal the '''Hyx videotape''' and the '''Dread''' log.}}

=== Videotapes ===
Scattered around the museum are a few tapes. There is one for {{spoiler|[[Motra|'''Motra''']]}}, {{spoiler|[[Infernis|'''Infernis''']]}}, {{spoiler|[[Asteroid-13|'''Asteroid-13''']]}}, and a special tape labeled "???"

=== Fire Exit ===
A fire exit can be found to the left after exiting the ship. Inside will be a door to the left that requires a '''Fabricated key''' to open, the '''Intruder''' log, and a blocked entrance. A '''Fabricated key''' can be {{spoiler|crafted on [[Gratar|'''Gratar''']] for one Steel, two Copper wiring, and one Rubber.}}

==== Fabricator ====
After opening the door, {{spoiler|a fabrication machine similar to the one on [[Gratar|'''Gratar''']] can be found where players can craft '''Blank floppy discs''' instead of '''Untampered operating panels'''. Players can also still craft '''Triangulation devices''', '''Double barrel shotguns''', '''Shotgun shells''', '''Adrenaline-stims''', '''Health-stims''', '''Pulatrum spore emitters''', '''Boomboxes''', '''Advanced flashlights''', '''Fog reducers''', '''Radar boosters''', '''Action figures''', '''Weed killer''', '''De-weed''', '''Pesticide sprinklers''', '''Fabricated keys''', and '''Single-barrel shotguns''' on '''Galetry'''. Any [[Items#Ingredient_Items|'''Ingredient Items''']] deposited into either machine will be shared between them and resources will save even after players are fired. Note that there is a conversion rate for ingredients to resources (e.g., 1 '''Steel ingot''' equals 3 Steel) and these can be found in the [[Items#Ingredient_Items|'''Ingredient Items''']] section mentioned above.}}

=== Gift Shop ===
The '''Gift Shop''' can be found to the right (north) after exiting the ship. The '''Quickstart floppy disk''' and '''Failsafe floppy disk''' can be found underneath the counter on the right. The former unlocks {{spoiler|[[Asteroid-13|'''Asteroid-13''']], [[Infernis|'''Infernis''']], and [[Motra|'''Motra''']]}} while the latter will re-unlock any moons that randomly locked themselves again on the save file.

Additionally, you can buy some scrap or even something different like action figures here. You can also buy the '''Untampered operating panel''' (Vintage Control Panel) for ▮7000 and '''Mortor's mortar''' for ▮9000 here.<br><br>'''NOTE:''' Scrap has a price multiplier of 4, meaning the price to buy it is four times as much as its value.<br>Special items and action figures have normal price multiplier (1.0).<br>Also:
*Every scrap spot has a 10% chance to be empty.
*Every action figure spot has a 15% chance to be empty.
*'''Mortor's mortar''' spot has a 20% chance to be empty.
*'''Untampered operating panel''' (Vintage Control Panel) spot has a 33.3% chance to be empty.

== > Lore ==
=== Collector Logs ===
These logs can be found around [[Galetry|'''Galetry''']]. In order, '''The Collector''' can be found on the Hoarding Bug bust to the right of the '''Log translator''', '''Company trouble''' can be found on the ground to the left of the counter, '''Intruder''' can be found on the ground past the fire exit door, and '''The great mystery''' can be found in the backstage area on some boxes near the secure door. '''Dread''' can be found in the room past the secure door.

==== The Collector ====
{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
!Text {{pad|0.5em|}}
|-
|{{Story Log Text|I cannot say I am much of a writer, I beg of you, don’t have grave expectations.<br>As for any story it would be good to know who’s behind the pencil. Or keyboard in this instance.<br><br>To introduce myself, my name is Zellenah. Born on Haltar under the family name Cross.<br>For those who are unaware, Haltar is likely one of the wealthiest moons still remaining in our region.<br>First, an agreement. Then the golden flame. Foolish to have gotten involved.<br>Our father couldn’t keep the political talk to himself so I’ve become rather educated on the conflict.<br><br>I feel I am already losing the path. Where was I? Ah yes.<br>For the greater part of my life I have spent mindlessly staring at golden halls and sipping the most elegant vintages while relatives endlessly discuss their fortunes with a devotion I could not understand. We’ve always gone on the same trips and visited the same fountains. I couldn’t convey how often I’ve seen the gemstone waters.<br>You could say I’ve always had more of an explorative trait. The predictability of it all became rather stifling. The people are kind, but perhaps a touch soulless. All they conversed about was their wealth and what grandiose places they visited. I found it to be rather dull. Terribly underwhelming. I fear the normality of it all has greatly impacted my joy of what were seemingly magnificent things.<br><br>I found myself unwilling to accept such predictability so I left for a few trips outside of our usual experiences.<br>A majority of the places I went to were fresh, unique. Often whelming as I had witnessed the same before but on a grander scale.<br><br>Then, during one of these visits there were these magnetized pebbles. Not too extraordinary I believe we have all seen magnets before. But these pebbles, when they touched they would brighten up. Not only brighten up, they would share a light that traveled between them. Now that was lovely. I had never seen that before. Truly magnificent. I still have them somewhere I am quite certain. Perhaps in one of my drawers with the crystals which pacifies insects with a soft drone, another magical find.<br>Either way I put on a glove and took a hand full of them back to the manor.<br>From then on all I ever wanted was to collect more of these interesting objects.<br>Indeed I did. I went on many trips following this initial find.<br>I had gathered plentiful mistiques. It had gotten to a point where they were turning my manors into a dreadful mess.<br>There was a terrible need for a place to put these things. And that’s when I came with the idea of the gallery. A gallery of uniquities.<br>I wouldn’t want it to be back on Haltar, you could display something magnificent and they wouldn’t even lift their glasses.<br><br>This place looks delightful and happens to be right in the center of everything. Nearly too good to be true.<br>So I acquired this small moon and began planning out the gallery.<br>A few months pass and now we are here.<br><br>I appreciate your reading. I find it incredibly relaxing to write.<br>Perhaps I might write some more in the future.}}
|}

==== Company Trouble ====
{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
!Text {{pad|0.5em|}}
|-
|{{Story Log Text|I desire to write again following today's frightful ordeal.<br>It was in the early morning when the trouble began. I had woken up from an annoyingly repetitive beeping coming from my computer. And so I had a gaze at what happened to be a message. It was deeply unsettling.<br>It read as follows: <br>“The celestial body designated [98 Galetry] falls under company territory and is marked for collection. Agree to our terms or leave immediately.”.<br>Of course I took this sudden message very dear. It had appeared to be rather important though a bit distasteful. So as with any message of seemingly grave importance like this I had informed them, in terms perhaps less diplomatic than advisable, that I had no interest in their proposal.<br><br>Not much time had passed and I heard this charming jingle of an elevator of sorts followed by an explosion. Immediately I put on my gloves and armed myself with an antique blade in hopes it would scare away whoever had impolitely seared my front yard. Or at the very least offer me the confidence to confront them.<br><br>To my surprise there was nobody there. Only the wind, a dull quietness and a pod with a big gap presumably from the explosion.<br>Then to my surprise, a dreadful swarm of hornets attacked me. I ran away as fast as I could and locked myself in my bed chamber.<br>Then I remembered those droning crystals. Unsure where I had left them I began searching. It had taken me a fair moment but in the end I discovered them to be in a small box in one of my closets. I took out a few and slowly opened the door. Nothing in the hallway. Quite curious. I slowly made my way along the gallery towards the entrance, not a hornet in sight. Then to my surprise there was a bulging man standing in the grass. He quietly gazed at me. To my knowledge I was alone, there hadn’t been any visitors in days. I yelled out to him. No response. Frightening. I took a step back. Then he seemed to search for something in his tailor coat. Before long he ran at me holding a shimmering knife. Having neither a plan or any courage in that moment I instinctively held out the small bag of crystals between us. To my surprise this bloated man seemed enamored by them. Staring soullessly into the bag. Only then it dawned on me, this was not an ordinary man at all, but a deteriorating arrangement of skin and cloth piloted by these hornets. The dreadful smell only confirmed that. Terrifying discovery yet I must admit in a way quite divine.<br>I had led him to the back room as he followed the bag of crystals. As I had no proper placement for this ominous gentleman, I elected to leave him where he was. I don’t think he minds that much.<br><br>Finally I return to my computer only to find it beeping once more. A new message.<br>“You have received your first and only warning, The celestial body designated [98 Galetry] falls under company territory and is marked for collection. Agree to our terms or leave immediately.”<br>I was left with a choice and perhaps in an act of fear I agreed.<br><br>As long as I help their workers ship the things they found to Gordion without interrupting their work, I should be left alone.<br>I’m hopeful.}}
|}

==== Intruder ====
{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
!Text {{pad|0.5em|}}
|-
|{{Story Log Text|There has been a fair passage of time between now and the previous time I have written.<br>I had not expected this arrangement would prove so demanding. It feels as though every few days a new ship arrives at my door, not to be enamored by the mystiques of my gallery but rather to dispose of the debris they have gathered.<br>I have attempted to inquire about their work yet they seem either hesitant to explain or convey that they know as much as I do.<br>Either way, I have made the wise decision to automate the process of exporting these worthless pieces to Gordion. I cannot imagine taking care of such matters personally without leaving me exhausted.<br><br>There has however been one thing I became aware of regarding this mysterious company. They do not take kindly to their employees and demand them work an absurd amount where failure appears to be met with termination in the quite literal sense.<br>I have always been aware of the cruelty within this region from the tales but I had never imagined it to be this terrible. Not until I met this gentleman of the name Marcus Brad.<br><br>I wouldn't say it was the most pleasant of encounters.<br>This company ship had landed and were doing their own usual business. I on the other hand was altering some of the displays, not quite paying the attention to my surroundings as I likely should have.<br>Upon turning, I discovered an armed stranger silently standing a few paces behind me, which in honesty I found considerably less pleasant than the display I had been arranging moments earlier. It was quite alarming even and my response was rather lacking. He demanded that I help him with his harrowing situation which, at the time, I wasn’t aware of how bad it was. His suit appeared worn, bloodied with a scorch mark covering the left side of his helmet. An intimidating figure.<br>I exclaimed I wouldn’t know how and even if I did there would be a chance this mysterious company would return with evil intent.<br>He appeared serious, slightly frustrated even. Still pointing the weapon in my direction I attempted to politely ask for his name and how I could be of service.<br>“My name is Marcus.”, he replied. “I have survived this company for at least five weeks now. You wouldn’t believe what they put us through. You need to help me escape them. Sooner or later they will try to kill me again.”. This ominous response left me curious and so I tried to inquire what exactly he meant with, they will try to kill him again. He replied: “We have a quota we have to meet every few days. It keeps getting higher every time we succeed. I don’t believe it stops. It gets higher and higher until it’s impossible to reach. What happens if we don’t meet the quota? We die. The ship enters space and opens the doors sucking us into space to die an excruciating death. I survived this once, only because I could crawl into this airtight space within the ship’s internals before the doors opened and.. Took the others.”.<br>I was stunned by this news. I confess I initially expected exaggeration.<br>I could now sense that it wasn’t frustration in his voice but desperation. Perhaps a hint of sadness and dread.<br>I offered a proposal, if he’s able to find and bring me uniquities or antiquities. I would search for a way of hiding him from and possibly tricking this company. Which he accepted.<br><br>Since that eye opening encounter I have had a security system installed at the counter in case somebody deranged comes upon me with malicious intent.<br>So it appears for now I will be keeping myself busy with devising a plan alongside some other research I have been doing.<br>I am certain I will write again.}}

== > Trivia ==
=== Spooky Galetry ===
When the player's device clock and date is set to October, '''Galetry''' will turn spooky for Halloween. Several candles, cobwebs, pumpkins, and skulls will decorate the buildings, some of the lighting in the buildings will turn purple and green, the sky will turn purple, and the waterfall will turn green. The '''Teach the disloyal videotape''' will also spawn next to some pumpkins at the top of the staircase near the projector.

######## Gilded Jester
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title= Gilded Jester
|images=
Gilded Jester Boxed.jpg:In-Game (Boxed),
Gilded Jester Popped.jpg:In-Game (Popped)
|Variant Of= Jester
|Internal ID= GoldenJester
|Max Count= 1
|Power Level= 3
|Cause of Death= Mauling
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= Unkillable
|Damage= Instant Kill
|Door Speed Multiplier= 0.5
|Stun Time Multiplier= 0.6
}}

The '''Gilded Jester''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Jester Jester] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is a golden jack-in-the-box with two legs, an arm, and an image of a skull on its center. When it pops open, a golden skull connected to several cables comes out of the box.

== > Mechanics ==
Similar to the Jester, the '''Gilded Jester''' will roam around the interior until it spots a player. It will then follow that player before beginning to crank itself. After it finishes cranking, the box will pop open and the '''Gilded Jester''' will attempt to chase and instantly kill the closest player on contact. It will get faster the longer it chases players, but its speed will reset after it kills an employee or it is stunned. The '''Gilded Jester''' will only close its box and begin roaming again once all players have left the interior.

The '''Gilded Jester''' has a much faster roaming and following speed and a much longer countdown before it begins cranking compared to the Jester. However, its cranking duration is significantly shorter. In singleplayer, it has a countdown of 80 to 100 seconds before it starts cranking and a cranking duration of 10 to 15 seconds.

== > Spawn Chances ==
The '''Gilded Jester''' has a 45.35% chance to spawn in the interior of [[Empra|'''Empra''']], typically spawning near the start of the day due to the interior spawn curve.

== > Bestiary Entry ==
The entry for the '''Gilded Jester''' is the same as the Jester.

{{TOC left}}

Across the polar ocean of [[Polarus|'''Polarus''']] lies the area named '''Glace'''. Originally a labratory to study the local wildlife. Now an abandoned building due to the frequent.. vibrations and disturbances within the facility. Perhaps this lab was built near something large and aggressive. High value items remain inside.

== > Moon Map ==

== > Moon Info ==

{{Moon Info|Sacrificed/Deceased.|Cold, icy terrain, supports plant life.|A balanced ecosystem, creatures support very agressive behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==

== > Weather ==
Glace supports Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, and Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Elevator ===
To the left and north of the ship is an elevator that can be used to transport between the upper and lower level of the moon's exterior.

=== Major Story Spoilers: Decision Aftermath ===
{{spoiler|If players decided to overload and blow up [[ResearcherxB|'''ResearcherxB''']], debris from the ship can fall onto Glace's exterior. If players land on Glace in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and [[Infected Bunker Spider|'''Infected Bunker Spiders''']] will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.}}

== > Environment ==

== > Weather ==
Glimmer supports Eclipsed and Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
The player's clock is hidden while on Glimmer. However, time progresses at its normal speed.

Glimmer's interior features stalks of cosmic growth that can act as obstructions and map hazards called "Watchers". They look around the area they are facing toward and will deal 4 damage per hit to players caught in their gaze. If an apparatus related event is triggered, all Watchers will be angered and look around faster.

{{TOC left}}

The giant forests of '''Gloom''' remained untouched for many years. That was until a logging company decided it to be the perfect place to exploit. But little did they know that these forests were.. Protected.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Gloomtopview.jpg|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Missing.|Cold moist terrain, roofed trees present.|A flowering ecosystem, agressive behaviour present.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}
'''Gloom''' environment

== > Weather ==
Gloom can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==

=== Outside Ambience ===
On Gloom you can hear ambience that plays outside.

==== Outside Ambience ====
[[File:Gloom spooky ambience.wav]]

=== Time Multiplier ===
The player's clock is hidden while on Gloom. However, time progresses at its normal speed.

=== Gloom's Fog ===
Gloom's exterior and interior has a foggy-like effect that reduces visibility. The interior fog can increase or decrease in intensity throughout the day.

=== Gloom's Map & Detonator ===
{|
|[[File:Gloommap.png|right|border|frameless|350px]]In the cave where the main entrance can be found, a map displays the location of all cave entrances and has a X on it.<br>This X is a detonator that is located next to one of cabins (fire exits) on the exterior. The easiest way to reach it is to walk almost directly southwest from the ship and then follow the lanterns to the detonator. Pushing this detonator causes two fire exits, which are the left most and right most cave entrances on the map respectively, to become accessible from the exterior. However, pushing this detonator also causes a cave-in that renders the main entrance and the cave it's in to be inaccessible from the exterior.
|}

=== Altar (Mysterious Object's Slot) ===
Gloom's exterior also has an altar where a mysterious object can be placed. To reach it, follow the pathway behind the ship and walk along the edge of the water, turn left near the big tree and walk towards a lantern, turn right and walk to the second lantern, and walk a little straight and turn left past the second lantern. This mysterious object is {{spoiler|a '''Brooding seed''' that can be found in a hidden chamber on the exterior of [[Berunah|'''Berunah''']]. Placing the seed will cause a warning message to appear that says "A Cosmic Entity of unknown power has turned it's focus towards this planet".}}

{{spoiler|This dramatically alters the terrain on the exterior, causes several tentacles to appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, visually alters the interior, and causes the [[Assimilated_Growth|'''Assimilated Growth''']] to almost immediately spawn in the interior when landing on the moon in the future. This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of [[Etern|'''Etern''']], [[Filitrios|'''Filitrios''']], [[Fission-C|'''Fission-C''']], and [[Utril|'''Utril''']], in which case the changes become permanent on that save file.}}

######## Gold Disturbed Masked
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Gold Disturbed Masked
|images=
Gold Disturbed Masked.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Masked
|Internal ID= GoldDisturbedMasked<br>PlayerEnemy 1
|Max Count= 10
|Power Level= 1
|Cause of Death= Strangulation
|Is Body Recoverable?= No

|Health= 20
|Damage= Instant Kill
|Door Speed Multiplier= 2
|Stun Time Multiplier= 0.75
}}

The '''Gold Disturbed Masked''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Masked Masked] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is an employee with a '''Gold disturbed''' mask attached to their face.

== > Mechanics ==
Identical to a regular Masked, the '''Gold Disturbed Masked''' will roam around in search of players. It looks similar to a normal player on the radar but will often be seen spinning around. It will look around, sprint, and stop sprinting randomly. If no player is within the interior, it will try to reach the main entrance and exit onto the exterior and vice versa. It will also make its way to the ship after some time to hide and wait for players to return to ambush them.

If a '''Gold Disturbed Masked''' spots a player, it will pause before beginning to chase them. If a player comes into contact with it, they'll be grabbed and the '''Gold Disturbed Masked''' will try to convert them. This can be interrupted if the '''Gold Disturbed Masked''' is hit. Otherwise, the player will die, their body and any scrap they were holding can not be recovered, and a second '''Gold Disturbed Masked''' will spawn.

== > Spawn Conditions ==
An initial '''Gold Disturbed Masked''' will only be spawned if a player wears and randomly gets possessed by the '''Gold disturbed''' scrap that is a potential [[Toy_Store#Rewards|'''Secondary Objective Reward''']] from the '''Toy Store'''.

######## Grand Armory
[[File:Armorymainentrance.jpg|thumb|The main entrance of the Grand Armory.]]
The '''Grand Armory''' is a large arsenal that most commonly spawns on [[Selector]]. The Grand Armory is quite spacious, having large open rooms and five floors with stairs and elevators connecting them. The main entrance is always accompanied by two lamps on either side of the door.

== > Rooms ==
*'''Missile Container''' - A platform that spawns close to the main entrance with a missile in a container. This container can be opened after completing a [[Grand_Armory#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objective''']].
*'''Server Rooms''' - Enclosed rooms with a light on top of them, often containing lockers and lots of scrap. These rooms have a lever that can be turned off to shut down the power to that room, making the light on top green instead of yellow. This can be used as a helpful indicator that a room has already been looted.
*'''Shipping Containers''' - Some shipping container doors can be opened. These containers are typically on the ground floor.
*'''Cold Storage''' - A cold storage room where scrap can spawn. Can connect to either a dead end with a possible '''Lurker''' at the end of it or can connect to [[Grand_Armory#>_Event:_The_Exterminator|'''The Exterminator''']] event.
*'''Liquid Area''' - A large portion of the armory that has various platforms connected over liquid. A larger '''Server Room''' typically spawns in this area.
*'''Charging Station''' - A room similar to a '''Server Room''' but with a powered off apparatus outside of it and a charge station inside of it. Typically spawns in the '''Liquid Area'''.
*'''Toxic Apparatus''' - A green apparatus that typically spawns on a grated platform, typically in the '''Liquid Area'''. It is worth ▮280, is two-handed, and weighs 31lbs. Taking the apparatus will trigger a '''Lockdown'''.

== > Interior Features ==
*'''Elevator''' - An elevator near the main entrance can be used to go between different floors with the push of a button.
*'''Breaker Box''' - When turning off multiple switches on the breaker box, the lights will turn red and begin to play alarm sound. This primarily makes it easier to find '''Server Rooms''', and the light will remain green if the power is turned off to that room even with the breaker box off. 
*The '''Liquid''' in the Grand Armory changes based on the moon it spawns on.

== > Hazards ==
*'''Lockdown''' - when the apparatus is pulled, the separate platform it is on, if any, will fall into the liquid below. All fire exit doors will become locked and only accessible via the exterior, meaning the only way to get out is through the main entrance. The ceiling will be revealed to have spikes on it and begin to fall slowly, sometimes dropping a significant distance or increasing and decreasing in speed. If a player comes into contact with the top of the ceiling, they will be crushed for 999 damage. Once the ceiling has reached the floor, it will shortly rise back up and make the interior accessible again. However, the fire exit doors will remain locked.
*'''Swinging Hook''' - A hook that swings back and forth, dealing 25 damage to any player that comes into contact with the sharp point.
*'''Lurker''' - A hazard that sits behind a set of double doors, occasionally peeping out. If a player is in its line of sight, the doors will open revealing a flamethrower that will rapidly deal 10 damage per hit to players and entities. 
*'''Liquid''' - Pools of hazardous liquid that emit a soft glow. What this liquid does varies. For example, the regular acid pools deal 999 damage per hit to a player that falls into them. Some act as quicksand. Regardless, falling into them usually results in death.

== > Secondary Objectives ==
[[File:GrandArmoryMissile.jpg|thumb|The Missile Container that holds the reward.]]One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn in the '''Missile Container'''.

=== Radio Signals ===
If there is a red light on the satellite dish, players need to tune the radio frequencies. This can be done by finding cases with a dial on them inside '''Server Rooms''' with a small yellow light on them. The dial must be repeatedly turned until the sounds match each other and players must hit the green button when they match.

Once all three frequencies are properly tuned, a sound effect will play and players can return to the '''Missile Container''' to get their reward.

=== Code Input ===
If the numbered button panel has a red light, players must find the '''Charging Station''' in the interior. Inside will be a sticky note on a cabinet that says a four digit code. Players can then return to the '''Missile Container''', input the correct code, and get their reward.

=== Communications ===
If both lights on the main panel are red, players must find a '''Shipping Container''' with a small yellow light on it. Inside that container will be a board of morse code and a device to input a code. Players must listen to the morse code sequence and determine what the code is by following the board. A circle indicates a short beep and a dash indicates a long beep. One strategy players can use is to only count and listen for when long beeps happen, as they are easier to discern from multiple short beeps.

After inputting the correct code, players can press an emergency button to the right. A sound effect will play and players can return to the '''Missile Container''' to get their reward.

The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Mechanics#Furniture_luck the vanilla luck system]. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. '''Code Input''' is considered Easy difficulty and has a 1.0x multiplier, '''Radio Signals''' is considered Medium difficulty and has a 1.15x multiplier, and '''Communications''' is considered Hard difficulty and has a 1.4x multiplier. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

== > Event: The Exterminator ==
[[File:GrandArmoryExterminator.jpg|thumb|The Exterminator revealing itself.]]'''The Exterminator''' can randomly generate connected to a '''Cold Storage''' room. At the end of a grated hallway lies a caged area with five '''Skinned Thumpers''' hanging from hooks and an '''Advanced nightstick''' on the ground. Once any player enters far enough into this room, a door will abruptly shut behind them, the lights will flicker, the center thumper will be slammed to the ground, and all thumpers will be risen up into the ceiling.

'''The Exterminator''' will then reveal itself at the front of and outside of the arena, resembling a much larger '''Lurker'''. Shortly afterward, a [[Skinned Thumper|'''Skinned Thumper''']] will be dropped into the arena. This is a variant of the Thumper with 12hp. The '''Advanced nightstick''' can be swung as a weapon with the additional property of stunning enemies for a short duration, making fighting the '''Skinned Thumper''' significantly easier. When a '''Skinned Thumper''' is killed, another '''Skinned Thumper''' will shortly be dropped into the arena and players must kill four of them in total.

While the player fights the '''Skinned Thumpers''', '''The Exterminator''' will be moving around the arena and attempting to attack players with four different attacks:
*'''Flamethrower''' - '''The Exterminator''' will open up one claw near the roof and begin spraying a flamethrower that tracks a player. It will rapidly deal 5 damage per hit to any player caught in it.
*'''Dual Flamethrower''' - '''The Exterminator''' will open up two claws near the roof and begin spraying a flamethrower from both, moving in a straight line across the arena. These flamethrowers will rapidly deal 10 damage per hit to players.
*'''Fan''' - '''The Exterminator''' will begin spinning a larger claw and slowly lowering it into the center of the arena, although it also loosely tracks a player. This fan will deal 999 damage per hit to any player hit by it while its spinning.
*'''Saws''' - '''The Exterminator''' will lower three sets of giant saws into and at the edge of the arena, moving them across the arena in a straight line. Any player that touches the blades will take 999 damage per hit.

If players successfully kill all four '''Skinned Thumpers''' while surviving '''The Exterminator''', the fifth and larger '''Skinned Thumper''', now engulfed in flames, will shortly be dropped into the arena. It will ignore players and immediately run straight into the door that shut behind players when they entered the arena, dying and slightly popping it open. '''The Exterminator''' will begin one final attack by opening up five claws at the front of the arena and spewing flames from all of them, slowly moving them toward the back of the arena. These flames rapidly deal 80 damage per hit and players must interact with the door to open it and escape the arena before these flames reach them.

The reward for this event is the '''Advanced nightstick''' players used to fight the '''Skinned Thumpers''', ranging from ▮192 to ▮329. The primary appeal of this scrap is that it doubles as both a weapon and a stunning tool. It has approximately a 2s base stun duration, slightly better than a Radar-booster's stun, and also weighs significantly less than a Shovel at only 2lbs. However, it can not be put in a Belt bag and both its value and rarity as an event reward makes losing it significantly more impactful.

{{TOC left}}

'''Gratar''' was known for housing the biggest factory in the solar system. The whole facility was controlled by an AI made by a fantastic inventor last seen on Etern. As of recent, legend has it that the AI on Gratar has gone rogue.

== > Moon Map ==
{{Maps|Gratar}}

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Killed.|Warm, dry dirt terrain, supports plant life such as Fabaceae.|A thriving Avian ecosystem, creatures support agressive behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
'''Gratar''' has several dirt mountains that extrude from a vast ocean below. Multiple waterfalls can also be seen falling down from the taller mountains around the exterior. The terrain itself is covered in bushes, grass, and trees. Bridges and ladders with lights nearby can be used for navigation and traversal.

Several concrete structures and parts of the factory are visibile on the exterior, some of which are either the main entrance or fire exits. The main entrance is on top of the hill in front of the ship and across the bridge. Two fire exits are visibile to the northeast and southwest from the ship as well. The last regular fire exit is at the top of the hill to the left of the ship and requires either the cruiser (not recommended), two extension ladders, or a jetpack to reach from the exterior.

=== Exterior Ambience ===
[[File:Gratar outside loop.wav]]

== > Weather ==
'''Gratar''' can experience Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, or Forsaken weather by default.

When '''Gratar''' is Flooded, large trees and branches will be present on the exterior, mainly in the middle of the moon. This does not affect any existing pathways or the moveable bridge, but does create new potential pathways for players to use.
<!-- I am unable to replicate this path in Obscurity.
The main new passage allows for skilled players to traverse from the disconnected fire exits back to the main part of the map, which involves scaling around one of the hills to get onto the tree's bark and making your way along it from there.
-->

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Interior Content and G. A. R. Y. ===
In the interior, the lights are red, the rogue AI, '''G. A. R. Y.''', can be heard in the background, and the AI will play various voicelines. These voicelines can be used as a rough indicator for how much time has past, as most of them play roughly every 45-60 seconds, or every 1-1.5 hours of in-game time, while a player is inside the interior. Some additional lines are played when various things happen within the interior, such as the lights turning on or off.

==== Interior Ambience and Voicelines ====
[[File:Gratar inside loop 2.mp3]]

=== Broken Bridge ===
A broken bridge to the left of the main entrance can be pushed. Pushing the bridge will move it towards the right side of the ship temporarily before it falls into the water below, making it a one-time use. Players can stand on and place scrap on the bridge, so it can be useful for quickly getting scrap from the main entrance back to the ship or avoiding entities later in the day.

=== Fire Exits ===
Two lone fire exits can be found within the interior that lead to an area on the exterior where both of these fire exits are connected by a bridge. A natural fog surrounds this area when on the bridge or approaching it, but the bridge can be seen a little behind and to the right of the ship. This area is accessible via jetpack.

=== Special Room ===
A blue fire exit can also be found to the side of the main entrance that leads to a fabrication machine. Players can deposit [[Items#Ingredient_Items|'''Ingredient Items''']] into the machine to craft '''Untampered operating panels''', '''Triangulation devices''', '''Double barrel shotguns''', '''Shotgun shells''', '''Adrenaline-stims''', '''Health-stims''', '''Pulatrum spore emitters''', '''Boomboxes''', '''Advanced flashlights''', '''Fog reducers''', '''Radar boosters''', '''Action figures''', '''Weed killer''', '''De-weed''', '''Pesticide sprinklers''', '''Fabricated keys''', and '''Single-barrel shotguns''' here. Note that there is a conversion rate for ingredients to resources (e.g., 1 '''Steel ingot''' equals 3 Steel), which is listed in the [[Items#Ingredient_Items|'''Ingredient Items''']] section mentioned above. Any ingredients deposited into the machine will be saved even if players are fired and {{spoiler|resources are shared with the machine on '''[[Galetry]]'''.}}

=== G. A. R. Y.'s Announcement ===
[[File:GARY announcement.mp3]]

'''G. A. R. Y.''' makes an announcement on the exterior that it will soon perform a facility-wide decontamination at 09:00pm. At around 09:20pm, multiple explosions will occur at various areas, such as the main entrance and fire exits, that can also be heard within the interior. These explosions deal no damage to the player.

== > Lore ==
'''G. A. R. Y.''', the AI, was originally created by the scientist on '''[[Etern]]''' with the intention of finding the location of '''[[Cosmocos]]''' after it teleported. However, the AI was incapable of reciting the full location, either because the location was encrypted or because the AI was malfunctioning. It then got sold to be used by the company located on '''Gratar'''.

=== Accident Logs / Fatality Reports ===
'''Accident logs''' can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior. They are workplace accident reports logged by '''G. A. R. Y.''' that a manager is viewing. These accidents gradually become more dangerous, causing more and more fatalities, until it is revealed that '''G. A. R. Y.''' itself caused thousands of "workplace accidents" in a single day by powering up the turrets to kill everyone.

=== Cunningham's Visit ===
Additionally, '''Cunningham's visit''' can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior. It plays the conversation between Cunningham and '''G. A. R. Y.''' and Cunningham was able to trick '''G. A. R. Y.''' into revealing Cosmocos's location.

######## Greenhouse
[[File:Greenhousemainentrance.jpg|alt=The main entrance of the Greenhouse interior.|thumb|The main entrance of the Greenhouse interior.]]
The '''Greenhouse'''  is a botanical garden themed interior that only spawns commonly on [[Faith]] and [[Spine]]. This interior has a very rare chance to spawn on any moon.

== > Rooms ==

*'''Fields''' - The majority of the interior is covered in fields of corn. Scrap can spawn in specific and usually more open tiles here.
*'''Secure Greenhouse''' - A small greenhouse with a button next to it. Completing a [[Greenhouse#>_Secondary_Objectives|'''Secondary Objective''']] and pushing the button reveals a reward inside.
*'''Shipping Container''' - An interactable shipping container that spawns in the '''Fields'''. The door to open it can be locked and the container can have scrap inside it.
*'''Gazebos''' - Multiple Gazebos are scattered throughout the '''Fields'''. Scrap can spawn around or under them. The breaker box also spawns attached to one.
*'''Greenhouse''' - The garden is a larger, interconnected structure that has various plants inside. Scrap can spawn here on the floor or on shelves.
*'''Plasma Apparatus''' - A blue apparatus hooked up to a machine that powers the entire facility. It generates somewhere in the '''Fields''', is conductive, weighs 31lbs, and is worth ▮95.

== > Interior Features ==
*'''Decontamination''' - When the apparatus is pulled, an alert and countdown for "decontamination" will begin. Afterward, all the sprinklers found within the '''Fields''' will activate and begin to spray flames and turn left about 90 degrees. They rapidly deal 6 damage per hit to the player and this decontamination lasts for about 45 seconds. This burns the corn and causes the interior to become smoky with a foggy-like effect.

== > Hazards ==
*'''Sprinklers''' - Starting at 12:00pm, the sprinkler system on the roof of the interior will begin to activate every three hours. A loud buzzer will be heard three times before activation, most of the lights will turn red, and acidic pesticide will begin to rain down for about 10 seconds. This quickly deals 3 damage per hit to the player and the player must find cover to avoid taking damage. 

== > Secondary Objectives ==
[[File:GreenhouseSecureGreenhouse.jpg|thumb|The Secure Greenhouse.]]One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that will spawn in the '''Secure Greenhouse'''.

=== Power the Towers ===
If the sticky note next to the button to open the '''Secure Greenhouse''' says "POWER", players must find and turn on four towers in the '''Fields'''. A panel will be attached to each tower with several switches. Each switch turns off or on different switches in a specific pattern, but the pattern generated is random. Players must turn all the switches green and both a sound effect will play and the tower will begin to glow red if players are successful.

After players turn on all four towers, a sound effect will play and they can return to the '''Secure Greenhouse''' to open the door for their reward.

=== Stabilise the Water Pressure ===
If the sticky note next to the button to open the '''Secure Greenhouse''' says "PRESSURE", players must find the water pressure in the '''Greenhouse'''. A discernable hum will play when players are nearby this tile and there will be several panels with a button on them to interact with.

Players must keep every panel above the first red line but below the second red line to stabilise the pressure. Each time players successfully get every panel to this threshold, the pressure will stabilize. The fastest way to do this is to find the two panels that decrease pressure at the quickest rate and keep them near the first red line to constantly push it back up to the correct threshold. Other panels must be adjusted as needed and discernable click sound effects will happen when each panel goes above or below a specific threshold.

Once players have stabilized the pressure enough, all the panels will settle at a specific pressure and a sound effect will play. Players can now return to the '''Secure Greenhouse''' and open the door for their reward.

=== Burn the Blatodara ===
If the sticky note next to the button to open the '''Secure Greenhouse''' says "KILL", players must burn groups of Blatodara in the '''Fields'''. These bugs are incredibly loud and relatively easy to find. To kill the bugs, players must interact with them while holding a '''Match''' in their hand, which is scrap that also spawns in the '''Fields'''. A group of Blatodara can be interacted with five times each and players must use 15 matches in total. Alternatively, players can pull the '''Plasma Apparatus''' to cause '''Decontamination''' to burn every Blatodara.

Once at least 15 Blatodara are burned, players can return to the '''Secure Greenhouse''' and open the door for their reward.

=== Rewards ===

The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Mechanics#Furniture_luck the vanilla luck system]. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. '''Stabilise the Water Pressure''' is considered Easy difficulty and has a 1.0x multiplier, '''Power the Towers''' is considered Medium difficulty and has a 1.15x multiplier, and '''Burn the Blatodara''' is considered Hard difficulty and has a 1.4x multiplier. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

== > Event: Blatodara Swarm ==
[[File:GreenhouseBlatodaraSwarm.jpg|thumb|The Blatodara Swarm.]]A large gazebo with a hole and pot next to the hole can be found either in the '''Fields''' or adjacent to the main entrance. After interacting with and pushing the pot into the hole, the '''Blatodara Swarm''' will be angered, rise from the hole, and cause walls to rise up and trap players inside.

Players must enable the four acid sprayers in the corners of the arena. To do so, players must turn all the switches on the panel attached to the the sprayer green. Each switch turns off or on another switch in a specific pattern, but the pattern generated is random. If successful, the acid sprayer will turn on.

The '''Blatodara Swarm''' deals 8 damage per hit to players that come into contact with it. The '''Blatodara Swarm''' will additionally form arms and hands to attempt to hit players with four different attacks:
*'''Sweep''' - The '''Blatodara Swarm''' will sweep a hand slowly around two sprinklers, dealing 8 damage per hit to players that come in contact with it.
*'''Spin''' - The '''Blatodara Swarm''' will spin three arms around the arena in one direction before spinning them in the other direction, dealing 8 damage per hit to players that come into contact with them.
*'''Slam''' - The '''Blatodara Swarm''' will repeatedly slam three of its hands to the ground and create small aftershocks, dealing 15 damage per hit to players that come into contact with either.
*'''Smack''' - The '''Blatodara Swarm''' will smack one of the acid sprayer panels, resetting it and dealing 8 damage per hit to players. There currently might be a softlock where the '''Blatodara Swarm''' can attack an inactive acid sprayer and cause it to effectively be disabled the entire fight despite players still being able to turn it on.

A relatively safe way to avoid most attacks or avoid accumulating too much damage is to crouch in the corners of the arena. Players can also jump onto the acid sprayers and jump above attacks like the '''Sweep''' and '''Spin'''. An extension ladder can be repeatedly placed near a wall and climbed to avoid all attacks as well.

After players keep the sprayers on for long enough and keep turning them back on after the '''Blatodara Swarm''' disables them, the '''Blatodara Swarm''' will violently explode and scatter. Afterward, the '''Blatodara commander''' can be found on the ground. This is the reward for the event. It is not conductive, weighs 0lbs, and is worth ▮196 to ▮239.
