######## Guidebook
{{TOC left}}
== Welcome To Wesley's Moons! ==
Hello! Welcome to the guidebook for Wesley's Moons. This should help point you in the right direction for getting started and advancing.

== Basics ==
=== Galetry & Videotapes ===
In the beginning of the mod, you'd have likely noticed you have currently one moon from the mod unlocked alongside all the vanilla moons. Routing to this moon, [[Galetry]] provides access to the beginner moons of the mod. Inside, you'll find the tapes for {{spoiler|[[Motra]]}}, {{spoiler|[[Infernis]]}}, and {{spoiler|[[Asteroid-13]]}}. Bring these tapes up to the projector on the top-most floor, and the tape will play automatically. Take a seat and enjoy the video.<br><br>Now that you've watched your tape(s) you'll notice you unlocked the associated moon written on the tape's header side. You can now route there.<br><br>NOTE: <s>There is currently a bug in Multiplayer, non-host clients '''cannot see unlocked moons''' at the moment.</s>
(Fixed?*)

=== Loggable Items ===
Across the moons in the mod you'll notice Logs scattered through the map, They look like cassette players. To find these Logs, look for anything that might point you to it, they can tend to be surrounded by investigation equipment like floodlights and flares, if you start seeing tables and papers you are in the right area. These logs can then be carried to the Log Translator and translated into your ship's terminal. This is not the only effect however, in some instances, logs will provide a new route that you didn't previously have, this is not random. every log is set to provide something depending on which log it is.<br>These logs are not the only translatable item in the previously mentioned Log Translator. You can also log notes you find randomly in the [[interiors]] as Scrap.

== Progression ==
Unlike a lot of other moon mods, Wesley's Moons utilizes a roguelike structure for progression.<br><br>Note: Some people may not like this system and that's okay; You can disable progression in the Config if desired, otherwise leave it enabled for the intended gameplay.<br><br>Without getting into spoiler territory the basic idea is just to go from one moon to the next, collect any loggables you can find, rinse, repeat.

=== Progression - Moon Connections ===
If you don't mind spoilers and just want to unlock the moons in order you can find a full image of the progression tree [https://www.image2url.com/r2/default/images/1794206672305-6718e3ff-f744-4ff8-a081-5395cde2f97c.png here]  (Courtesy of WhiteA12, With help from Nagatonis), Log locations can be found on the maps provided in this wiki if help is needed.

== Mid-Game ==
So you've explored a good chunk of moons so far. "What do I do now?" I, Lambda hear you ask across the internet, Well something you might want to consider doing right now is searching for special '''Apparatuses'''.. Apparati? Ah Whatever

=== Mid-Game - Return to Galetry ===
If you didn't know, near the left-side of the stairs in the back of [[Galetry]] there's a ''Hoarding bug'' statue you can push, that folds the stairs, and pushes the case back revealing the true inside of Galetry. Don't freak out because its dark or because there's a butler, he's friendly, name's Butch, if you push on and find where the Apparatus slots are, you can turn the lights on. And if you look at the slots, you can see what they'll take. Can you find out where to find them?<br><br>NOTE: Yes the stairs CAN kill you.

=== Mid-Game - What Else? ===
Before you leave Galetry. You may want to take a right from the ship's door. There's a gift shop you can visit and buy some items.<br><br>Your main focus right now is trying to find those special Apparatuses and plug them into the slots in the back of galetry. You don't have to find all of them in one quota, you can take your time, if you plug one into the slot, it will remain there between visits to Galetry, go at your own pace.<br><br>The Following moons contain these apparatuses needed to unlock one of the final moons.
*{{spoiler|[[Demetrica]]}} - Bloody Apparatus
*{{spoiler|[[Cosmocos]]}} - Cosmic Apparatus
*{{spoiler|[[Calist]]}} - Royal Apparatus

== End-Game ==
You're approaching the ending! Congrats! This assumes you're at the point you're at the point that you now have access to {{spoiler|[[Hyx]]}}

=== End-Game - Find. That. Tape! ===
{{spoiler|[[Hyx]]}} is a dangerous moon, especially later. staying out of the ship in later parts of the day is essential, that crater in front of the ship is not for decoration.<br><br>Navigating {{spoiler|[[Hyx]]}} can be really hard especially for your first time, but walking forward from the ship, on the ridge allows you mostly direct access to the facility, you can also walk in the red substance without taking damage of any kind, as dangerous as it looks.<br><br>What you're looking for here at {{spoiler|[[Hyx]]}} is the {{spoiler|[[Empra]]}} Video tape. Which sports a spawn weight of 10, it is '''not''' guaranteed to spawn unlike some sources say.

== End-Game - Cont'd ==
Now that you got the tape and watched it back at Galetry, You need a minimum of 2500 credits to go that fancy new moon. Take your time, there's a certain scrap or two you're gonna want:
*A single normal apparatus, hold on to that
*A "Huge Harold", Don't question it

=== End-Game C'D - Return to Sender  ===
Now that you have both of these items, there's a store item you're going to want, hence why I said a "minimum" to route here, You'll want a jetpack. for a total of 3400, not including a discount on the jetpack.<br><br>Now that you have all of those, follow these steps, Courtesy of "ChaoticPyre" for writing the following section:
#{{spoiler|Plug an apparatus to the cart}}
#{{spoiler|Place the Huge Harold on the designated slot in the cart}}
#{{spoiler|Ride the cart into Empra's plaza}}
#{{spoiler|Redirect the mortar}}
#{{spoiler|Jetpack to the control tower}}
#{{spoiler|Fire the mortar from the control tower NOTE: Make sure every other crewmate is back home at the ship, this step can be fatal, you're safe up there.}}
#{{spoiler|Move the crane}}
#{{spoiler|Lift the tracks}}
#{{spoiler|Ride the cart back home, send it off, jump off, QUICK.}}
#{{spoiler|Drive the cart into the overseer and watch the fireworks and the ending cutscene.}}

== Conclusion ==
Now that you've officially beaten the moons, and watched that hell of a cutscene, you're now in freeplay, do whatever you want, make quotas and explore the other moons. When or if you're fired, you keep all of your moons, so if you get fired at any point you will keep your progress.<br><br>Have fun and best of luck.<br><br>- Absolute Lambda

######## Hailey Robertson

'''Hailey Robertson''', also referred to as just '''Hailey''', is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Ghost_Girl Ghost Girl] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. She resides in a coffin that opens to reveal her decayed corpse. She has hollowed out eyes, blonde hair, and a short blue dress.

== > Mechanics ==
There is little to no difference between the Ghost Girl and '''Haily Robertson'''. She will appear behind her targeted player accompanied by the sound of her coffin creaking, muffling the player's audio if they look at her. After her targeted player has looked at her at least twice or ignored her at least three times, approaching, looking, or staring at her can cause her to begin chasing that player. She will decapitate and instantly kill that player on contact.

While '''Hailey Robertson''' does have some possibly intentional instances of not being harmful to the player, such as her coffin showing up directly in the ship, she can be quite buggy. For example, she can sometimes get stuck and be visible moving in place on the exterior while trying to go after her targeted player. That said, it's better to be cautious when seeing her over assuming she is harmless.

== > Spawn Conditions ==
'''Hailey Robertson''' will begin haunting the player that picked up any of the [[Rubber_Rooms#Rewards|'''Secondary Objective Rewards''']] from the '''Rubber Rooms'''. Spooky sound effects will randomly be played followed by a message next to the player's stamina bar, which is '''Hailey Robertson''' speaking to them. This haunting persists across all moons barring moons like [[Galetry|'''Galetry''']] and [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Gordion Gordion].

Eventually, '''Hailey Robertson''' will announce her prescence with the player's screen turning red and getting a fear effect. This action spawns her as an entity. She will disappear upon returning to orbit. However, she can spawn once per reward grabbed and continue haunting players if multiple rewards are picked up. This can also apply if players pick up a medallion again after dropping it in the ship, typically after the save file is reloaded.

'''Heaps''' of trash, the largest disposal area in the region. A place housing disease, parasites and insects at a concentration higher than the most vile places. If you've ever lost something, there's a good chance its here. Disposed. Vanished. Rumors say it wasn't only used to dispose of trash but bodies too.

== > Moon Map ==

== > Moon Info ==

{{Moon Info|Abandoned.|Warm, moist, large amounts of trash.|A struggling ecosystem, dominated by insects.|}}

== > Environment ==
'''Heap''' is a massive landfill and its entire terrain is almost entirely covered in hills and mounds trash. Some of this trash includes cars with sometimes functional car alarms, shipping containers, etc. Rubble can be heard dislodging and falling from trash and breaking randomly as well.

Three large cranes can also be seen on the exterior and can be used as landmarkers to help in finding the three large buildings on the exterior, which are the main entrance and fire exits. The crane to the west and slightly south marks the main entrance, the crane to the northwest is to the left of a fire exit, and the hook of the crane to the southeast is placed roughly above another fire exit.

=== Outdoor Ambience ===
[[File:Etern_outside_loop.wav]]

== > Weather ==
'''Heap''' supports Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, and Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Mines ===
'''Heap''' naturally generates mines on its exterior. These mines begin beeping faster when a player enters its range and will explode if a player stays too close for too long. Players can safely trigger these mines without taking damage, but they can also deal 30 damage to players or instantly kill players and most entities depending on the proximity to the blast.

=== Major Story Spoilers: Falling Debris ===
{{spoiler|If players decided to overload and blow up [[ResearcherxB|'''ResearcherxB''']], debris from the ship can crash onto '''Heap's''' exterior near the main entrance. If players land on '''Heap''' in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and two [[Infected Bunker Spider|'''Infected Bunker Spiders''']] will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.}}

######## Honey Stinger
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Honey Stinger
|images=
Honey_Stinger.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Hoarding Bug
|Internal ID= HoneyStinger

|Cause of Death= Mauling
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= 3

}}

The '''Honey Stinger''' is a hostile or docile entity depending on how players interact with it and is a variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Hoarding_Bug Hoarding Bug] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is a large black and brown bee with a stinger, a pair of wings, four longer arms it uses to crawl around, and two shorter arms it uses to grab items.

== > Mechanics ==
While the '''Honey Stinger''' behaves very similarly to the Hoarding Bug for its Roaming, Guarding, and Attacking states, the '''Honey Stinger''' specifically only attempts to find and collect '''Bee hives'''. The '''Honey Stinger''' becomes more aggressive and territorial of its nesting area the more hives it collects. If several hives are collected, the '''Honey Stinger''' will often attack players it encounters on sight. The '''Honey Stinger''' deals 30 damage on contact in its Attacking state.

A '''Honey stinger treat''' is randomly available for purchase from the Gift Shop on [[Galetry|'''Galetry''']] for ▮520. It is not conductive, weighs 21lbs, is two-handed, and is worth ▮130. The tooltip mentions that it can be offered to the '''Honey Stinger''' as a treat and tribute. If players encounter a '''Honey Stinger''', they can drop the treat on the ground for it to collect. The '''Honey Stinger''' will become permanently happy and docile on that save file after collecting it, never attacking players and allowing players to safely take hives they have collected.

However, the tooltip also mentions that the '''Honey Stinger''' will remember if players betray it. Players can betray the '''Honey Stinger''' by directly attacking it, such as with a shovel. Indirect actions like dropping a conductive item to strike it down with lightning does not count as betrayal. If players do betray the '''Honey Stinger''', it will immediately aggro every time it encounters players on that save file.

{{TOC left}}

'''Hyve/Asteroid-14''' is home to the largest bee colonies in the region. Many companies have attempted to harvest honey from the massive beehives here. The locals however were not fond of intruders. 

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Hyve Overview.png|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Abandoned.. for good reason.|Rocky terrain highly populated by bee hives.|Bees, lots and lots of bees.|<br><br>Also known as Asteroid-14.}}

== > Environment ==
'''Hyve''' has rocky terrain with patches of tall brown grass, flowers, and an overwhelming number of bee hives that range from small to colossal in size. Several small lakes of honey can also be found around the exterior that generally hinder the movement speed of players, and this honey can be present in the interior depending on what interior is generated. The ecosystem is dominated by bees, including species like the [[Honey_Stinger|'''Honey Stinger''']], and they can be seen flying overhead or around their hives.

Buildings with hexagonal tiling resembling honeycombs can also be found around the exterior. The buildings northeast, southeast, and south of the ship are fire exits while the taller building northwest of and behind the ship is the main entrance.

== > Weather ==
'''Hyve''' can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

'''Hyve''' experiences a unique Foggy weather. A swarm of bees will continously surround players in a circular formation with a denser and darker shade of fog, though it being pitch black in some instances may be unintended. Though the bees will always follow the player, the fog can still be flown out of with a jetpack.

'''Hyve''' also experiences a unique Flooded weather. Instead of the water level rising throughout the day, a swarm of gigantic bees will move from the far right side to the far left side of the exterior throughout the day. Players that go too deep into this swarm of bees will rapidly take 3 damage per hit and have drastically reduced visibility. The player is not safe within the ship, and the bees envelop the ship around 04:00pm and pass at around 04:30pm. It is possible to fly over the bees safely with a jetpack.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside & Outside Ambience ===
On '''Hyve''' you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

[[File:Asteroid14 outside loop.wav]]

==== Inside Ambience ====

=== Large Hives ===
'''Hyve's''' exterior has many large hives that can be broken by driving '''the cruiser''' into them. This will spawn several additional Circuit Bees and hives that can be collected for scrap as usual. Breaking these hives can also spawn entities, such as '''Honey Stingers''' and '''Old Birds'''.

=== Interior's Unique Hazard ===
'''Hyve's''' interior has hives on pedestals that can not be collected as scrap. '''At 06:00pm''', bees begin expanding and contracting around this hive. Any player that steps within the area the bees are around will rapidly take '''3 damage per hit'''.

=== Major Story Spoilers: Decision Aftermath ===
{{spoiler|If players decided to overload and blow up [[ResearcherxB|'''ResearcherxB''']], debris from the ship can fall onto Hyve's exterior. If players land on Hyve in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and [[Infected Bunker Spider|'''Infected Bunker Spiders''']] will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.}}

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Assimilated.|Watched.|The Overseer is here.|}}

== > Environment ==
'''Hyx''' has been completely assimilated by '''The Overseer''', who can be seen floating above the moon looking down on players and moving as time progresses. The terrain is made up of yellow ish rocks, strange rock formations, a goopy red substance, and large craters scattered around the landscape. The goopy red substance is also part of the waterfall, river, and lakes and functions as quicksand. The south portion and end of the river has this quicksand trigger above the red goop, causing players to sink through the solid ground on the shoreline.

A forested area can also be found in the west portion of the moon, which is connected to the rest of the exterior by bridges. The trees have tendril-like growth coming out of them. The main entrance can be found west and slightly north of the ship in the forest, surrounded by strange glowing rocks. Three other buildings and fire exits can be found in the forest southwest, northwest, and north and slightly west of the ship. The last fire exit can be found southeast of the ship.

In Hyx's interior, several creatures and body parts can be found completely assimilated. They can be collected as scrap.

=== Hyx's Ambience ===
'''Hyx''' plays ambience in the background while on the exterior. '''The Overseer''' can also be heard on the exterior and in the interior.

== > Weather ==
'''Hyx''' can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, or Earthquakes weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
[[File:HyxOverseerDistant.jpg|thumb|The Overseer in the distance.]]
=== The Overseer ===
'''The Overseer''' can hear and feel players while they are on Hyx, progressively getting angrier as the day progresses and while players are running, using a jetpack, etc., on the exterior. Each time '''The Overseer''' is angered, he will roar and several tentacles will appear on the exterior.

Addtionally, '''The Overseer''' can randomly unleash colossal tentacles from the large craters of a red substance. These tentacles will target and track a player before slamming down. These tentacles have a hitbox on the bottom and top ends of the tentacle, making a portion of the center of the tentacle safe. Any player that comes into contact with these hitboxes will take 999 damage per hit. Excluding the ship, these tentacles can damage players through obstructions.

=== Assimilation ===
Hyx's interior has several hazards that mostly aid in Hyx's primary gimmick, '''Assimilation'''. This is functionally similar to [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Cadaver_Growth#Becoming_infected Cadaver Growth Infection], but it takes significantly longer at a baseline for '''Assimilation''' progress to reach 100%. Getting hit by most of Hyx's hazards also increases '''Assimilation''' progress significantly. Any player that does reach 100% '''Assimilation''' progress will shortly die and spawn an [[Assimilated_Employee|'''Assimilated Employeee''']], a variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Cadaver_Bloom Cadaver Bloom] with 28hp that similarly only takes 1 damage from all sources.

For a list of interior hazards:
*An [[Assimilated_Growth|'''Assimilated Growth''']] will immediately spawn in the interior upon landing. It is a variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Cadaver_Growth Cadaver Growth] that can not be destroyed and builds up '''Assimilation''' (infection) at a comparatively much slower rate.
*Sets of three tendrils coming out of a red substance and yellowish rock on the ground, dealing 15 damage per hit to players and building up '''Assimilation'''.
*Tentacles coming out of the floor, ceiling, and walls from yellowish rocks that deal 20 damage per hit to players that come into contact with them and build up '''Assimilation'''.
*Markings that look similar to a red X on yellowish rocks will lash out with tendrils when a player walks near them, dealing 15 damage per hit and building up '''Assimilation'''. These can deal upwards of 90 damage if a player stands in them for the full duration they're active.
*A small red circle on yellowish rocks will lash out with a tentacle and scan around the area when a player is near it, dealing 20 damage per hit. This hazard does not build up '''Assimilation''' on its own but does decrease player hp to speed up its progress.
*A red subtance will periodically fall from yellowish rocks on the ceiling to the floor. This substance deals 1 damage per hit to players and builds up '''Assimilation'''.

== > Lore ==
'''Hyx''' was originally advertised as a vacation destination to experience the wonders of nature. It has since been entirely "assimilated" by '''The Overseer''', a cosmic entity and the primary antagonist of Wesley's Moons.

=== Hyxellia Logs ===
These logs can be found by interacting with five '''Databoxes''' on the exterior. In order of the log number, these can be found at the main entrance, at the fire exit southeast of the ship, at the fire exit north and slightly west of the ship in the forest, southwest of the ship in the forest near one of the fire exits, and northeast of the ship near a lake. They document the full timeline of the moon's assimilation.

Rich was both intrigued and disgusted by the discovery and went looking for the source. He couldn’t find anything else out of the ordinary until he got to the stove. He was frightened by what he saw. It was a rat covered in tendrils with strange goop oozing from one of its empty eyesockets, bubbling and twitching as it did. Before Rich could fully understand what he was looking at, it scurried away, fleeing to someplace outside.<br>He was shaking and frantically called his employer before loosely explaining what happened.<br>Rich was quickly dismissed with the assumption of it being another one of his psychotic breaks.<br>Meaning to prove that what he witnessed was real, he went to chase it down, leaving a note for the other employees explaining where he went.<br>Rich followed the trail of goop through the town, into the forest all the way to the area where the fungus was spotted by hikers before. The fungus he had heard about has seemingly spread through a significant chunk of the forest.<br>As Rich wandered through the infested area, he laid eyes upon more of these critters in a similar condition. Witnessing this he got scared and ran back towards the bakery and told his coworkers, who had arrived by this time, what he had seen. To ensure they would believe him he had taken some pictures to show.<br>The coworkers seemed very concerned upon being shown the pictures. Similarly confused and disgusted they decided to investigate on their own, leaving Rich at the bakery, who at this time was still shaking.<br>An hour passed and Rich grew concerned, maybe they got lost, maybe they were still investigating, who knows. But he grew more and more concerned by the minute. Another hour later he finally made the decision to call the authorities. Fearing they’d dismiss him if he spoke the truth, he only said there was an emergency at the bakery. And there he stayed until an officer arrived.}}

This has to be reported, it has become a real anomaly he thought. It looked like it was trying to scream or yell but no sound erupted from its mouth. On his way back he found something else.<br>The missing employees laid there, lifeless on the hard rock surface. He called it in and told the other officers to head back. The employees were in a terrible condition, it looked like their limbs had torn themselves from their bodies, oozing out of their eyes and mouths. Witnessing this he ran back immediately and met up with the other officers in the bakery. This has quickly turned into a seemingly deadly fungal invasion.}}

==== The I.T.D.A. ====
{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
!Text {{pad|0.5em|}}

|{{Story Log Text|The Corruption of Hyxellia<br>—--------------------------------------<br>Documented timeline of recorded events since the initial meteoric impact.<br>The Beginning<br>The Employee<br>The Officer<br>> The I.T.D.A.<br>The Coverup<br>—--------------------------------------<br>[This a detailed construction of events put together through interviews and reports with those involved]<br><br>The I.T.D.A. - 7 days since impact.<br>—--------------------------------------<br>The town has been evacuated and all survivors involved have been brought in for questioning and isolation. The I.T.D.A. Has labeled this situation as critical and has begun quarantining the area. Nobody was allowed to enter or leave the quarantine zone. The military had been called in for additional security.<br>Several teams of experienced biologists and scientists had made it to the site to analyze and halt the anomalous threat. It was immediately proven not to be any sort of fungi but something else that had yet to be documented. This spread seemed to overtake whatever they put in front of it, consuming it entirely. Attempts of halting the spread were made such as burning it which only temporarily made the tendrils disappear. They had attempted several other chemical solutions to no avail. The closest they had gotten was by using a liquid which super freezes anything it comes into contact with. It only significantly slowed it down.<br>From this point several nearby towns were also evacuated as the spread and the quarantine area grew. Slowly but surely the area was becoming a wasteland.<br>It was discovered that direct contact with the substance could result in an infection which ends in a grueling eruption of tendrils, torn limbs and death.<br>The I.T.D.A. had officially labeled the spread as a world-ending level hazard. And as there have been no viable methods to halt the spreading or cure anyone infected. The I.T.D.A after a discussion with the Council of Rule on Calist, had marked Hyxellia as a moon in quarantine. Nobody could enter. Nobody could leave. Those who tried were either stopped or killed.<br>The population remaining on Hyxellia were scared, unable to send out or receive communication from a source outside of the moon, the only source they had were the I.T.D.A. which assured the public that the threat will be dealt with.<br>Biologists had well documented the workings of this spread which has gained the name “The Red Death”. In a detailed report it was documented how the red death consumed and spread:<br>The yellow rock-like material isn’t technically stone as many assumed but more similar to a very thick, dense, solidified skin. Instead of being stretchy, the density makes it much harder and rock-like. Below the yellow crust is a much softer meat-like material, this material is able to retract or expand, even move as if it’s one large living being organising its fleshy layer. This soft layer has seen to form these tentacles or tendrils for either defensive or even offensive measures. The spread itself is quite unique, these cells will attempt to eat whatever is around them and immediately replace the consumed material with a new cell. The process of consumption also generates this red substance. Drilling procedures have noted that deep inside the soft layer there’s large tunnels where the substance flows similar to our veins. The substance which gets generated doesn’t always end up within these veins, it often surfaces and forms large bubbles of goop below the crust, sometimes bursting through, leaving holes within the crust and forming large puddles of goop.<br>At the two week mark, the Red Death had consumed nearly half the moon. The cause seemed lost. This was the end times. Anyone still on Hyxellia was awaiting a horrible fate with no way of saving them.<br>Many military personnel as well as teams sent in by the I.T.D.A. have chosen to end their own lives to avoid a worse end.}}
|}

=== Translated Messages ===
'''Translated Messages''' can randomly be found as scrap within the interior and are translations of The Overseer talking about its plan and success in using the Emperor as a puppet ruler to cause a war and destabilize the region to continue assimilating worlds unimpeded. Although not mentioned in these logs, the "spark", or catalyst, was the Triton military's destruction of Calist ordered by Agent Geoffrey at the request of the Emperor after the Council of Rule refused to allow the study and usage of biological weapons.

== > Trivia ==
=== The Region Pillars ===
[[File:HyxPillarsLeft.jpg|thumb|300x300px|The left pillars with the KENJI, SFDESAT, DEMONMAE, STARLANCER, DELTA, GENERIC, and NIKKI REGIONS.]][[File:HyxPillarsRight.jpg|thumb|300x300px|The right Hyx pillars with the WESLEY, S1CKBOY, TOLIAN, LUNAR LIGHTS, ROSIE, V0XX, and HARVEST REGIONS.]]
Hyx's exterior has a set of stone pillars in the southwestern area of the forest with various regions and moon names inscribed on them. All of these are references to various Lethal Company mod developers and the moons they have created.
*[https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/ Kenji], who created the KENJI REGION with the [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/Kenjis_Moons/ Kenjis Moons] modpack containing the moons [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/476_Taldor/ Taldor], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/13_Dejection/ Dejection], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/84_Ascension/ Ascension], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/01_Lua/ Lua], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/65_Nostalgia/ Nostalgia], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/30_Row/ Row], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/42_Kiri/ Kiri], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/113_Kiln/ Kiln], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/164_Hollowed/ Hollowed], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/25_Manuland/ Manuland], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/74_Allure/ Allure], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/154_Thrive/ Thrive], and [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/rectorado/37_Alacrity/ Alacrity]. Wring, Broadkast, Constant, Collide, Checkpoint, Breach, Reposo, Gambit, Hush, and Devotion are not available on Thunderstore and might be unreleased or currently in development.
*[https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/sfDesat/ SFDesat], who created the SFDESAT REGION with the moons [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/sfDesat/Aquatis/ Aquatis], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/sfDesat/Celest/ Celest], and [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/sfDesat/Orion/ Orion]. Development has since been taken over by [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/Tolian/ Tolian].
*[https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/ DemonMae], who created the DEMONMAE REGION with the [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Moons_of_Otherworldly_Oddity/ Moons of Otherworldly Oddity] modpack containing the moons [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Halation_moon/ Halation], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Espira_moon/ Espira], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Mazon_moon/ Mazon], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Praetor_moon/ Praetor], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Rockwell_moon/ Rockwell], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Calypso_moon/ Calypso], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Makron_moon/ Makron], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Lithium_moon/ Lithium], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Baykal_moon/ Baykal], and [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Ultimatum_moon/ Ultimatum]. DemonMae also created the moon [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DemonMae/Flicker_moon/ Flicker].
*[https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/AudioKnight/ Audio Knight], who created the STARLANCER REGION with the [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/AudioKnight/StarlancerMoons/ StarlancerMoons] modpack containing the moons [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/AudioKnight/Auralis/ Auralis], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/AudioKnight/Triskelion/ Triskellion], [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/AudioKnight/Solace/ Solace], and [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/AudioKnight/StarlancerZero/ StarlancerZero]. 
*[https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/JacobG5/ JacobG5], who created the DELTA REGION with the moons [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/JacobG5/Pinnacle/ Pinnacle] and [https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/JacobG5/Elasticity/ Elasticity]. === Other Trivia ===
*Despite being in the [[Hyx#Enemy_Spawns_(Interior)| Enemy Spawns (Interior)]] table, [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Lasso_Man Lasso] can not spawn without commands or additional modification. Wesley has previously stated Lasso was added to a spawn table because it was funny, which likely applies here too, but Wesley also created a Jester variant called [[Lasso_Man|'''Lasso Man''']] and potentially added it to the table in the Obscurity update.
*Prior to the Obscurity update, Hyx's interior was grayscale.

######## Ice Leviathan
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox

|images=

The '''Ice Leviathan''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Earth_Leviathan Earth Leviathan] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is a brown, colossal, and long worm with a toothless and split jaw it opens to swallow things whole when feeding or defending its territory.

== > Mechanics ==
Similar to the Earth Leviathan, the '''Ice Leviathan''' is located underground and will roam around until a player above it is nearby. It will then chase that player, indicated by the rumbling of the '''Ice Leviathan''' below them. If the '''Ice Leviathan''' attempts to attack, the ground will start shaking and it will launch out of the ground into the sky at a random interval before crashing back down again. Any player or killable entity in the path of the '''Ice Leviathan''' when it attacks will die.

== > Spawn Chances ==
The '''Ice Leviathan''' has an 18.33% chance to spawn in the interior and a 54.27% chance to spawn on the exterior of [[Glace|'''Glace''']]. It additionally has a 20.50% chance to spawn on the exterior of [[Polarus|'''Polarus''']], although '''Ice Leviathans''' also act as map hazards there.

######## Infected Bunker Spider
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Infected Bunker Spider
|images=
Infected Bunker Spider.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Bunker Spider
|Internal ID= InfectedSandSpider
|Max Count= 1
|Power Level= 2
|Cause of Death= Mauling, Stabbing
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= 5
|Damage= 4 or 90
|Door Speed Multiplier= 0.15
|Stun Time Multiplier= 1
}}

The '''Infected Bunker Spider''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Bunker_Spider Bunker Spider] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. It is a large white spider with black markings and two spikes of white mold on its body.

== > Mechanics ==

Similar to a Bunker Spider, an '''Infected Bunker Spider''' will initially attempt to create a nesting area by placing several webs in the surrounding area and will typically stop if it encounters a player until line of sight is broken. Once all the webs have been laid down, the '''Infected Bunker Spider''' will find a spot to wait until one of its webs is triggered, a player walks underneath it, or it is attacked by a player. It will then pursue that player.

Players that come into contact with the '''Infected Bunker Spider''' will take 90 damage. Additionally, the white mold spikes on the '''Infected Bunker Spider''' rapidly deal 4 damage per hit to players on contact. Any player that dies to either attack will be cocooned and hung from the ceiling, although the '''Infected Bunker Spider''' typically is encountered on the exterior and the body will instead be hung on thin air. Regardless, the body can only be recovered via the ship teleporter.

== > Spawn Conditions ==
The '''Infected Bunker Spider''' only naturally spawns on [[Vindict|'''Vindict''']], having a 36.04% chance to spawn on the exterior during daytime and a 39.62% chance to spawn in the interior.

=== Major Story Spoilers ===
The '''Infected Bunker Spider''' can additionally spawn {{spoiler|immediately on the exterior of one or several moons depending on if players let [[ResearcherxB|'''ResearcherxB''']] crash or decide to overload it. If players let it crash onto [[Trite|'''Trite''']], several '''Infected Bunker Spiders''' will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day every time players land on Trite afterward on that save file.}}

{{spoiler|If players instead decided to overload the ship, debris from the ship can fall onto the exteriors of several moons. A couple or few '''Infected Bunker Spiders''' will spawn on the exterior of the moon every time players land on it afterward on that save file. The moons currently known to have a chance for debris to fall onto their exteriors are [[Carnate|'''Carnate''']], [[Core|'''Core''']], [[Crowd|'''Crowd''']], [[Dune|'''Dune''']], [[Glace|'''Glace''']], [[Heap|'''Heap''']], [[Hyve|'''Hyve''']], [[Infernis|'''Infernis''']], [[Junic|'''Junic''']], [[Selector|'''Selector''']], and [[Utril|'''Utril''']].}}

It is capable of growing in dark places but prefers not to, very rarely it be found in shadow or complete darkness.<br><br><br>The mold grows en masse and is able to spread across large surfaces with rapid succession. Additionally, on occasion it clusters up and grows spike-like formations which act as a way of detecting motion and a means to spread itself through direct infection of any poor creature which gets stung by it.<br><br><br>The spike-like formations are able to sense both heat and vibrations through the air. It knows what sort of creatures are easier to spread through and which are not. Those it deems not viable, it tries to scare off by shaking its spikes. However it will not hesitate to sting when the opportunity arises regardless of what steps on it.<br><br><br>Unlike most infections, this one does not try to kill or harm the host, instead it tries to adapt to its host and strengthen the skeleton or exoskeleton, making them bulkier and more violent as a faster method of spreading to other creatures through the addition of spikes growing out of the bones it has strengthened. Comparisons have been made with Rabies lyssavirus, a disease which similarly alters behaviour to become more violent as a means to spread.<br><br><br>The I.T.D.A. has investigated several infestations of this mold and deemed it not to be a critical level invasive species and has successfully cleared large patches of the mold.<br>They highly advise everyone to report any instances of the white mold appearing and avoid direct contact.}}

{{TOC left}}

'''Infernis''' was previously used for the mining of crystals and other various materials. But due to the increase of volcanic activity all sorts of insects infiltrated the facilities to seek refuge. Every employee within the building at this time was either devoured or cooked by the extreme heat.

== > Moon Map ==
{{Maps|Infernis}}

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Deceased.|Extremely hot, Dry dusty terrain, Rarely supports living plant life due to recent volcanic activity.|A desperate ecosystem, remaining creatures support agressive behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
'''Infernis''' has hot and dry terrain with little signs of plantlife beyond red bushes. Several large crystals are scattered across the landscape and a ring of lava surrounds the exterior. Its most prominent landmark is the large volcano that can be seen behind the ship, which periodically shoots out molten rock that crashes onto the exterior. This volcanic activity causes dust to scatter in the interior and reduce visibility. When the ship leaves '''Infernis''', the volcano will erupt and the lava will rise and cover the exterior. 

Four square shaped buildings can be found around the exterior, which are the main entrance and fire exits. The main entrance is on the right-hand side of the pathway that is behind and to the left (south) of the ship. A fire exit can similarly be found by going straight from the main entrance and past the floodlight on the ground. Another fire exit can be seen southeast of the ship, but requires a relatively difficult jump, tools like a ladder or TZP, or finding the exit within the interior to push a stalgamite and create a bridge to make the exit accessible. The last and southwest fire exit can be found by going to the path behind the ship and heading left to a short parkour above lava.

=== Exterior Ambience ===
[[File:infernis outside loop2.wav]]

=== Interior Ambience ===
[[File:infernis inside loop2.wav]]

== > Weather ==
'''Infernis''' can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

If '''Infernis''' experiences Rainy weather, steam will be present on the exterior and can reduce visibility.

If '''Infernis''' experiences Stormy weather, the lava and lava crystals on the exterior will be blue. This is just a visual change.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Music ===
'''Infernis''' has a unique music track that plays after landing on the moon.<br>[[File:Infernis music.wav]]

=== Lava ===
The lava on the exterior acts like quicksand and rapidly deals 10 damage per hit. If players fall into the holes with lava at the bottom, they will instead take 20 damage per hit.

=== Major Story Spoilers: Falling Debris ===
{{spoiler|If players decided to overload and blow up [[ResearcherxB|'''ResearcherxB''']], debris from the ship can fall onto the exterior of '''Infernis''' near the path behind and to the left (south) of the ship. If players land on '''Infernis''' in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and two [[Infected Bunker Spider|'''Infected Bunker Spiders''']] will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.}}

== Wesley's Scrap ==
Almost every Wesley's moon have its own unique scrap items. Some of them can be found on more than one moon. '''Wesley's scraps have default scrap item icons'''.<br>Currently, there are '''307''' unique, "normal" scrap items.<br><br>[[File:ScrapIcon2.png|border|center|100px]]

== Loggable Items ==
'''Loggable items''' are the foundation of Wesley's Moons lore. All of them can be found on their moons as random scrap within the interior or in special spots on exterior. Some of them can even unlock moons.<br>Loggable items have a '''unique icon''' in your inventory when you grab them.<br>Currently, there are '''122''' loggable items.

[[File:Loggableitemicon.png|border|100px|center]]<br>Loggable items can be inserted into '''log translator''' which can be found on most moons except:
*Vanilla moons
*Crowd
*Narcotic
*Descent
*Extort
*Release
*Duckstroid-14
*Berunah
<br>Here are images of how log translator looks:

<center>[[File:Log Translator.png|border|100px]][[File:log Translator1.png|border|100px]][[File:log Translator2.png|border|100px]]</center>
<br><br><span style="font-size: 110%;">'''All loggable items ARE NOT two-handed.'''</span>

== Videotapes ==
'''Videotapes''' are unique items, which unlock other moons after you insert them into the videotape player on '''[[Galetry]]'''. '''Cursed videotape''' and '''Bury the child''' are exceptions, as the former kills players and the latter is only supposed to unlock '''Roart''' during October for Halloween. Some videotapes can be found even on '''Vanilla moons'''.<br>Videotapes have a '''unique icon''' in your inventory when you grab them.<br>Currently, there are '''23''' videotapes.

== Ingredient Items ==
'''Ingredient items''' are scrap items that you can put into the machine on {{spoiler|'''[[Galetry]]'''}} and '''[[Gratar]]'''. Depositing the ingredients into the machines will process the materials and add resources to the machine that can then be used to craft '''Untampered operating panels''' (Gratar only), '''Blanky floppy discs''' (Galetry only), '''Triangulation devices''', '''Double-barrel shotguns''', '''Shotgun shells''', '''Adrenaline stims''', '''Health stims''', '''Pulatrum spore emitters''', '''Boomboxes''', '''Advanced flashlights''', '''Fog reducers''', '''Radar boosters''', '''Action figures''', '''Weed killer''', '''De-weed''', '''Pesticide sprinklers''', '''Fabricated keys''', and '''Single-barrel shotguns'''. Resources are shared between both machines and resources will be saved even after being fired.<br><br>Ingredient items have a '''unique icon''' in your inventory when you grab them. Currently, there are '''8''' ingredient items and '''8''' large ingredient items. However, '''Large plastic stock''' is likely not obtainable through legitimate means currently because it is not in the scrap table for '''Fission-C'''.

== Key Items ==
'''Key items''' are items which are required to unlock something or to finish a task or a challenge. Most key items spawn in their own unique place but there are exceptions - for example, '''Human heart''' is a scrap item but '''is required''' on [[Roart]] in a special place. Key items have a normal scrap icon in your inventory.<br>Currently, there are '''22''' key items.

== Action Figures ==

== Destiny Items ==
'''Destiny items''' are required to get other endings on '''[[Repress]]'''. Trying to get an ending without a Destiny item will result in you getting the "Escaped?" ending. Every destiny item has its own moon where it can be found. With most of them you have to do a special task. Only '''Harrington's research log 4''' can be found as random scrap within the facility (It is also a loggable item).<br>Destiny items have a '''unique icon''' in your inventory when you grab them.<br>Currently, there are '''6''' destiny items.

== Trivia ==
*'''Radio message 1''' and '''Quick start floppy disk''' are the only items in the mod that unlocks more than one moon at the same time.
*'''Cursed videtape''' is the only tape that does not unlock any moon.
*'''Concrete block''' is the heaviest scrap item in Wesley's Moons - It weighs 246 lbs.
*'''Legally distinct batley''' has the lowest individual scrap spawn chance of any item, being injected into almost all of Wesley's Moons with a rarity of 1 and a 0.05% chance to spawn on '''Roart'''.

{{TOC left}}

Deep in the deadly jungles of '''Junic''' there where ancient temples where ancient rituals were performed. This place is very attractive to archeologists due to the many artifacts that remain here. However they might not have fully understood what they were dealing with.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Junicnew.png|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Several tribes detected, no human life in designated area.|Warm, very lush terrain, supports plenty of flora, always sunny.|A very healthy ecosystem, fauna exhibits neutral behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather ==

Junic can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside & Outside Ambience ===
On Junic you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

==== Outside Ambience ====
[[File:Junic outside.wav]]

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:Junic inside loop.wav]]

=== Carnivorous Roses ===
Junic's exterior has several small and large roses that temporarily trap any player that walks into them. The small roses will deal 22 damage to the player while the large roses will deal 90 damage to the player before releasing them. Additionally, Junic's exterior is somewhat foggy and can be confusing to navigate due to rocks and trees that fall and block pathways at specific points in time if a player is nearby.

=== Ritual Circle ===
Near one of the fire exits, there exists a ritual circle on the ground. To reach it, head straight from the back of the ship and turn right, turn left into a narrow pathway, continue walking along the path until the next intersection and turn left, and follow the path until reaching the fire exit and ritual circle. Entering this circle normally will result in a short cutscene and death. During that cutscene you can hear voice of Devils of Junic.<br><br>[[File:LivingSpeach.wav]]<br><br>However, if the player holds the scrap "Jack's skull", which randomly spawns as scrap within the interior of Junic or is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop on '''[[Galetry]]''', the player will survive. A new shortcut between the fire exit and the ship will be unlocked, the exterior and interior will emit a red glow, and the player will see a dramatically different exterior. Additionally, another path opens up near the back right of the ship and to the left of the log translator. {{spoiler|Following this path shows a giant cubic skull and unlocks Roart.}}

=== Major Story Spoilers: Decision Aftermath ===
{{spoiler|If players decided to overload and blow up [[ResearcherxB|'''ResearcherxB''']], debris from the ship can fall onto Junic's exterior. If players land on Junic in the future on that save file, a mild outbreak of white mold will be present on the exterior and [[Infected Bunker Spider|'''Infected Bunker Spiders''']] will spawn on the exterior at the start of the day.}}

######## Key Wielding Nutcracker
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Key Wielding Nutcracker
|images=
Key Wielding Nutcracker.jpg:In-Game
|Variant Of= Nutcracker
|Internal ID= NutcrackerKey
|Max Count= 10
|Power Level= 1
|Cause of Death= Gunshots, Kicking
|Is Body Recoverable?= Yes

|Health= 5
|Damage= 20, 40, 100, or Instant Kill 
|Door Speed Multiplier= 2
|Stun Time Multiplier= 0.5
}}

The '''Key Wielding Nutcracker''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Nutcracker Nutcracker] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. As its name implies, it looks very similar to the Nutcracker except it has a brighter colored coat, a hollowed out eye, and a key around its neck.

== > Mechanics == 
The '''Key Wielding Nutcracker''' behaves identical to the Nutcracker, having the same patrolling state, scanning state, attacking state, etc. The most notable differences are the bloody visual effects that comes out after the shotgun is fired and the scrap dropped, being the '''Bloody shotgun''', up to two '''Bloody Ammo''', and the '''Toy vault key'''. The first two are functionally identical to the '''Shotgun''' and '''Ammo''' respectively, and the ammo works for reloading any shotgun, but killing a '''Key Wielding Nutcracker''' is the only legitimate way to obtain any of this scrap.

== > Spawn Conditions ==
The '''Key Wielding Nutcracker''' will almost immediately spawn in the interior if the [[Toy_Store#Kill_the_Key_Keeper|'''Kill the Key Keeper''']] objective is generated in the '''Toy Store'''. This spawn does not contribute to total Power Level, and the Max Count and Power Level of the '''Key Wielding Nutcracker''' only matter if players modify spawn tables to spawn the '''Key Wielding Nutcracker''' elsewhere.

######## Lasso Man
__NOTOC__
{{Entity Infobox
|title=Lasso Man

|Health= Unkillable

}}

The '''Lasso Man''' is a hostile entity and variant of the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Jester Jester] added by '''Wesley's Ememy Variants'''. This entity is not to be confused with the other appearances of the '''Lasso Man''' in the [[Art_Gallery|'''Art Gallery''']] and the unused vanilla entity [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Lasso_Man Lasso]. To add to this confusion, both entities seem to share the same Internal ID, though Wesley's variant can also be referred to generally as '''RunningLasso'''.

Regardless, the '''Lasso Man''' is a tall humanoid creature made of red rope and string. Its head and the ends of its arms are circular and used as nooses to kill players.

== > Mechanics ==
Unlike the Jester, the '''Lasso Man''' will almost immediately enter its chasing state after spawning regardless of if it actually has seen a player or not. It will chase the closest player and instantly kill them on contact. However, its maximum speed is significantly reduced, only being a bit faster than a player walking.

After all players leave the interior, the '''Lasso Man''' will roam around the interior at a significantly reduced speed until spotting another player. The '''Lasso Man''' has a following timer and cranking timer of 1 second, meaning it will almost immediately enter its chasing state again after seeing another player.

== > Spawn Chances ==
The '''Lasso Man''' is primarily encountered in the [[Art_Gallery#>_Event:_Lost_Corridors|'''Lost Corridors''']] event in the '''Art Gallery''', where it is guaranteed to spawn from the painting in the reward room after a player passes a trigger point at and near the door leading into the room.

The '''Lasso Man''' can also naturally spawn on a few moons, though this should be taken with a grain of salt given the confusion surrounding its Internal ID as well as the vanilla Lasso, who is also in each of these tables, being incapable of spawning without commands or external modifications.

{{TOC left}}

'''Lecaro''' is an asteroid orbiting [[Infernis]], on the surface it seemed like not more than a volcanic wasteland. But deep inside there was a large deposit of crystalline wonders. Very attractive to the many mining companies in the region. Unfortunately they were not prepared enough for the dangers of this asteroid.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Lecaro_Topview.jpg|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Suffocated.|Extremely hot, Dry dusty terrain, Rarely supports living plant life.|A desperate ecosystem, remaining creatures support agressive behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather ==
Lecaro can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, or Hallowed weather by default.<br><br>When Lecaro experiences Rainy weather, steam will be visible on the exterior.<br><br>When Lecaro experiences Stormy weather, the lava and lava crystals on the exterior will be blue.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside & Outside Ambience ===
On Lecaro you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

==== Outside Ambience ====
[[File:Lecaro outside loop.wav]]

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:Lecaro inside loop.wav]]

=== Stalagmites & Gunpowder Barrels ===
Lecaro's exterior always spawns a shovel behind the ship to break Lecaro's unique map hazard, "Stalagmite", which one always spawns behind the ship as well. These Stalagmites can also be broken with a knife and a Pickaxe, a shovel variant and [[Items#WesleysScrap|custom scrap]] Wesley's Moons adds, breaks them in one hit. To the right of the main entrance there are large gunpowder barrels that explode when hit with a knife or shovel. Many more Stalagmites and gunpowder barrels can be found within the interior, but the gunpowder barrels in the interior are lit when hit instead of exploding immediately.

=== Minecart ===
Lecaro's exterior has a minecart to the right of the main entrance that can be used to transport players and scrap between the main entrance and the ship. While the lever at the main entrance can be pulled to have the minecart travel in either direction, there isn't a lever at the ship and the player instead interacts with and pushes the minecart back to the main entrance. There is a geyser underneath and between a gap in the tracks that triggers any time a player is detected above it that rapidly deals 69,420 damage per hit to players to prevent simply running and jumping across the tracks instead.

=== Falling Rocks ===
Lecaro's exterior has large rocks that spawn in fixed positions that, for the most part, randomly fall when a player walks underneath it. This will crush any player underneath it for 999 damage and block off that path for the rest of the day as these rocks can not be broken.

=== Stalactites Within The Interior ===
Numerous stalactites will spawn above or on the roof of the interior. These are normally not visible to the player, but can be seen in interiors with high ceilings like the [[Grand Armory]]. When a player walks underneath a stalactite, there is a chance it will begin falling and the roof will shake and scatter dust as a warning. It will then fall into the interior and any player underneath it will be crushed for 999 damage. This will then create a Stalagmite as an obstruction, which can be broken as usual.

== > Progression ==
=== Unlocked By ===
{{spoiler|Interacting with the map found on the exterior of [[Atlantica]].}}

=== Unlocks ===
{{spoiler|[[Thalasso|<big>'''Thalasso:'''</big>]] Once the stalagmite is broken, stick to the right. Get past the river of lava and keep right. Before reaching the fire exit, there will be a small opening on the left with the map. Interacting with this map will cause a short cutscene and unlock Thalasso. Note that a rock will fall on top of the map shortly after the cutscene, crushing the player.}}

{{spoiler|[[Hyve|<big> '''Hyve:''' </big>]] Once the stalagmite is broken, hug the left wall until getting back outside, head up the hill on the right, and a hive will be straight ahead on a different rock. This is also near one of the fire exits. A jetpack or extension ladder is required to reach the hive and breaking it reveals the Hyve videotape.}}<br>{{spoiler|[[Oldred|<big>'''Oldred:'''</big>]] Oldred videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.}}

==== Explorer's Note 1 ====
{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
!Image & Text {{pad|0.5em}}
|-
![[File:Explorers Note 1.png|border|center|frameless|300x300px]]
|-
|{{Story Log Text|It has not been a couple hours since I entered this abandoned mineshaft. And already something feels off. If not for the missing equipment in the supply area, it would be the distant rumbling giving me a sense of unease. Maybe I should just shrug it off and get what I came here for.<br>A large deposit of various crystals is what attracted me to this place.<br>I've been short on money and I'm slowly heading into debt. If I'm able to find what I'm looking for it could really help me out. I don't know how deep they are but I know for certain that they're there.<br>There's no mineshaft here for nothing.<br>I'm heading in deeper.}}
|}

==== Explorer's Note 2 ====
{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
!Image & Text {{pad|0.5em}}
|-
![[File:Explorers Note 2.png|border|center|frameless|300x300px]]
|-
|{{Story Log Text|I was uneased before, now I'm scared.<br>I have seen some of the equipment scattered around the caverns. Abandoned by whomwever used to work here. Possibly left in an emergency I thought. But then I started seeing bones and bodies.<br>There were empty birdcages sitting on the floor about an hour back. My theory is that there might be something toxic in the air. Possibly some sort of gas leak. Suffocating everyone who was down here at the time. It could be in the air still.<br>Either way, I need to make it quick. The rumbling is getting closer. And I do not entertain what that could mean.}}
|}

==== Explorer's Note 3 ====
{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
!Image & Text {{pad|0.5em}}
|-
![[File:Explorers Note 3.png|border|center|frameless|300x300px]]
|-
|{{Story Log Text|The earthquakes are getting louder and I can hear parts of the cavern collapsing in the distance ahead of me.<br>The amount of bodies I have seen have left me horrified. While some of them were slumped over. Others looked like they were trying to run.<br>It's getting harder for me to breathe. And my legs are getting tired.<br>I have found a few crystals of value. Not many but I should not succomb to my greed. This deposit is lost and I don't want to die trying to find it.<br>I'm turning around and heading back. I want to see my cat Bean again.<br>I just need to remember the way I came.}}
|}

=== Miner Recording ===
[[File:Miner's recording.ogg]]
{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
!Text {{pad|0.5em}}
|-
|{{Story Log Text|Ah well would you look at that<br>I think I got this thing workin'<br>Might serve me some entertainment in these caves<br>It's not easy spendin' all day down here<br>Can't see the sun, can't read the time<br>It's actually quite sad<br>Diggin' for these shiny crystals and I don't even know what they are<br>They were sendin' birds in earlier<br>Haven't heard from them since<br>Ah, well<br>Better get back to work}}
|}

{{TOC left}}

Mrov bought McDonalds.<br>He's here

== > Moon Map ==
{{Maps|MorvDonalds}}

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|happy customers|bleak.|oh if only you knew.|}}

== > Environment ==
MorvDonalds is a specific rocky moon featuring rough landscapes, some several plants, crystals, dead trees and MorvDonalds's building. If you played Lethal Company with Wesley's Moons before you probably noticed that moon's surface is similar to [[Infernis]] and [[Lecaro]] - two volanic like moons that you can unlock during your journey. Upon exiting the ship, when you go straight you'll see MorvDonalds's building which is similar to how Mcdonalds restaurants look. If you stop and go left instead of going to main entrance, you'll be close to one of fire exits also crystals will lead you to it. Fire exits on this moon are untypical because they don't look like they're connected to a building. It's similar to how main entrance on [[Hyx]] is presented. Another and last fire exit is located on the other half of the map. When you'll be standing in front of main entrance and then go right and straight down the path, you'll find the second fire exit.

== > Weather ==
'''MorvDonalds''' supports Rainy, Foggy, Stormy, Eclipsed, Hurricane, Forsaken, Hallowed and Earthquake weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Unique Scrap ===
This moon contains only one unique scrap item which is '''Mrov Sauce'''. It is the most common scrap item on this moon.

=== Interior ===
This moon has its own unique interior that spawn here only. It has '''99.9997%''' chance to spawn. '''Interior looks like McDonald's restaurant'''.

== > Progression ==
=== Unlocked By ===
This moon is unlocked by default.

=== Unlocks === 
This moon does not unlock any other moon.

== > Trivia ==
*This is the only Lethal Company mod created by '''Magic_Wesley''' that contains custom moon and its own unique interior at the same time.
*This mod was created because it was Wesley's secret santa gift for his friend '''Mrov'''.
*MorvDonalds unique interior also has references to '''Poland''' just because '''Mrov''' (Wesley's friend for who this moon was made) is from Poland.

{{TOC left}}

Between the mountain tops on '''Motra''' neighboring Filitrios. There is a hidden, well protected prison. The prison held prisoners off all sorts, the most dangerous ones were often shipped off to a higher level security prison such as [[Alcatras]]. Very few actually managed to escape the prison. Until it was invaded. 

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Motraview.jpg|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Executed.|Cold, mountainous terrain, very snowy.|A healthy avian ecosystem.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather Conditions ==
Motra can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.<br><br>If Motra is Eclipsed, the mortars will fire off four shots in quick succession instead of one.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Mortars ===
Motra has mortars as seen in the tape used to unlock the moon. These mortars aim towards the rough location of a random player outside and fire one shot at a time. These mortars can be turned off via a lever that is behind the ship, up the pathway to the right above the fire exit, and to left at the next intersection.

{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Trial: Medicate The Unwell ===
This moon features a '''trial''' that generates on the exterior. Completing it rewards the player with scrap worth a total of at least ▮320. '''The specific rewards''' are {{spoiler|several "Small diamond" and one "Medicate the unwell ticket" scrap.}}

<big>To complete this trial:</big>

#{{spoiler|Enter the warehouse straight behind the ship.}}
#{{spoiler|Grab the gas canister next to the machine hooked up to the employee, carefully follow the line connected to the machine to the correct generator, and fuel it with the gas. Fueling the wrong generator will cause the player to die via blast.}}
#{{spoiler|Exit this warehouse and follow the yellow signs to a different warehouse. This other warehouse is located in front of and to the left of the ship.}}
#{{spoiler|Retrieve two acid canisters from this warehouse. Inside your vision will be clouded with a TZP-like effect and you will hear auditory hallucinations, but it is non-lethal.}}
#{{spoiler|Return to the warehouse with the employee inside it, pour both acid canisters into the machine, and wait for the employee to die. The rewards will spawn on the floor in front of the employee.}}

{{TOC left}}

'''Oldred''' is one of the most valuable moons in the system. Not for its many riches but for its remarkable amount of oil. For this reason, during hard times of death and destruction, oil extraction sites were made. But nobody knew how big of a mistake this was until it was too late.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:Oldredtopp.png|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Deceased.|Hot thin terrain, no surviving flora, high pressure within outer crust.|A desperate ecosystem, remaining fauna display agressive behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather Conditions ==
Oldred can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside & Outside Ambience ===
On Oldred you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

==== Outside Ambience ====
[[File:Oldred outside loop.wav]]

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:Oldred inside loop.wav]]

=== Geysers ===
Oldred's exterior has geysers of boiling oil that shoot upward periodically, primarily on the catwalks. These geysers rapidly deal 3 damage per hit to any player that walks into them.

=== Hanging Mines ===
Oldred's interior has a unique map hazard called a "Hanging mine". These mines deal 10 damage to any player that walks into them. Throughout the day, a blast radius will pulse out from a mine accompanied by a beeping sound. The blast radius will then pulse out again and the beeping sound will increase in speed before the mine explodes. Any player that is within the blast radius when the explosion occurs will take 70, 90, 99, or 9,999,999 damage depending on the proximity to the mine itself. The explosion goes through all obstructions.

=== Where is Duckstroid-14? ===
After leaving the ship, when you approach the rightmost building, you can find graffiti on one of the walls that says "Where is Duckstroid-14?", which you can interact with. When you proceed to do so a strange audio will play. After that '''[[Duckstroid-14]]''' will be unlocked for you.

{{TOC left}}

'''Polarus''' houses the legendary Polar Vaults. These vaults contained very valuable riches before the corporation went bankrupt. The corporation was known for their extremely high hiring rates. It also appears that many of these employees magically dissapeared after being fired.

== > Moon map ==
[[File:Polarusss.png|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Sacrificed/Deceased.|Cold, wet snowy terrain, supports plant life.|A balanced ecosystem, creatures support very agressive behaviour.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}
'''Polarus''' features an elevator, a ladder, moving platforms, and five fire exits. The exterior is massive, featuring a frozen lake with breakable ice platforms.

== > Weather ==
Polarus can experience Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, or Hurricane weather by default.

If Polarus is Eclipsed, the Ice Leviathan that is in the area with the two fire exits to the front left of the ship will not be present. Instead, a meteor will enter the atmosphere at 02:00pm and crash into this area at around 05:00pm. Any player nearby will die and any player within a large radius that extends all the way to the ship will quickly take 20 damage per hit. {{spoiler|Approaching and inspecting this meteor will unlock [[Desolation]].}}

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Inside & Outside Ambience ===
On Polarus you can hear two ambiences. One plays inside while the other one plays outside.

==== Outside Ambience ====
[[File:Polarus ambience outside.wav]]

==== Inside Ambience ====
[[File:Polarus ambience inside.wav]]

=== Ice Leviathan (Visual) ===
Shortly after landing, an Ice Leviathan can be seen launching upward from the back of the ship to an area in front of the ship. When the player leaves the moon, an Ice Leviathan can again be seen launching upward from the back of the ship and it will proceed to attempt to devour the ship. This is purely visual.

=== Ice Leviathan (Hazard) ===
Polarus's exterior has an Ice Leviathan that moves through the area where the two fire exits in front and to the left of ship are located roughly every 20 seconds. Any player in its path will die.

=== Frozen Lake and Falling Icicles ===
On the frozen lake behind and below the ship are noticeable patches of ice. Ice Leviathans can break two patches of this ice when players approach or stand on them, while the other three patches of ice will break when a player stands on them for too long with too much weight. Some of the ice is also slippery, causing players to move faster in one direction but making it significantly more difficult to slow down or turn.

Additionally, icicles can fall onto players in the canyon paths in front of the ship. Any player that gets directly hit by an icicle will die.

=== Icy Walls ===
The pathway that leads to the two fire exits to the front right of the ship will begin randomly closing when a player walks through them. Any player will be crushed by these moving walls, though it can be survivable due to clipping issues. This makes these fire exits inaccessible without a jetpack or finding them in the interior for the rest of the day.

A moon with lush and dense forests, it remained mostly untouched until ownership was transferred to the '''Trite Control Corporation'''.

== > Moon Map ==
[[File:ReleaseMap.jpg|border|frameless|650px]]

== > Moon Info ==
{{Moon Info|Abandoned|Cold. Moist. Mildly foggy. Highly populated by dense forests.|Dominated by a few species.|}}

== > Environment ==
{{Unfinished Section}}

== > Weather ==

Release can experience Rainy, Foggy, Stormy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Time Multiplier ===
This moon has a default day speed multiplier of 0.7, meaning the player can stay on the moon for longer.

=== Trial: Reshape The Incapable ===
This moon features a trial to complete that generates with the Expanded Facility interior. Completing it rewards the player with scrap worth a total of at least ▮360. '''The specific rewards''' are {{spoiler|the scrap "Bloodied diamond" and "Reshape the incapable ticket".}}

<big>To complete this trial:</big>

#{{spoiler|Though not required until the final step, it is advised to find a door with a sign that says "RESHAPE THE INCAPABLE" and remember its location.}}
#{{spoiler|Find a room with an employee trapped in a machine and remember its location.}}
#{{spoiler|Find and return three "Machine parts" scrap to this room and insert them into the machine. These parts spawn in smaller server rooms with shelving units behind electrical gates. These electrical gates will deal 99 hp to the player if they walk through them while holding machine parts. The intended method to avoid taking damage is to place the parts onto a small platform, walk through the electrical gate and around to the other side of the platform, and rotate the platform to safely transport the parts. However, dropping the parts near the electrical gate, walking through the gate, and grabbing the parts from the other side is much simpler.}}
#{{spoiler|Press the red button in the room with the employee, grab the gas can underneath it, and find a generator within the interior to fuel with the gas. The generator typically spawns in rooms adjacent to catwalks with a sign saying "BACKUP POWER".}}
#{{spoiler|Return to the room with the employee, press the red button again, and wait.<br>6. Once the employee has been "reshaped" and a loud buzzer sound plays, return to the door in step 1. It will now be opened.}}

'''Additionally''', completing this trial can reward the player with {{spoiler|two different destiny items that can be inserted into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on [[Repress]].}}

'''Ending 5:''' Turn on the TV in the room after beating the trial and watch. {{spoiler|The destiny item "Secret Coordinates" will spawn in the machine next to the TV afterward.}}

'''Ending 6:''' The player must have previously completed the trials on [[Crowd]], [[Narcotic]], [[Descent]], and [[Extort]] to get their respective tickets as rewards. In the room after completing the trial, insert all five tickets, including Release's ticket acquired in this room, into the machine to left of the TV as prompted before turning on the TV. {{spoiler|The destiny item "Very secret Coordinates" will spawn in the machine shortly after turning on the TV. Submitting any less than all five tickets will result in Ending 5.}}

== > Weather ==
Repress can experience Earthquakes or Minefield weather by default.

== > Moon Exclusive Content ==
=== Time Multiplier ===
Repress has a default day speed multiplier of 0.75, meaning the player can stay on the moon for longer.

=== Ending Guide ===
The following content contains major spoilers for completion.

{{spoiler|Repress's exterior has an abandoned ship the player can repair and power to take off in. An apparatus, two oil barrels, and an untampered operating panel are required to do so. The appratus can be found within the [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Interiors#The_Factory Facility], [[Expanded Facility]], and [[Fractured Complex]] interiors. The oil barrels can randomly spawn as scrap within the interiors of multiple moons, but most commonly spawn on [[Oldred]] and Repress. The untampered operating panel is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop on [[Galetry]] for ▮7000, can be crafted on [[Gratar]], and randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of [[Empra]] or [[Hyx]].}}

{{spoiler|To the left of the main entrance, insert an apparatus to open the door at the end of the wire. To the left of the ship in this room, place two oil barrels to fuel the ship. Once fueled, turn towards the monitor, interact with the keypad, interact with the top lever, interact with the bottom lever, and interact with the top lever again to move the ship outside. Run straight out of this room to reach the ship, jump inside, and place the untampered operating panel onto the terminal. If a destiny item has been collected, it can be inserted into the slot to the left of the terminal. Regardless, taking off will cause a cutscene to play and transport the player to the back of the ship once finished. This process is required to complete any ending.}}

A destiny item can be acquired on [[Berunah]], [[Carnate]], [[Empra]], [[Release]], or [[Utril]].}}

== > Lore ==
=== Floppy Disks ===
'''Kind crew''', '''Insanity''', and '''Destiny''' all can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior. They tell the story of a crew looking to escape from the company using a ship on Repress and flying to a moon in a different region known as 495-Risk. One of the crew members died to a Masked on [https://lethal.miraheze.org/wiki/Rend Rend]. The fate of the remaining crew is unknown.

==== Kind Crew ====
{| class="article-table mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="&#9660;" data-collapsetext="&#9650;"
!Text {{pad|0.5em|}}
|-
|{{Story Log Text|-9th of July 2349-<br>I found a couple floppy discs in a cabinet somewhere in the building.<br>Allows me to put down my thoughts using the big computer in the hangar.<br><br>First I'll introduce myself, hi, I'm Dan. It's been 7 days since I started working for the company.<br>Lucky for me I was greeted by a set of kind faces. They sort of explained to me how things work around here.<br>We're a crew of 4, there's Berry, he's pretty funny and good at keeping our spirits up. Then there's Kate who has been here the longest, used to be a mechanic for a failed business.<br>And there's Arnold. Big guy, pretty smart as well, we call him engine man cause he's always the one carrying the engines hehe.<br>(I'm also fairly certain Kate and Arnold have a thing for each other)<br>Don't tell them I wrote that, they'll kill me<br><br>It's been rough. We've been going from building to building day by day delivering all our Junk to the company building.<br>Can't say I'm quite fond of the place. The company desk reeks, it's nasty. And not only that but the building itself is quite imposing.<br>I don't understand why but it feels like it wants to crush me like I'm an ant in the kitchen.<br><br>Same with this place, though I feel a bit more safe here, its less menacing. Less like I'm being watched constantly.<br>I'm not the only one who feels that way.<br>Arnold hates the company building too. He's always said there's something off about it.<br>Maybe he's on to something.<br><br>Either way Kate just radioed in that it's getting late. I better get going.<br>I'll write more when I can.}}
|}

And Berry has seemingly cought the flu.<br><br>It's been rough.<br><br>Last thing we expected was to enter an insane asylum back on Vow. The place looked haunted.<br>It might as well have been because I swear I saw a trash can move. Arnold also claims to have seen a dark figure briefly staring at him when he opened a door before it vanished.<br>Terrifying.<br>That wasn't the strangest part though. We heart Kate scream a few hallways down.. and when we got there, Blood was still freshly dripping from the ceiling. Guts, pieces of skin and hair littered the floor.<br>We were horrified.
